questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 《職業安全衛生法》的立法目的為何？
questions.b_zh: 規範勞資雙方之工資給付
questions.c_zh: 提高事業單位生產效率
questions.d_zh: 防止職業災害，保障工作者安全及健康
questions.q_en: What is the legislative purpose of the Occupational Safety and Health Act?
questions.b_en: To regulate wage payment between employers and employees
questions.d_en: To prevent occupational accidents and protect workers' safety and health
questions.explain_zh: 第1條：為防止職業災害，保障工作者安全及健康，特制定本法。
questions.explain_en: Article 1: The Act is enacted to prevent occupational accidents and protect the safety and health of workers.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第2條，「工作者」不包括下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 受工作場所負責人指揮監督從事勞動之人員
questions.q_en: Under Article 2, which of the following is NOT a 'worker'?
questions.a_en: A person performing labor under the direction or supervision of the workplace manager
questions.d_en: A visitor merely touring the site
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第1款：工作者指勞工、自營作業者及其他受工作場所負責人指揮或監督從事勞動之人員。訪客未從事勞動，不屬工作者。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(1): 'worker' means laborers, self-employed persons and other persons performing labor under the direction or supervision of the workplace manager. A visitor performs no labor.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法所稱「勞工」，指下列何者？
questions.b_zh: 受僱從事工作獲致工資者
questions.d_zh: 獨立作業之技藝工作者
questions.q_en: Under the Act, a 'laborer' means:
questions.b_en: A person employed to work and receiving wages
questions.c_en: The person in charge of operating the business
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第2款：勞工指受僱從事工作獲致工資者。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(2): 'laborer' means a person who is employed to work and receives wages.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法所稱「雇主」，指下列何者？
questions.c_zh: 事業主或事業之經營負責人
questions.q_en: Under the Act, 'employer' means:
questions.b_en: The chairperson of the labor union
questions.c_en: The business owner or the person in charge of operating the business
questions.d_en: An occupational safety and health administrator
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第3款：雇主指事業主或事業之經營負責人。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(3): 'employer' means the business owner or the person in charge of operating the business.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法所稱「職業災害」，其結果包含下列何者？
questions.q_en: Under the Act, the consequences covered by an 'occupational accident' include:
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第5款：職業災害指因勞動場所之建築物、機械、設備、原料、材料、化學品等或作業活動及其他職業上原因引起之工作者疾病、傷害、失能或死亡。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(5): an occupational accident means a worker's disease, injury, disability or death caused by buildings, machinery, equipment, materials, chemicals, work activities or other occupational causes at the labor site.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法所稱「作業場所」，指下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 工作場所中，從事特定工作目的之場所
questions.b_zh: 勞動契約存續中由雇主提示使勞工提供勞務之場所
questions.c_zh: 接受雇主指示處理勞工事務之人所能支配管理之場所
questions.d_zh: 自營作業者實際從事勞動之場所
questions.q_en: Under the Act, an 'operation site' means:
questions.a_en: A place within the workplace used for a specific work purpose
questions.b_en: A place designated by the employer during the labor contract for the laborer to provide services
questions.c_en: A place that can be controlled and managed by the person handling labor affairs under the employer's instruction
questions.d_en: A place where a self-employed person actually performs labor
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第8款：作業場所指工作場所中，從事特定工作目的之場所。「雇主提示使勞工提供勞務之場所」為勞動場所；「處理勞工事務之人所能支配管理之場所」為工作場所。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(8): an operation site is a place within the workplace used for a specific work purpose. The place designated by the employer for providing services is the labor site; the place controlled by the person handling labor affairs is the workplace.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法所稱中央主管機關為何？
questions.q_en: Which is the central competent authority under the Act?
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第1項：本法所稱主管機關，在中央為勞動部；在直轄市為直轄市政府；在縣（市）為縣（市）政府。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(1): the central competent authority is the Ministry of Labor; at the municipal level it is the municipal government; at the county (city) level it is the county (city) government.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法的適用範圍為何？
questions.a_zh: 僅適用於勞工人數三十人以上之事業
questions.d_zh: 適用於各業，但中央主管機關得指定公告部分規定之適用
questions.q_en: What is the scope of application of the Act?
questions.a_en: Only enterprises with 30 or more laborers
questions.d_en: All industries, though the central competent authority may designate partial application by public notice
questions.explain_zh: 第4條：本法適用於各業。但因事業規模、性質及風險等因素，中央主管機關得指定公告其適用本法之部分規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 4: the Act applies to all industries; based on scale, nature and risk, the central competent authority may designate and announce partial application of the Act.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法第5條規定，雇主使勞工從事工作，應在何種範圍內採取必要之預防設備或措施？
questions.b_zh: 主管機關檢查時之範圍內
questions.q_en: Under Article 5, an employer shall take necessary preventive equipment or measures within what scope?
questions.b_en: The scope examined by the competent authority during inspection
questions.c_en: The highest standard regardless of cost
questions.d_en: The scope requested by the laborers
questions.explain_zh: 第5條第1項：雇主使勞工從事工作，應在合理可行範圍內，採取必要之預防設備或措施，使勞工免於發生職業災害。
questions.explain_en: Article 5(1): the employer shall, within a reasonably practicable scope, take necessary preventive equipment or measures so that laborers are free from occupational accidents.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第5條第2項，機械、設備、原料等物件之設計、製造或輸入者及工程之設計或施工者，應於何階段實施風險評估？
questions.c_zh: 設計、製造、輸入或施工規劃階段
questions.q_en: Under Article 5(2), designers, manufacturers or importers of machinery, equipment and materials, and designers or contractors of construction works, shall conduct risk assessment at which stage?
questions.b_en: Three years after the product leaves the factory
questions.c_en: At the design, manufacturing, import or construction planning stage
questions.d_en: Before inspection by the labor inspection agency
questions.explain_zh: 第5條第2項：物件之設計、製造或輸入者及工程之設計或施工者，應於設計、製造、輸入或施工規劃階段實施風險評估，致力防止發生職業災害。
questions.explain_en: Article 5(2): risk assessment shall be conducted at the design, manufacturing, import or construction planning stage to prevent occupational accidents during use or construction.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬本法第6條第2項雇主應妥為規劃及採取必要安全衛生措施之事項？
questions.a_zh: 輪班、夜間工作、長時間工作等異常工作負荷促發疾病之預防
questions.b_zh: 防止高壓氣體引起之危害
questions.c_zh: 防止水患、風災或火災引起之危害
questions.d_zh: 防止採石、採掘等作業引起之危害
questions.q_en: Which of the following falls under Article 6(2), matters the employer shall properly plan and take necessary safety and health measures for?
questions.a_en: Preventing diseases induced by abnormal workloads such as shift work, night work and long working hours
questions.c_en: Preventing hazards from floods, windstorms or fires
questions.d_en: Preventing hazards from quarrying and excavation
questions.explain_zh: 第6條第2項四款：重複性作業促發肌肉骨骼疾病之預防、異常工作負荷促發疾病之預防、執行職務遭受不法侵害之預防、避難急救休息等事項。其餘選項屬第6條第1項。
questions.explain_en: Article 6(2) lists four items: musculoskeletal disorders from repetitive work, diseases induced by abnormal workloads, unlawful physical or mental harm by others, and evacuation/first aid/rest. The other options fall under Article 6(1).

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法第6條第2項第3款要求雇主對「執行職務因他人行為遭受身體或精神不法侵害之預防」，除採取措施外尚應建立何種程序？
questions.q_en: Under Article 6(2)(3), for preventing physical or mental unlawful harm by others during the performance of duties, the employer shall also establish what procedures?
questions.explain_zh: 第6條第2項第3款：執行職務因他人行為遭受身體或精神不法侵害之預防，並建立申訴、調查及處理程序。
questions.explain_en: Article 6(2)(3): prevention of unlawful physical or mental harm by others while performing duties, and establishment of complaint, investigation and handling procedures.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法第6條第1項第5款要求雇主應有必要之安全衛生設備及措施，以防止何種作業場所引起之危害？
questions.c_zh: 有墜落、物體飛落或崩塌等之虞之作業場所
questions.q_en: Article 6(1)(5) requires the employer to have necessary safety and health equipment and measures to prevent hazards from what type of operation site?
questions.c_en: Operation sites with risk of falls, falling objects or collapse
questions.explain_zh: 第6條第1項第5款：防止有墜落、物體飛落或崩塌等之虞之作業場所引起之危害。
questions.explain_en: Article 6(1)(5): to prevent hazards from operation sites where there is a risk of falls, falling objects or collapse.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第7條，對於中央主管機關指定之機械、設備或器具，其構造、性能及防護不符安全標準者，下列何種行為是被禁止的？
questions.a_zh: 產製運出廠場、輸入、租賃、供應或設置
questions.d_zh: 僅禁止在工作場所張貼標示
questions.q_en: Under Article 7, for machinery, equipment or tools designated by the central competent authority whose structure, performance and protection do not meet safety standards, which act is prohibited?
questions.a_en: Manufacturing for shipment, importing, leasing, supplying or installing
questions.d_en: Posting labels in the workplace only
questions.explain_zh: 第7條第1項：製造者、輸入者、供應者或雇主，對於指定之機械、設備或器具，其構造、性能及防護非符合安全標準者，不得產製運出廠場、輸入、租賃、供應或設置。
questions.explain_en: Article 7(1): manufacturers, importers, suppliers or employers shall not manufacture for shipment, import, lease, supply or install designated machinery, equipment or tools that do not meet safety standards.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第7條第3項，製造者或輸入者對於符合安全標準之指定機械、設備或器具，應辦理下列何事？
questions.a_zh: 於中央主管機關指定之資訊申報網站登錄，並於產品明顯處張貼安全標示
questions.b_zh: 向地方政府申請營業登記
questions.c_zh: 向勞動檢查機構申請竣工檢查
questions.q_en: Under Article 7(3), for designated machinery, equipment or tools that meet safety standards, the manufacturer or importer shall:
questions.a_en: Register on the information reporting website designated by the central competent authority and affix a safety label in a conspicuous place on the product
questions.b_en: Apply for business registration with the local government
questions.c_en: Apply to the labor inspection agency for completion inspection
questions.explain_zh: 第7條第3項：符合安全標準者，應於中央主管機關指定之資訊申報網站登錄，並於其產製或輸入之產品明顯處張貼安全標示，以供識別。
questions.explain_en: Article 7(3): products meeting the safety standards shall be registered on the designated information reporting website and bear a safety label in a conspicuous place for identification.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 經中央主管機關公告列入型式驗證之機械、設備或器具，須符合何條件始得產製運出廠場或輸入？
questions.c_zh: 經中央主管機關認可之驗證機構實施型式驗證合格及張貼合格標章
questions.q_en: For machinery, equipment or tools announced as subject to type certification, what condition must be met before manufacturing for shipment or import?
questions.c_en: Passing type certification by a certification body approved by the central competent authority and affixing a conformity mark
questions.d_en: Record with the local competent authority
questions.explain_zh: 第8條第1項：非經中央主管機關認可之驗證機構實施型式驗證合格及張貼合格標章，不得產製運出廠場或輸入。
questions.explain_en: Article 8(1): they shall not be manufactured for shipment or imported unless type-certified by an approved certification body and affixed with a conformity mark.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第8條第2項，下列何種情形得免實施型式驗證？
questions.a_zh: 產品售價低於一定金額
questions.d_zh: 供國防軍事用途使用，並有國防部或其直屬機關出具證明
questions.q_en: Under Article 8(2), which of the following may be exempted from type certification?
questions.a_en: The product price is below a certain amount
questions.b_en: Product liability insurance has been purchased
questions.c_en: The manufacturer believes the quality is good
questions.d_en: Used for national defense purposes with a certificate issued by the Ministry of National Defense or its directly subordinate agency
questions.explain_zh: 第8條第2項免驗證情形包括：依第16條或其他法律實施檢查驗證認可、供國防軍事用途並有國防部證明、限量製造供研發測試經核准、商業樣品或展覽品經核准、其他特殊情形經核准。
questions.explain_en: Article 8(2) exemptions include: inspection/certification under Article 16 or other laws; national defense use with MND certificate; limited quantity for R&D/testing with approval; commercial samples or exhibits with approval; other special cases with approval.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第9條，下列何種產品不得使用安全標示或驗證合格標章？
questions.a_zh: 依法免驗證且已登錄之產品
questions.b_zh: 已完成資訊申報網站登錄之產品
questions.c_zh: 已取得型式驗證合格之產品
questions.d_zh: 資訊申報網站登錄逾期或型式驗證逾期之產品
questions.q_en: Under Article 9, which product may NOT bear a safety label or certification mark?
questions.a_en: A product legally exempt from certification and already registered
questions.b_en: A product that has completed website registration
questions.c_en: A product that has passed type certification
questions.d_en: A product whose website registration or type certification has expired
questions.explain_zh: 第9條第1項：對於未完成資訊申報網站登錄、未取得型式驗證合格、登錄逾期或型式驗證逾期之產品，不得使用安全標示、驗證合格標章或易生混淆之類似標示。
questions.explain_en: Article 9(1): safety labels, conformity marks or confusingly similar marks shall not be used on products that have not completed registration, have not passed type certification, or whose registration or certification has expired.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第10條，雇主對於具有危害性之化學品，應辦理下列何者？
questions.c_zh: 標示、製備清單及揭示安全資料表，並採取必要之通識措施
questions.q_en: Under Article 10, for hazardous chemicals the employer shall:
questions.a_en: Simply lock them in a warehouse
questions.c_en: Label them, prepare an inventory, make safety data sheets available and take necessary hazard communication measures
questions.explain_zh: 第10條第1項：雇主對於具有危害性之化學品，應予標示、製備清單及揭示安全資料表，並採取必要之通識措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 10(1): the employer shall label hazardous chemicals, prepare an inventory, make safety data sheets available and take necessary hazard communication measures.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 製造者、輸入者或供應者提供危害性化學品予事業單位前，應辦理何事？資料異動時如何處理？
questions.a_zh: 僅需附發票；異動免處理
questions.c_zh: 予以標示及提供安全資料表；資料異動時亦同
questions.q_en: Before providing hazardous chemicals to an enterprise, what must manufacturers, importers or suppliers do, and what about when the information changes?
questions.a_en: Only attach an invoice; no action for changes
questions.c_en: Label them and provide safety data sheets; the same applies when information changes
questions.explain_zh: 第10條第2項：製造者、輸入者或供應者，提供化學品與事業單位或自營作業者前，應予標示及提供安全資料表；資料異動時，亦同。
questions.explain_en: Article 10(2): before providing chemicals to an enterprise or self-employed person, they shall label the chemicals and provide safety data sheets; the same applies when the information changes.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第11條，雇主對危害性化學品應依何種情形評估風險等級並採取分級管理措施？
questions.a_zh: 保存期限及供應商信用
questions.d_zh: 健康危害、散布狀況及使用量
questions.q_en: Under Article 11, based on what factors shall the employer assess the risk level of hazardous chemicals and adopt graded management?
questions.d_en: Health hazards, dispersion conditions and quantity used
questions.explain_zh: 第11條第1項：雇主對於前條之化學品，應依其健康危害、散布狀況及使用量等情形，評估風險等級，並採取分級管理措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 11(1): the employer shall assess the risk level based on health hazards, dispersion conditions and quantity used, and adopt graded management measures.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 對於中央主管機關定有容許暴露標準之作業場所，雇主應確保勞工之危害暴露如何？
questions.q_en: For operation sites with permissible exposure limits set by the central competent authority, the employer shall ensure laborers' hazard exposure is:
questions.explain_zh: 第12條第1項：雇主對於中央主管機關定有容許暴露標準之作業場所，應確保勞工之危害暴露低於標準值。
questions.explain_en: Article 12(1): the employer shall ensure that laborers' hazard exposure is below the permissible exposure limit.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第12條第3項，雇主對經中央主管機關指定之作業場所，應訂定何種計畫並由何者實施監測？
questions.a_zh: 緊急應變計畫；由消防局實施
questions.b_zh: 品質管理計畫；由品管部門實施
questions.c_zh: 年度預算計畫；由財務部門實施
questions.d_zh: 作業環境監測計畫；由認可之作業環境監測機構實施
questions.q_en: Under Article 12(3), for operation sites designated by the central competent authority, the employer shall formulate what plan, and who conducts the monitoring?
questions.a_en: An emergency response plan; by the fire department
questions.b_en: A quality management plan; by the QC department
questions.c_en: An annual budget plan; by the finance department
questions.d_en: A workplace environment monitoring plan; monitoring by an approved workplace environment monitoring institution
questions.explain_zh: 第12條第3項：應訂定作業環境監測計畫，並設置或委託由中央主管機關認可之作業環境監測機構實施監測。指定免經監測機構分析之項目得僱用合格監測人員辦理。
questions.explain_en: Article 12(3): the employer shall formulate a workplace environment monitoring plan and establish or commission a monitoring institution approved by the central competent authority to conduct the monitoring.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主對作業環境監測計畫及監測結果，應如何處理？
questions.d_zh: 公開揭示，並通報中央主管機關
questions.q_en: How shall the employer handle the workplace environment monitoring plan and results?
questions.a_en: Hand them to the union only
questions.d_en: Publicly disclose them and report to the central competent authority
questions.explain_zh: 第12條第4項：雇主對於監測計畫及監測結果，應公開揭示，並通報中央主管機關。中央主管機關或勞動檢查機構得實施查核。
questions.explain_en: Article 12(4): the employer shall publicly disclose the monitoring plan and results and report them to the central competent authority, which may conduct audits.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 製造者或輸入者對於化學物質清單以外之「新化學物質」，於製造或輸入前應完成何事？
questions.c_zh: 向中央主管機關繳交化學物質安全評估報告，並經核准登記
questions.q_en: Before manufacturing or importing a 'new chemical substance' not on the chemical substance inventory, a manufacturer or importer shall:
questions.c_en: Submit a chemical substance safety assessment report to the central competent authority and obtain approved registration
questions.explain_zh: 第13條第1項：對於中央主管機關公告之化學物質清單以外之新化學物質，未向中央主管機關繳交化學物質安全評估報告，並經核准登記前，不得製造或輸入含有該物質之化學品。
questions.explain_en: Article 13(1): chemicals containing a new chemical substance shall not be manufactured or imported until a safety assessment report has been submitted and registration approved.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第14條第1項，對於經中央主管機關指定之「管制性化學品」，原則上如何？
questions.a_zh: 不得製造、輸入、供應或供工作者處置、使用，但經中央主管機關許可者不在此限
questions.q_en: Under Article 14(1), what is the rule for 'controlled chemicals' designated by the central competent authority?
questions.a_en: They shall not be manufactured, imported, supplied or handled/used by workers, unless permitted by the central competent authority
questions.c_en: Filing a report alone permits use
questions.explain_zh: 第14條第1項：對於經中央主管機關指定之管制性化學品，不得製造、輸入、供應或供工作者處置、使用。但經中央主管機關許可者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 14(1): controlled chemicals shall not be manufactured, imported, supplied or handled/used by workers unless permitted by the central competent authority.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 對於中央主管機關指定之「優先管理化學品」，製造者、輸入者、供應者或雇主應如何辦理？
questions.a_zh: 將相關運作資料報請中央主管機關備查
questions.b_zh: 報請地方消防機關核准
questions.q_en: For 'priority management chemicals' designated by the central competent authority, manufacturers, importers, suppliers or employers shall:
questions.a_en: Report the relevant operation data to the central competent authority for record
questions.b_en: Apply for approval from the local fire authority
questions.explain_zh: 第14條第2項：對於中央主管機關指定之優先管理化學品，應將相關運作資料報請中央主管機關備查。
questions.explain_en: Article 14(2): relevant operation data of priority management chemicals shall be reported to the central competent authority for record.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第15條，下列何種工作場所應定期實施製程安全評估並製作報告？
questions.a_zh: 從事石油裂解之石化工業
questions.q_en: Under Article 15, which workplace shall periodically conduct process safety assessment and prepare a report?
questions.a_en: Petrochemical industry engaged in petroleum cracking
questions.explain_zh: 第15條第1項：從事石油裂解之石化工業，及從事製造、處置或使用危害性化學品數量達規定量以上之工作場所，應依規定期限定期實施製程安全評估，製作報告並採取必要之預防措施；製程修改時亦同。
questions.explain_en: Article 15(1): petrochemical plants engaged in petroleum cracking, and workplaces manufacturing, handling or using hazardous chemicals above the prescribed quantity, shall periodically conduct process safety assessment, prepare reports and take preventive measures; the same applies when the process is modified.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 製程安全評估報告，事業單位應報請何機關備查？
questions.q_en: To which agency shall the enterprise submit the process safety assessment report for record?
questions.explain_zh: 第15條第2項：前項製程安全評估報告，事業單位應報請勞動檢查機構備查。
questions.explain_en: Article 15(2): the process safety assessment report shall be submitted to the labor inspection agency for record.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第15條之1，事業單位將一定規模以上之工程交付規劃、設計時，應辦理下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 分析潛在施工危害，編製安全衛生圖說及規範，量化編列安全衛生費用，並製作工程規劃設計安全分析報告
questions.d_zh: 僅需向勞動檢查機構報備
questions.q_en: Under Article 15-1, when an enterprise commissions planning and design of a construction project above a certain scale, it shall:
questions.a_en: Analyze potential construction hazards, prepare safety and health drawings and specifications, quantify safety and health costs, and prepare a construction planning and design safety analysis report
questions.d_en: Only notify the labor inspection agency
questions.explain_zh: 第15條之1第1項：應依其工程特性，分析潛在施工危害，編製安全衛生圖說及規範，量化編列安全衛生費用，並製作工程規劃設計安全分析報告。
questions.explain_en: Article 15-1(1): based on the project characteristics, analyze potential construction hazards, prepare safety and health drawings and specifications, quantify safety and health costs, and prepare a planning and design safety analysis report.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第15條之1第2項，事業單位將工程交付施工時，應使施工者事前依工程規劃設計安全分析報告做什麼？
questions.b_zh: 評估施工風險，採取必要預防設備及措施，納入施工計畫書並確實執行
questions.c_zh: 將報告轉交監造單位即可
questions.q_en: Under Article 15-1(2), when commissioning construction, the enterprise shall require the contractor, based on the safety analysis report, to:
questions.b_en: Assess construction risks, adopt necessary preventive equipment and measures, incorporate them into the construction plan and implement them
questions.c_en: Forward the report to the supervising unit
questions.d_en: Merely read and sign the report
questions.explain_zh: 第15條之1第2項：應使該施工者於事前依工程規劃設計安全分析報告，評估施工風險，採取必要之預防設備及措施，納入施工計畫書，並確實執行。第3項：事業單位應指派人員或委託專業機構監督及查證。
questions.explain_en: Article 15-1(2): the contractor shall assess construction risks in advance based on the report, adopt necessary preventive equipment and measures, incorporate them into the construction plan and implement them; under paragraph 3 the enterprise shall assign personnel or a professional body to supervise and verify.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 經中央主管機關指定具有危險性之機械或設備，須經何者檢查合格始得使用？
questions.a_zh: 勞動檢查機構或中央主管機關指定之代行檢查機構
questions.q_en: Designated dangerous machinery or equipment may be used only after passing inspection by:
questions.a_en: The labor inspection agency or an agent inspection institution designated by the central competent authority
questions.explain_zh: 第16條第1項：非經勞動檢查機構或中央主管機關指定之代行檢查機構檢查合格，不得使用；其使用超過規定期間者，非經再檢查合格，不得繼續使用。
questions.explain_en: Article 16(1): they shall not be used unless inspected and passed by the labor inspection agency or a designated agent inspection institution; after the prescribed period, re-inspection is required.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 勞工工作場所之建築物，應由何人依建築法規及本法安全衛生規定設計？
questions.d_zh: 依法登記開業之建築師
questions.q_en: Buildings used as laborers' workplaces shall be designed by whom, in accordance with building regulations and the safety and health provisions of the Act?
questions.a_en: An occupational safety and health administrator
questions.explain_zh: 第17條：勞工工作場所之建築物，應由依法登記開業之建築師依建築法規及本法有關安全衛生之規定設計。
questions.explain_en: Article 17: buildings of laborers' workplaces shall be designed by a legally registered practicing architect in accordance with building regulations and the safety and health provisions of the Act.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 工作場所有立即發生危險之虞時，雇主或工作場所負責人應如何處置？
questions.a_zh: 即令停止作業，並使勞工退避至安全場所
questions.b_zh: 等待勞動檢查機構到場後再處理
questions.c_zh: 要求勞工加快完成工作
questions.d_zh: 僅需口頭提醒勞工小心
questions.q_en: When there is an imminent danger in the workplace, the employer or workplace manager shall:
questions.a_en: Immediately order work to stop and have laborers withdraw to a safe place
questions.b_en: Wait for the labor inspection agency to arrive
questions.c_en: Ask laborers to finish the work faster
questions.d_en: Only verbally remind laborers to be careful
questions.explain_zh: 第18條第1項：工作場所有立即發生危險之虞時，雇主或工作場所負責人應即令停止作業，並使勞工退避至安全場所。
questions.explain_en: Article 18(1): when there is an imminent danger in the workplace, the employer or workplace manager shall immediately order work to stop and have laborers withdraw to a safe place.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 勞工執行職務發現有立即發生危險之虞時，得自行停止作業退避，並應如何處理？
questions.a_zh: 逕行離開公司不必通知
questions.c_zh: 三日內以書面通知雇主
questions.q_en: When a laborer discovers an imminent danger while performing duties and stops work to withdraw, the laborer shall also:
questions.c_en: Notify the employer in writing within three days
questions.d_en: Immediately report to the direct supervisor
questions.explain_zh: 第18條第2項：勞工執行職務發現有立即發生危險之虞時，得在不危及其他工作者安全情形下，自行停止作業及退避至安全場所，並立即向直屬主管報告。
questions.explain_en: Article 18(2): the laborer may stop work and withdraw to a safe place without endangering other workers, and shall immediately report to the direct supervisor.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 勞工依法自行停止作業退避後，雇主得否對其解僱、調職或不給付停止作業期間工資？
questions.c_zh: 不得，但雇主證明勞工濫用停止作業權，經報主管機關認定並符合勞動法令者不在此限
questions.q_en: After a laborer lawfully stops work and withdraws, may the employer dismiss, transfer or withhold wages for the stoppage period?
questions.a_en: Yes, a demerit and transfer may be imposed
questions.b_en: Yes, the day's wages may be deducted
questions.c_en: No, unless the employer proves abuse of the right, confirmed by the competent authority and compliant with labor laws
questions.explain_zh: 第18條第3項：雇主不得對前項勞工予以解僱、調職、不給付停止作業期間工資或其他不利之處分。但雇主證明勞工濫用停止作業權，經報主管機關認定，並符合勞動法令規定者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 18(3): the employer shall not dismiss, transfer, withhold wages or impose other adverse treatment, unless the employer proves the laborer abused the right, as confirmed by the competent authority and in compliance with labor laws.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 在高溫場所工作之勞工，雇主不得使其每日工作時間超過幾小時？
questions.q_en: For laborers working in high-temperature workplaces, the employer shall not make them work more than how many hours per day?
questions.explain_zh: 第19條第1項：在高溫場所工作之勞工，雇主不得使其每日工作時間超過六小時。
questions.explain_en: Article 19(1): laborers working in high-temperature workplaces shall not work more than six hours per day.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第19條，下列何種作業應規定減少勞工工作時間並在工作時間中予以適當休息？
questions.c_zh: 異常氣壓作業、高架作業、精密作業、重體力勞動
questions.q_en: Under Article 19, which operations require reduced working hours and appropriate rest during working hours?
questions.c_en: Abnormal pressure work, work at height, precision work, heavy physical labor
questions.explain_zh: 第19條第1項：異常氣壓作業、高架作業、精密作業、重體力勞動或其他對於勞工具有特殊危害之作業，亦應規定減少勞工工作時間，並在工作時間中予以適當之休息。
questions.explain_en: Article 19(1): abnormal pressure work, work at height, precision work, heavy physical labor and other work with special hazards shall have reduced working hours and appropriate rest.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第20條，雇主於僱用勞工時應施行何種檢查？
questions.q_en: Under Article 20, what examination shall the employer conduct when hiring a laborer?
questions.explain_zh: 第20條第1項：雇主於僱用勞工時，應施行體格檢查；對在職勞工應施行一般健康檢查、特別危害健康作業之特殊健康檢查及指定之特定對象與特定項目健康檢查。
questions.explain_en: Article 20(1): the employer shall conduct a physical examination upon hiring; for in-service laborers, general health examinations, special health examinations for especially hazardous work, and designated examinations for specific groups/items.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 勞工體格及健康檢查之費用由何人負擔？檢查紀錄由何人保存？
questions.a_zh: 費用由雇主負擔；紀錄由雇主保存
questions.b_zh: 費用由工會負擔；紀錄由工會保存
questions.c_zh: 費用由勞工負擔；紀錄由勞工保存
questions.d_zh: 費用由政府負擔；紀錄由醫院保存
questions.q_en: Who bears the cost of laborers' physical and health examinations, and who keeps the records?
questions.a_en: The employer bears the cost; the employer keeps the records
questions.b_en: The union bears the cost; the union keeps the records
questions.c_en: The laborer bears the cost; the laborer keeps the records
questions.d_en: The government bears the cost; the hospital keeps the records
questions.explain_zh: 第20條第2項：檢查應由認可之醫療機構之醫師為之；檢查紀錄雇主應予保存，並負擔健康檢查費用。
questions.explain_en: Article 20(2): examinations shall be performed by physicians of approved medical institutions; the employer shall keep the records and bear the cost.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 實施特殊健康檢查時，雇主應提供何種資料予醫療機構？
questions.d_zh: 勞工作業內容及暴露情形等作業經歷資料
questions.q_en: When conducting special health examinations, what information shall the employer provide to the medical institution?
questions.d_en: Work history data such as job content and exposure conditions
questions.explain_zh: 第20條第2項：實施特殊健康檢查時，雇主應提供勞工作業內容及暴露情形等作業經歷資料予醫療機構。
questions.explain_en: Article 20(2): when conducting special health examinations, the employer shall provide the medical institution with the laborer's work history data, including job content and exposure conditions.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 醫療機構對於健康檢查結果，應通報中央主管機關備查；其中一般健康檢查結果之通報範圍為何？
questions.b_zh: 以指定項目發現異常者為限
questions.q_en: Medical institutions shall report health examination results to the central competent authority; what is the scope of reporting for general health examinations?
questions.b_en: Limited to abnormal findings in designated items
questions.explain_zh: 第20條第4項：醫療機構對於健康檢查之結果，應通報中央主管機關備查。但一般健康檢查結果之通報，以指定項目發現異常者為限。
questions.explain_en: Article 20(4): results shall be reported to the central competent authority, but for general health examinations only abnormal findings in designated items are reported.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 勞工對於雇主依法安排之體格及健康檢查，有無接受之義務？
questions.q_en: Is a laborer obliged to undergo the physical and health examinations lawfully arranged by the employer?
questions.b_en: No, the laborer may freely decline
questions.c_en: Yes, the laborer is obliged to undergo them
questions.explain_zh: 第20條第6項：勞工對於第一項之檢查，有接受之義務。
questions.explain_en: Article 20(6): laborers are obliged to undergo the examinations under paragraph 1.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 健康檢查發現勞工經醫師健康評估不能適應原有工作時，雇主應如何處理？
questions.a_zh: 參採醫師建議，變更其作業場所、更換工作或縮短工作時間，並採取健康管理措施
questions.d_zh: 要求勞工自費治療後再上班
questions.q_en: When a health examination shows that a laborer cannot adapt to the original work according to the physician's assessment, the employer shall:
questions.a_en: Follow the physician's advice to change the operation site, reassign work or shorten working hours, and adopt health management measures
questions.explain_zh: 第21條第1項：經醫師健康評估結果，不能適應原有工作者，應參採醫師之建議，變更其作業場所、更換工作或縮短工作時間，並採取健康管理措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 21(1): the employer shall follow the physician's advice to change the operation site, reassign work or shorten working hours, and adopt health management measures.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主依健康檢查結果彙編之健康檢查手冊，其使用限制為何？
questions.c_zh: 不得作為健康管理目的以外之用途
questions.q_en: What is the restriction on the use of the health examination handbook compiled by the employer?
questions.a_en: It may be provided to insurers for marketing
questions.b_en: It may be used as a reference for layoffs
questions.c_en: It shall not be used for purposes other than health management
questions.d_en: It may be used for performance appraisal
questions.explain_zh: 第21條第2項：雇主應依檢查結果及個人健康注意事項，彙編成健康檢查手冊，發給勞工，並不得作為健康管理目的以外之用途。
questions.explain_en: Article 21(2): the employer shall compile a health examination handbook and issue it to the laborer; it shall not be used for purposes other than health management.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數達多少人以上，應置勞工健康服務人員或委託勞工健康服務專業機構？
questions.q_en: An enterprise with how many laborers or more shall appoint labor health service personnel or commission a professional labor health service institution?
questions.explain_zh: 第22條第1項：事業單位勞工人數在五十人以上者，應置勞工健康服務人員或委託勞工健康服務專業機構，辦理健康管理、職業病與工作相關疾病之預防及健康促進等事項。
questions.explain_en: Article 22(1): enterprises with 50 or more laborers shall appoint labor health service personnel or commission a professional institution for health management, prevention of occupational and work-related diseases, and health promotion.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法所稱「職場霸凌」，其行為特徵不包括下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 持續以冒犯、威脅、冷落、孤立、侮辱等言行
questions.b_zh: 逾越業務上必要且合理範圍
questions.c_zh: 利用職務或權勢等關係
questions.d_zh: 依規定進行之正常工作考核
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of 'workplace bullying' under the Act?
questions.a_en: Persistent offensive, threatening, isolating or insulting words or conduct
questions.b_en: Exceeding the necessary and reasonable scope of business
questions.d_en: Normal work performance evaluation conducted according to rules
questions.explain_zh: 第22條之1第1項：職場霸凌指勞工於勞動場所執行職務，因其事業單位人員利用職務或權勢等關係，逾越業務上必要且合理範圍，持續以冒犯、威脅、冷落、孤立、侮辱或其他不當之言詞或行為，致其身心健康遭受危害。但情節重大者，不以持續發生為必要。
questions.explain_en: Article 22-1(1): workplace bullying means enterprise personnel exploiting position or power, exceeding the necessary and reasonable scope of business, persistently harming a laborer's physical or mental health through offensive, threatening, isolating, insulting or other improper conduct; for serious cases persistence is not required.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 僱用勞工人數在幾人以上者，應訂定職場霸凌申訴管道並在工作場所公開揭示？
questions.q_en: An employer with how many laborers or more shall establish workplace bullying complaint channels and publicly post them in the workplace?
questions.explain_zh: 第22條之1第2項第1款：勞工人數在十人以上者，應訂定職場霸凌申訴管道，並在工作場所公開揭示。
questions.explain_en: Article 22-1(2)(1): employers with 10 or more laborers shall establish workplace bullying complaint channels and publicly post them in the workplace.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 僱用勞工人數在幾人以上者，應訂定職場霸凌防治措施、申訴及懲處規範並公開揭示？
questions.q_en: An employer with how many laborers or more shall formulate workplace bullying prevention measures, complaint and disciplinary rules and publicly post them?
questions.explain_zh: 第22條之1第2項第2款：勞工人數在三十人以上者，應訂定職場霸凌防治措施、申訴及懲處規範，並在工作場所公開揭示。
questions.explain_en: Article 22-1(2)(2): employers with 30 or more laborers shall formulate workplace bullying prevention measures, complaint and disciplinary rules and publicly post them.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主因接獲被霸凌勞工申訴而知悉時，對申訴事件進行調查；申訴人有意願者得予協調，若協調不成立應如何？
questions.q_en: When an employer learns of bullying via a complaint and the complainant is willing to mediate, what happens if mediation fails?
questions.explain_zh: 第22條之2第1項第1款第3目：對申訴事件進行調查；申訴人有意願者，得予協調，如協調不成立時，應續行調查。
questions.explain_en: Article 22-2(1)(1)(iii): the employer shall investigate the complaint; mediation may be conducted if the complainant is willing, and if mediation fails the investigation shall continue.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主僱用勞工人數達一定規模者，處理職場霸凌事件應組成調查小組，其外聘成員比例不得少於多少？
questions.q_en: For employers of a certain scale, an investigation team for workplace bullying shall include externally appointed members of at least what proportion?
questions.explain_zh: 第22條之2第2項：雇主僱用勞工人數達一定規模者，應組成調查小組；其調查小組外聘成員比例不得少於二分之一。
questions.explain_en: Article 22-2(2): employers of a certain scale shall form an investigation team whose externally appointed members shall be no less than one half.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主接獲被霸凌勞工申訴時，應於何處登錄？
questions.a_zh: 中央主管機關指定之網站
questions.q_en: Where shall the employer register upon receiving a workplace bullying complaint?
questions.a_en: The website designated by the central competent authority
questions.explain_zh: 第22條之2第3項：雇主接獲被霸凌勞工申訴時，應於中央主管機關指定之網站登錄；事件之處理結果，亦應於該網站登錄之。
questions.explain_en: Article 22-2(3): upon receiving a bullying complaint the employer shall register it on the website designated by the central competent authority, and the handling result shall also be registered there.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 勞工遭受職場霸凌，原則上應向雇主申訴；若被申訴人為最高負責人時，得向何者申訴？
questions.d_zh: 逕向直轄市或縣（市）主管機關
questions.q_en: A bullied laborer generally complains to the employer; if the respondent is the top person in charge, the laborer may complain to:
questions.d_en: The municipal or county (city) competent authority directly
questions.explain_zh: 第22條之3第1項：勞工遭受職場霸凌，應向雇主提起申訴。但被申訴人為最高負責人時，得逕向直轄市或縣（市）主管機關提起申訴。
questions.explain_en: Article 22-3(1): complaints shall be filed with the employer, but when the respondent is the top person in charge, the laborer may file directly with the municipal or county (city) competent authority.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 勞工向直轄市或縣（市）主管機關提起職場霸凌申訴，自霸凌行為終了時起逾幾年者不予受理？
questions.q_en: A workplace bullying complaint filed with the municipal or county (city) authority will not be accepted if more than how many years have passed since the bullying ended?
questions.explain_zh: 第22條之3第2項：自職場霸凌行為終了時起，逾三年者，不予受理；事件發生時在職者，得於離職之日起一年內申訴，但有較長期限者從其規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 22-3(2): not accepted if more than three years have passed since the bullying ended; a laborer employed at the time may complain within one year of leaving, whichever is longer.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第23條，雇主應依事業單位規模、性質，設置安全衛生組織、人員，並訂定何種計畫？
questions.b_zh: 職業安全衛生管理計畫
questions.q_en: Under Article 23, the employer shall establish safety and health organizations and personnel according to the enterprise's scale and nature, and formulate what plan?
questions.b_en: An occupational safety and health management plan
questions.explain_zh: 第23條第1項：雇主應依其事業單位之規模、性質，設置安全衛生組織、人員；並訂定職業安全衛生管理計畫，實施安全衛生管理及自動檢查。
questions.explain_en: Article 23(1): the employer shall establish safety and health organizations and personnel, formulate an occupational safety and health management plan, and implement safety and health management and self-inspection.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第23條第2項，何種事業單位應建置職業安全衛生管理系統？
questions.a_zh: 達一定規模或有第15條第1項所定工作場所者
questions.q_en: Under Article 23(2), which enterprises shall establish an occupational safety and health management system?
questions.a_en: Those reaching a certain scale or having workplaces defined in Article 15(1)
questions.explain_zh: 第23條第2項：事業單位達一定規模或有第十五條第一項所定之工作場所者，應建置職業安全衛生管理系統。
questions.explain_en: Article 23(2): enterprises reaching a certain scale or having workplaces defined in Article 15(1) shall establish an occupational safety and health management system.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法第23條所定安全衛生管理，應由何人綜理？
questions.d_zh: 雇主、雇主代理人或工作場所負責人
questions.q_en: Who shall have overall charge of the safety and health management under Article 23?
questions.a_en: The occupational safety and health administrator
questions.d_en: The employer, the employer's agent or the workplace manager
questions.explain_zh: 第23條第4項：安全衛生管理應由雇主、雇主代理人或工作場所負責人綜理，並由事業單位各級主管依其職責指揮、監督所屬人員執行。
questions.explain_en: Article 23(4): safety and health management shall be under the overall charge of the employer, the employer's agent or the workplace manager, with supervisors at all levels directing and supervising their subordinates.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 具有危險性機械或設備之操作人員，雇主應僱用何種人員充任？
questions.a_zh: 由承攬商指派之任何人
questions.c_zh: 經中央主管機關認可之教育訓練或經技能檢定之合格人員
questions.q_en: Operators of dangerous machinery or equipment shall be:
questions.c_en: Qualified persons who have completed training approved by the central competent authority or passed skills certification
questions.explain_zh: 第24條第1項：危險性機械或設備及其他特定機械之操作人員，雇主應僱用經中央主管機關認可之教育訓練或經技能檢定之合格人員充任之。
questions.explain_en: Article 24(1): the employer shall employ persons who have completed approved education and training or passed skills certification to operate dangerous machinery or equipment and other specified machinery.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位以其事業招人承攬時，承攬人就承攬部分負何種責任？原事業單位就職業災害補償如何？
questions.a_zh: 承攬人負雇主責任；原事業單位與承攬人負連帶責任
questions.c_zh: 承攬人負全責；原事業單位無責任
questions.d_zh: 承攬人無責任；原事業單位負全責
questions.q_en: When an enterprise contracts out its business, what responsibility does the contractor bear, and how about the original enterprise regarding occupational accident compensation?
questions.a_en: The contractor bears the employer's responsibility; the original enterprise is jointly and severally liable with the contractor
questions.c_en: The contractor bears full responsibility; the original enterprise has none
questions.d_en: The contractor has none; the original enterprise bears full responsibility
questions.explain_zh: 第25條第1項：承攬人就承攬部分負本法所定雇主之責任；原事業單位就職業災害補償仍應與承攬人負連帶責任。再承攬者亦同。
questions.explain_en: Article 25(1): the contractor bears the employer's responsibility for the contracted part; the original enterprise remains jointly and severally liable with the contractor for occupational accident compensation; the same applies to subcontractors.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 原事業單位違反本法或安全衛生規定，致承攬人所僱勞工發生職業災害時，應負何種責任？
questions.c_zh: 與承攬人負連帶賠償責任
questions.q_en: If the original enterprise violates the Act or safety and health regulations, causing an occupational accident to a contractor's laborer, it shall:
questions.a_en: Bear only half of the compensation
questions.c_en: Be jointly and severally liable for damages with the contractor
questions.explain_zh: 第25條第2項：原事業單位違反本法或有關安全衛生規定，致承攬人所僱勞工發生職業災害時，與承攬人負連帶賠償責任。再承攬者亦同。
questions.explain_en: Article 25(2): the original enterprise is jointly and severally liable for damages with the contractor; the same applies to subcontractors.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位以其事業交付承攬時，應於事前辦理何事？
questions.b_zh: 僅需口頭交代注意安全
questions.d_zh: 就交付承攬之事業實施風險評估，將工作環境、危害因素與應採取之安全衛生設備及措施等評估結果告知承攬人
questions.q_en: Before contracting out its business, an enterprise shall:
questions.a_en: Merely sign the contract and pay
questions.b_en: Merely tell the contractor verbally to be careful
questions.d_en: Conduct a risk assessment of the contracted business and inform the contractor of the work environment, hazard factors and required safety and health equipment and measures
questions.explain_zh: 第26條第1項：應於事前就交付承攬之事業實施風險評估，將有關工作環境、危害因素與應採取之安全衛生設備及措施等評估結果告知該承攬人，並於承攬期間使承攬人依評估結果確實執行。
questions.explain_en: Article 26(1): the enterprise shall conduct a risk assessment in advance and inform the contractor of the assessment results including work environment, hazard factors and required safety and health equipment and measures, and ensure implementation during the contract period.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位將其工作場所、設備出租或出借他人使用時，應於事前告知何事？
questions.a_zh: 場所、設備危害因素及安全衛生相關注意事項
questions.q_en: When an enterprise leases or lends its workplace or equipment to others, it shall inform in advance of:
questions.a_en: The hazard factors of the site and equipment and related safety and health precautions
questions.explain_zh: 第26條第3項：事業單位將其工作場所、設備出租或出借他人使用時，應於事前告知其場所、設備危害因素及安全衛生相關注意事項。
questions.explain_en: Article 26(3): the enterprise shall inform in advance of the hazard factors of the site and equipment and related safety and health precautions.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位與承攬人、再承攬人之工作者共同作業時，原事業單位應設置何種組織並指定何人？
questions.a_zh: 設置董事會，並指定董事長
questions.b_zh: 設置工會，並指定理事長
questions.c_zh: 設置品管圈，並指定圈長
questions.d_zh: 設置協議組織，並指定工作場所負責人
questions.q_en: When working jointly with contractors' and subcontractors' workers, the original enterprise shall set up what organization and designate whom?
questions.a_en: Set up a board and designate its chairman
questions.b_en: Set up a union and designate its chairperson
questions.c_en: Set up a QC circle and designate its leader
questions.d_en: Set up a coordination organization and designate a workplace manager
questions.explain_zh: 第27條第1項第1款：設置協議組織，並指定工作場所負責人，擔任指揮、監督及協調之工作。
questions.explain_en: Article 27(1)(1): set up a coordination organization and designate a workplace manager to direct, supervise and coordinate.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 下列何者不是本法第27條第1項原事業單位於共同作業時應採取之必要措施？
questions.a_zh: 代承攬人投保勞工保險
questions.d_zh: 機械、設備、器具及人員之進場管制
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT a required measure of the original enterprise during joint operations under Article 27(1)?
questions.a_en: Enrolling the contractor's workers in labor insurance
questions.d_en: Entry control of machinery, equipment, tools and personnel
questions.explain_zh: 第27條第1項六款：設置協議組織並指定工作場所負責人、工作之連繫及調整、工作場所之巡視、相關承攬人安全衛生教育訓練之指導及協助、機械設備器具及人員之進場管制、其他為防止職業災害之必要事項。
questions.explain_en: Article 27(1) lists six items: coordination organization and workplace manager, liaison and adjustment of work, workplace patrol, guidance on contractors' safety and health training, entry control of machinery/equipment/tools/personnel, and other necessary accident prevention matters.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位分別交付二個以上承攬人共同作業而未參與共同作業時，應如何處理？
questions.b_zh: 由勞動檢查機構指定負責人
questions.c_zh: 指定承攬人之一負原事業單位之責任
questions.q_en: When an enterprise separately contracts two or more contractors for joint operations without participating itself, it shall:
questions.b_en: Have the labor inspection agency designate a person in charge
questions.c_en: Designate one of the contractors to bear the original enterprise's responsibilities
questions.d_en: Let each contractor be responsible for itself
questions.explain_zh: 第27條第2項：事業單位分別交付二個以上承攬人共同作業而未參與共同作業時，應指定承攬人之一負前項原事業單位之責任。
questions.explain_en: Article 27(2): the enterprise shall designate one of the contractors to bear the responsibilities of the original enterprise.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位將一定規模以上之工程交付二個以上施工者施工時，應指定施工者之一負何種責任？
questions.a_zh: 整體工程安全衛生統合管理責任
questions.q_en: When a project above a certain scale is contracted to two or more contractors, the enterprise shall designate one contractor to bear:
questions.a_en: Overall project safety and health integrated management responsibility
questions.c_en: Responsibility for collecting and paying project funds
questions.explain_zh: 第27條之1第1項：應指定施工者之一負整體工程安全衛生統合管理責任；經指定之施工者應執行整體工程安全衛生統合管理事項。
questions.explain_en: Article 27-1(1): one of the contractors shall be designated to bear overall project safety and health integrated management responsibility and shall carry out the integrated management matters.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 二個以上之事業單位分別出資共同承攬工程時，應如何處理雇主責任？
questions.c_zh: 互推一人為代表人，視為該工程之事業雇主
questions.q_en: When two or more enterprises jointly fund and contract a project, how is the employer's responsibility handled?
questions.a_en: The labor inspection agency designates one
questions.c_en: They elect one representative who is deemed the project's employer
questions.explain_zh: 第28條：二個以上之事業單位分別出資共同承攬工程時，應互推一人為代表人；該代表人視為該工程之事業雇主，負本法雇主防止職業災害之責任。
questions.explain_en: Article 28: they shall elect a representative who is deemed the employer of the project and bears the employer's responsibility for preventing occupational accidents.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第29條，雇主不得使未滿十八歲者從事下列何種工作？
questions.d_zh: 超過二百二十伏特電力線之銜接
questions.q_en: Under Article 29, employers shall not assign persons under 18 to which work?
questions.explain_zh: 第29條第1項第7款：超過二百二十伏特電力線之銜接。其他禁止項目包括坑內工作、處理爆炸性易燃性物質、有害物散布場所、鍋爐燒火及操作、起重機運轉等。
questions.explain_en: Article 29(1)(7): connecting power lines exceeding 220 volts. Other prohibited items include underground work, handling explosive or flammable substances, harmful substance dispersion sites, boiler firing and operation, and crane operation.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 下列何者不屬本法第29條禁止未滿十八歲者從事之工作？
questions.d_zh: 起重機、人字臂起重桿之運轉工作
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT prohibited for persons under 18 under Article 29?
questions.explain_zh: 第29條第1項列舉十五款危險性或有害性工作，包括坑內工作、鍋爐燒火及操作、起重機運轉等；辦公室影印不在其列。
questions.explain_en: Article 29(1) lists 15 dangerous or harmful jobs including underground work, boiler operation and crane operation; office photocopying is not among them.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第30條第1項，雇主不得使妊娠中之女性勞工從事下列何種工作？
questions.q_en: Under Article 30(1), employers shall not assign pregnant female laborers to which work?
questions.explain_zh: 第30條第1項第3款：異常氣壓之工作。其他包括礦坑工作、鉛及其化合物散布場所、弓形蟲德國麻疹暴露、指定危害性化學品、顯著振動、重物處理、有害輻射等。
questions.explain_en: Article 30(1)(3): work under abnormal pressure. Others include mining, lead dispersion sites, exposure to toxoplasma or rubella, designated hazardous chemicals, significant vibration, heavy lifting and harmful radiation.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第30條第2項，雇主不得使分娩後未滿一年之女性勞工從事下列何種工作？
questions.d_zh: 鑿岩機及其他有顯著振動之工作
questions.q_en: Under Article 30(2), employers shall not assign female laborers within one year after childbirth to which work?
questions.d_en: Rock drilling and other work with significant vibration
questions.explain_zh: 第30條第2項五款：礦坑工作、鉛及其化合物散布場所之工作、鑿岩機及其他有顯著振動之工作、一定重量以上之重物處理工作、其他經中央主管機關規定之工作。
questions.explain_en: Article 30(2) lists five items: mining, lead dispersion sites, rock drilling and other significant vibration work, heavy lifting above a certain weight, and other work designated by the central competent authority.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法第30條第1項第5款至第14款及第2項第3款至第5款所定工作，於何種條件下雇主得使妊娠中或分娩後未滿一年之女性勞工從事？
questions.b_zh: 雇主依第31條採取母性健康保護措施，經當事人書面同意
questions.q_en: Under what condition may pregnant or postpartum (within one year) female laborers perform the work listed in Article 30(1)(5)-(14) and 30(2)(3)-(5)?
questions.b_en: The employer adopts maternal health protection measures under Article 31 and obtains the laborer's written consent
questions.c_en: Approval by the labor inspection agency
questions.explain_zh: 第30條第3項：第一項第五款至第十四款及前項第三款至第五款所定之工作，雇主依第三十一條採取母性健康保護措施，經當事人書面同意者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 30(3): such work is allowed if the employer adopts maternal health protection measures under Article 31 and the laborer gives written consent.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主未經當事人告知妊娠或分娩事實而違反第30條規定者，處罰如何？
questions.a_zh: 得免予處罰，但雇主明知或可得而知者不在此限
questions.q_en: If the employer violates Article 30 without having been informed by the laborer of the pregnancy or childbirth, what is the penalty?
questions.a_en: The employer may be exempted, unless the employer knew or could have known
questions.explain_zh: 第30條第5項：雇主未經當事人告知妊娠或分娩事實而違反第一項或第二項規定者，得免予處罰。但雇主明知或可得而知者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 30(5): the employer may be exempted from penalty if not informed of the pregnancy or childbirth, unless the employer knew or could have known.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第31條，中央主管機關指定之事業，雇主對有母性健康危害之虞之工作應採取何種措施？
questions.b_zh: 一律禁止女性勞工任職
questions.d_zh: 危害評估、控制及分級管理措施；並依醫師適性評估建議採取工作調整或更換等健康保護措施
questions.q_en: Under Article 31, for work with potential maternal health hazards in designated enterprises, the employer shall:
questions.d_en: Conduct hazard assessment, control and graded management; and based on the physician's fitness assessment, adjust or reassign work and keep records
questions.explain_zh: 第31條第1項：應對有母性健康危害之虞之工作，採取危害評估、控制及分級管理措施；對於妊娠中或分娩後未滿一年之女性勞工，應依醫師適性評估建議，採取工作調整或更換等健康保護措施，並留存紀錄。
questions.explain_en: Article 31(1): the employer shall conduct hazard assessment, control and graded management; for pregnant or postpartum (within one year) laborers, adjust or reassign work according to the physician's fitness assessment and keep records.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主對勞工應施以何種教育訓練？勞工有無接受義務？
questions.a_zh: 僅需語言訓練；勞工可拒絕
questions.b_zh: 從事工作及預防災變所必要之安全衛生教育訓練；勞工有接受之義務
questions.d_zh: 僅需技術訓練；勞工可拒絕
questions.q_en: What education and training shall the employer provide, and is the laborer obliged to attend?
questions.a_en: Language training only; laborers may refuse
questions.b_en: Safety and health education and training necessary for the work and disaster prevention; laborers are obliged to attend
questions.d_en: Technical training only; laborers may refuse
questions.explain_zh: 第32條第1項：雇主對勞工應施以從事工作及預防災變所必要之安全衛生教育訓練。第4項：勞工對於第一項之安全衛生教育訓練，有接受之義務。
questions.explain_en: Article 32(1): the employer shall provide safety and health education and training necessary for the work and for disaster prevention; paragraph 4: laborers are obliged to attend.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 本法第32條之安全衛生教育訓練，得由何者辦理？
questions.a_zh: 雇主自行辦理或交由中央主管機關認可之機關（構）、學校、團體等訓練單位辦理
questions.q_en: Who may conduct the safety and health education and training under Article 32?
questions.a_en: The employer itself, or training institutions such as agencies, schools or organizations approved by the central competent authority
questions.explain_zh: 第32條第2項：前項安全衛生教育訓練，應由雇主自行辦理或交由中央主管機關認可之機關（構）、學校、團體等訓練單位辦理。
questions.explain_en: Article 32(2): training shall be conducted by the employer itself or entrusted to training units approved by the central competent authority.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第33條，雇主應負責宣導本法及有關安全衛生之規定，目的為何？
questions.q_en: Under Article 33, the employer shall be responsible for promoting the Act and related safety and health regulations in order to:
questions.d_en: Make them known to all laborers
questions.explain_zh: 第33條：雇主應負責宣導本法及有關安全衛生之規定，使勞工周知。
questions.explain_en: Article 33: the employer shall promote the Act and related safety and health regulations so that laborers are well informed.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主訂定安全衛生工作守則，應會同何人訂定？並報請何機關備查後公告實施？
questions.a_zh: 會同律師訂定；報經法院備查
questions.b_zh: 會同勞工代表訂定；報經勞動檢查機構備查
questions.c_zh: 會同會計師訂定；報經稅務機關備查
questions.d_zh: 會同股東訂定；報經經濟部備查
questions.q_en: With whom shall the employer formulate the safety and health work rules, and to which agency shall they be submitted for record before announcement?
questions.a_en: With lawyers; submitted to the court
questions.b_en: With laborer representatives; submitted to the labor inspection agency
questions.c_en: With accountants; submitted to the tax authority
questions.d_en: With shareholders; submitted to the Ministry of Economic Affairs
questions.explain_zh: 第34條第1項：雇主應依本法及有關規定會同勞工代表訂定適合其需要之安全衛生工作守則，報經勞動檢查機構備查後，公告實施。勞工應切實遵行。
questions.explain_en: Article 34(1): the employer shall formulate safety and health work rules together with laborer representatives, submit them to the labor inspection agency for record, then announce and implement them; laborers shall comply.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 中央主管機關召開職業安全衛生諮詢會，其成員之任一性別不得少於多少？
questions.q_en: In the Occupational Safety and Health Advisory Committee convened by the central competent authority, members of either gender shall be no less than:
questions.explain_zh: 第35條：職業安全衛生諮詢會研議國家職業安全衛生政策並提出建議；其成員之任一性別不得少於三分之一。
questions.explain_en: Article 35: the advisory committee deliberates national OSH policy; members of either gender shall be no less than one third.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 勞動檢查機構檢查發現不合規定，經通知限期改善屆期未改善，得如何處理？停工期間工資如何？
questions.b_zh: 得通知部分或全部停工；停工期間應由雇主照給工資
questions.c_zh: 得逕行拆除設備；停工期間不給工資
questions.q_en: If non-compliance is found and not corrected within the deadline, what may the labor inspection agency do, and what about wages during the stoppage?
questions.b_en: Order partial or complete work stoppage; the employer shall continue paying wages during the stoppage
questions.c_en: Demolish the equipment; no wages during stoppage
questions.explain_zh: 第36條第1項：其有不合規定者，應告知違反法令條款，並通知限期改善；屆期未改善或已發生職業災害，或有發生職業災害之虞時，得通知其部分或全部停工。勞工於停工期間應由雇主照給工資。
questions.explain_en: Article 36(1): the agency may order partial or complete work stoppage if not corrected within the deadline or if an accident has occurred or is likely; the employer shall continue paying wages during the stoppage.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位工作場所發生職業災害，雇主應即採取急救、搶救等措施，並會同何人實施調查、分析及作成紀錄？
questions.q_en: When an occupational accident occurs, the employer shall take first aid and rescue measures and, together with whom, investigate, analyze and record it?
questions.explain_zh: 第37條第1項：事業單位工作場所發生職業災害，雇主應即採取必要之急救、搶救等措施，並會同勞工代表實施調查、分析及作成紀錄。
questions.explain_en: Article 37(1): the employer shall immediately take first aid and rescue measures and, together with laborer representatives, investigate, analyze and record the accident.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位勞動場所發生死亡災害時，雇主應於幾小時內通報勞動檢查機構？
questions.q_en: When a fatal accident occurs at the labor site, the employer shall report to the labor inspection agency within how many hours?
questions.explain_zh: 第37條第2項：發生死亡災害、罹災人數三人以上、罹災一人以上且需住院治療、其他指定災害，雇主應於八小時內通報勞動檢查機構。
questions.explain_en: Article 37(2): for fatal accidents, accidents with three or more victims, accidents with one or more victims requiring hospitalization, or other designated accidents, the employer shall report within 8 hours.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 下列何種職業災害不屬於本法第37條第2項雇主應於八小時內通報之情形？
questions.a_zh: 罹災人數一人以上且需住院治療
questions.d_zh: 一人輕微擦傷經現場包紮即返回工作
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT an accident requiring reporting within 8 hours under Article 37(2)?
questions.a_en: One or more victims requiring hospitalization
questions.d_en: One minor abrasion treated on site with return to work
questions.explain_zh: 第37條第2項四款：死亡災害、罹災人數三人以上、罹災一人以上且需住院治療、其他經中央主管機關指定公告之災害。輕微擦傷不需住院者不在通報範圍。
questions.explain_en: Article 37(2) lists: fatal accidents, three or more victims, one or more victims requiring hospitalization, and other designated accidents. A minor abrasion not requiring hospitalization is not reportable.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 事業單位發生應通報之職業災害，除必要之急救、搶救外，雇主非經何者許可不得移動或破壞現場？
questions.d_zh: 司法機關或勞動檢查機構
questions.q_en: After a reportable accident, apart from necessary first aid and rescue, the employer shall not move or damage the scene without permission from:
questions.d_en: The judicial authority or the labor inspection agency
questions.explain_zh: 第37條第4項：事業單位發生第二項之災害，除必要之急救、搶救外，雇主非經司法機關或勞動檢查機構許可，不得移動或破壞現場。
questions.explain_en: Article 37(4): the employer shall not move or damage the scene without permission from the judicial authority or the labor inspection agency, except for necessary first aid and rescue.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 中央主管機關指定之事業，雇主應依規定填載職業災害內容及統計，多久報請勞動檢查機構備查一次？
questions.q_en: For enterprises designated by the central competent authority, how often shall the employer report occupational accident records and statistics to the labor inspection agency?
questions.explain_zh: 第38條：中央主管機關指定之事業，雇主應依規定填載職業災害內容及統計，按月報請勞動檢查機構備查，並公布於工作場所。
questions.explain_en: Article 38: designated enterprises shall fill in occupational accident details and statistics, report them monthly to the labor inspection agency for record, and post them in the workplace.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依本法第39條，工作者發現下列何種情形，得向雇主、主管機關或勞動檢查機構申訴？
questions.c_zh: 事業單位違反本法、疑似罹患職業病、身體或精神遭受侵害
questions.q_en: Under Article 39, a worker may file a complaint with the employer, competent authority or labor inspection agency upon discovering:
questions.c_en: Violations of the Act, suspected occupational disease, or physical or mental harm
questions.explain_zh: 第39條第1項三款：事業單位違反本法或有關安全衛生之規定、疑似罹患職業病、身體或精神遭受侵害。
questions.explain_en: Article 39(1): violations of the Act or safety and health regulations, suspected occupational disease, or physical or mental harm.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主對依本法申訴之工作者為不利處分，其效力如何？舉證責任由誰負擔？
questions.a_zh: 不利處分有效；勞工負舉證責任
questions.b_zh: 不利處分有效；雇主負舉證責任
questions.c_zh: 不利處分無效；勞工負舉證責任
questions.d_zh: 不利處分無效；雇主就該處分與申訴行為無關之事實負舉證責任
questions.q_en: If an employer imposes adverse treatment on a worker who filed a complaint under the Act, what is its effect, and who bears the burden of proof?
questions.a_en: Valid; the laborer bears the burden
questions.b_en: Valid; the employer bears the burden
questions.c_en: Void; the laborer bears the burden
questions.d_en: The adverse treatment is void; the employer must prove it was unrelated to the complaint
questions.explain_zh: 第39條第4至6項：雇主不得對申訴或協助申訴之工作者為解僱、降調、減薪等不利處分；雇主為前項不利處分者無效；雇主對於該不利處分與申訴行為無關之事實，負舉證責任。
questions.explain_en: Article 39(4)-(6): adverse treatment such as dismissal, demotion or pay cut is prohibited and void; the employer bears the burden of proving the treatment was unrelated to the complaint.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 違反第6條第1項或第16條第1項規定，致發生死亡災害者，其刑責為何？
questions.b_zh: 五年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣一百五十萬元以下罰金
questions.c_zh: 三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣一百萬元以下罰金
questions.q_en: What is the criminal penalty for violating Article 6(1) or 16(1) resulting in a fatal accident?
questions.b_en: Imprisonment up to 5 years, detention, and/or a fine up to NT$1.5 million
questions.c_en: Imprisonment up to 3 years, detention, and/or a fine up to NT$1 million
questions.explain_zh: 第40條第1項：違反第六條第一項或第十六條第一項之規定，致發生第三十七條第二項第一款（死亡）之災害者，處五年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣一百五十萬元以下罰金。法人犯之者，除處罰其負責人外，對該法人亦科以罰金。
questions.explain_en: Article 40(1): imprisonment for not more than five years, detention, and/or a criminal fine of not more than NT$1,500,000; a legal person is also fined in addition to its responsible person.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 下列何種情形，處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣一百萬元以下罰金？
questions.a_zh: 違反勞動檢查機構依第36條所發之停工通知
questions.c_zh: 未依規定張貼安全標示
questions.d_zh: 未按月填報職業災害統計
questions.q_en: Which of the following is punishable by imprisonment up to 3 years, detention, and/or a fine up to NT$1 million?
questions.a_en: Violating a work-stoppage notice issued by the labor inspection agency under Article 36
questions.c_en: Failing to affix a safety label
questions.d_en: Failing to file monthly accident statistics
questions.explain_zh: 第41條第1項四款：違反第6條第1項或第16條第1項致罹災三人以上、違反第18條第1項/第29條第1項/第30條第1項第2項、違反第36條第1項停工通知、故意違反第37條第4項移動破壞現場。
questions.explain_en: Article 41(1): violating Article 6(1)/16(1) causing three or more victims; violating Article 18(1), 29(1) or 30(1)/(2); violating a stoppage notice under Article 36(1); intentionally moving or damaging the scene in violation of Article 37(4).

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 違反第15條製程安全評估規定，其危害性化學品洩漏或引起火災、爆炸致發生應通報之職業災害者，罰鍰額度為何？
questions.a_zh: 新臺幣一萬元以上二十萬元以下
questions.b_zh: 新臺幣三十萬元以上三百萬元以下
questions.c_zh: 新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下
questions.q_en: For violating Article 15 (process safety assessment) where a hazardous chemical leak, fire or explosion causes a reportable occupational accident, the fine is:
questions.explain_zh: 第42條第1項：違反第15條第1項、第2項之規定，其危害性化學品洩漏或引起火災、爆炸致發生第37條第2項之職業災害者，處新臺幣三十萬元以上三百萬元以下罰鍰；經通知限期改善屆期未改善，並得按次處罰。
questions.explain_en: Article 42(1): a fine of NT$300,000 to NT$3,000,000, with consecutive penalties if not corrected within the deadline.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 雇主依第12條第4項通報之作業環境監測資料，經中央主管機關查核有虛偽不實者，罰鍰額度為何？
questions.a_zh: 新臺幣三十萬元以上一百萬元以下
questions.b_zh: 新臺幣五萬元以上三百萬元以下
questions.c_zh: 新臺幣三萬元以上七十五萬元以下
questions.q_en: If workplace environment monitoring data reported under Article 12(4) is found to be false, the fine is:
questions.explain_zh: 第42條第2項：雇主依第十二條第四項規定通報之監測資料，經中央主管機關查核有虛偽不實者，處新臺幣三十萬元以上一百萬元以下罰鍰。
questions.explain_en: Article 42(2): a fine of NT$300,000 to NT$1,000,000 for false monitoring data.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 規避、妨礙或拒絕本法規定之檢查、調查、抽驗、市場查驗或查核者，罰鍰額度為何？
questions.a_zh: 新臺幣五萬元以上三百萬元以下
questions.b_zh: 新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下
questions.c_zh: 新臺幣一萬元以上二十萬元以下
questions.q_en: What is the fine for evading, obstructing or refusing inspections, investigations, sampling tests, market surveillance or audits under the Act?
questions.explain_zh: 第43條第1項第6款：規避、妨礙或拒絕本法規定之檢查、調查、抽驗、市場查驗或查核，處新臺幣五萬元以上三百萬元以下罰鍰。第2項：主管機關得依事業規模、性質或違反情節，加重罰鍰至法定最高額二分之一。
questions.explain_en: Article 43(1)(6): a fine of NT$50,000 to NT$3,000,000; under paragraph 2 the fine may be increased by up to one half of the statutory maximum depending on scale, nature or severity.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 違反第7條第1項（不符安全標準之指定機械不得產製運出廠場等）或第8條第1項（型式驗證）規定者，罰鍰額度為何？
questions.a_zh: 新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下
questions.b_zh: 新臺幣一萬元以上一百萬元以下
questions.c_zh: 新臺幣二十萬元以上二百萬元以下，並得限期停止輸入、產製、製造或供應
questions.q_en: What is the fine for violating Article 7(1) (non-compliant designated machinery) or Article 8(1) (type certification)?
questions.c_en: NT$200,000 to NT$2,000,000, and import, production, manufacture or supply may be ordered to stop within a deadline
questions.explain_zh: 第44條第2項：違反第七條第一項、第八條第一項、第十三條第一項或第十四條第一項規定者，處新臺幣二十萬元以上二百萬元以下罰鍰，並得限期停止輸入、產製、製造或供應；屆期不停止者，按次處罰。
questions.explain_en: Article 44(2): a fine of NT$200,000 to NT$2,000,000, with possible orders to stop import, production, manufacture or supply, and consecutive penalties if not stopped.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 依第36條第1項停工期間應給付工資而不給付者，罰鍰額度為何？
questions.a_zh: 新臺幣五萬元以上三百萬元以下
questions.c_zh: 新臺幣三十萬元以上三百萬元以下
questions.d_zh: 新臺幣三萬元以上七十五萬元以下
questions.q_en: What is the fine for failing to pay wages that are due during a work stoppage under Article 36(1)?
questions.explain_zh: 第45條第1項第3款：依第三十六條第一項之規定，應給付工資而不給付，處新臺幣三萬元以上七十五萬元以下罰鍰。
questions.explain_en: Article 45(1)(3): a fine of NT$30,000 to NT$750,000.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 最高負責人經認定有職場霸凌之行為者，罰鍰額度為何？
questions.a_zh: 新臺幣五萬元以上三百萬元以下
questions.c_zh: 新臺幣三十萬元以上一百萬元以下
questions.d_zh: 新臺幣一萬元以上一百萬元以下
questions.q_en: If the top person in charge is found to have committed workplace bullying, the fine is:
questions.explain_zh: 第46條第1項：最高負責人經認定有職場霸凌之行為者，處新臺幣一萬元以上一百萬元以下罰鍰。
questions.explain_en: Article 46(1): a fine of NT$10,000 to NT$1,000,000.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法
questions.q_zh: 勞工違反第20條第6項（接受健康檢查義務）、第32條第4項（接受教育訓練義務）或第34條第2項（遵行工作守則）者，罰鍰額度為何？
questions.b_zh: 新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下
questions.c_zh: 新臺幣一萬元以上二十萬元以下
questions.q_en: A laborer who violates the duty to undergo health examinations (Art. 20(6)), attend training (Art. 32(4)) or comply with work rules (Art. 34(2)) is fined:
questions.explain_zh: 第46條第4項：違反第二十條第六項、第三十二條第四項或第三十四條第二項之規定者，處新臺幣三千元以下罰鍰。
questions.explain_en: Article 46(4): a fine of not more than NT$3,000.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則所稱「自營作業者」，指下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 與事業單位有僱傭關係之工作者
questions.b_zh: 僱用五人以下之小型企業主
questions.c_zh: 獨立從事勞動或技藝工作，獲致報酬，且未僱用有酬人員幫同工作者
questions.q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, a 'self-employed person' means:
questions.a_en: A worker with an employment relationship with the enterprise
questions.b_en: A small business owner with five or fewer employees
questions.c_en: A person who independently performs labor or craft work for remuneration without employing paid helpers
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第2條第1項：自營作業者，指獨立從事勞動或技藝工作，獲致報酬，且未僱用有酬人員幫同工作者。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 2(1): a self-employed person independently performs labor or craft work for remuneration and does not employ paid personnel to assist.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則所稱「工作場所負責人」，指下列何者？
questions.d_zh: 雇主或於該工作場所代表雇主從事管理、指揮或監督工作者從事勞動之人
questions.q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, the 'workplace manager' means:
questions.d_en: The employer, or a person representing the employer at the workplace to manage, direct or supervise workers
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第3條：工作場所負責人，指雇主或於該工作場所代表雇主從事管理、指揮或監督工作者從事勞動之人。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 3: the workplace manager is the employer or a person who represents the employer at the workplace to manage, direct or supervise workers performing labor.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則所稱「工資」是否包括獎金、津貼等經常性給與？
questions.c_zh: 包括，凡因工作獲得之報酬及任何名義之經常性給與均屬之
questions.q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, does 'wage' include bonuses, allowances and other regular payments?
questions.c_en: Yes, all remuneration for work and regular payments under any name are included
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第4條：工資指勞工因工作而獲得之報酬，包括工資、薪金及按計時、計日、計月、計件以現金或實物等方式給付之獎金、津貼及其他任何名義之經常性給與均屬之。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 4: wage means remuneration obtained for work, including wages, salaries, and bonuses, allowances and other regular payments under any name paid in cash or in kind.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則所稱「風險評估」，指下列何種程序？
questions.d_zh: 辨識、分析及評量風險之程序
questions.q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, 'risk assessment' means the process of:
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第8條第2項：本法第五條第二項及第二十六條第一項所稱風險評估，指辨識、分析及評量風險之程序。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 8(2): risk assessment means the process of identifying, analyzing and evaluating risks.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則對本法第5條「合理可行範圍」之定義，其判斷依據不包括下列何者？
questions.b_zh: 本法及有關安全衛生法令
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT a basis for judging the 'reasonably practicable scope' under the Enforcement Rules?
questions.b_en: The Act and related safety and health laws
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第8條第1項：合理可行範圍，指依本法及有關安全衛生法令、指引、實務規範或一般社會通念，雇主明知或可得而知勞工所從事之工作有致其生命、身體及健康受危害之虞，並可採取必要之預防設備或措施者。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 8(1): the scope is judged by the Act, related laws, guidelines, codes of practice or general social norms, where the employer knew or could have known of hazards and could take preventive measures.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者不是施行細則第12條所列本法第7條指定之機械、設備或器具？
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT a designated machine, equipment or tool under Enforcement Rules Article 12 (Article 7 of the Act)?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第12條列舉：動力衝剪機械、手推刨床、木材加工用圓盤鋸、動力堆高機、研磨機、研磨輪、防爆電氣設備及相關安全裝置等。固定式起重機屬第22條之危險性機械。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 12 lists power shearing/punching machines, hand-fed planers, woodworking circular saws, powered forklifts, grinders, grinding wheels, explosion-proof electrical equipment and related safety devices. A fixed crane is dangerous machinery under Article 22.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第14條所稱危害性化學品，其「危險物」與「有害物」之區分依據為何？
questions.a_zh: 依CNS15030分類，具物理性危害者為危險物、具健康危害者為有害物
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 14, how are 'dangerous substances' and 'harmful substances' distinguished?
questions.a_en: By CNS 15030 classification: physical hazards are dangerous substances; health hazards are harmful substances
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第14條：危險物指符合國家標準CNS15030分類，具有物理性危害者；有害物指符合CNS15030分類，具有健康危害者。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 14: dangerous substances have physical hazards and harmful substances have health hazards, both classified under national standard CNS 15030.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則所稱危害性化學品之「安全資料表」，應記載下列何種項目？
questions.b_zh: 化學品名稱、製造商或供應商基本資料、危害特性、緊急處理及危害預防措施
questions.q_en: Under the Enforcement Rules, a chemical 'safety data sheet' shall record:
questions.b_en: Chemical name, manufacturer/supplier information, hazard characteristics, emergency handling and hazard prevention measures
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第16條：安全資料表指記載化學品名稱、製造商或供應商基本資料、危害特性、緊急處理及危害預防措施等項目之表單。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 16: the safety data sheet records the chemical name, manufacturer or supplier information, hazard characteristics, emergency handling and hazard prevention measures.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第17條所稱「作業環境監測」，包含下列何種程序？
questions.d_zh: 規劃、採樣、測定、分析及評估
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 17, 'workplace environment monitoring' includes which procedures?
questions.d_en: Planning, sampling, measurement, analysis and evaluation
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第17條第1項：作業環境監測，指為掌握勞工作業環境實態與評估勞工暴露狀況，所採取之規劃、採樣、測定、分析及評估。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 17(1): workplace environment monitoring means planning, sampling, measurement, analysis and evaluation to grasp the actual workplace environment and assess laborers' exposure.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬施行細則第17條第2項應訂定作業環境監測計畫並實施監測之作業場所？
questions.d_zh: 顯著發生噪音之作業場所
questions.q_en: Which of the following is an operation site requiring a monitoring plan and monitoring under Enforcement Rules Article 17(2)?
questions.d_en: An operation site with significant noise
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第17條第2項：設置中央管理方式空氣調節設備之建築物室內作業場所、坑內作業場所、顯著發生噪音之作業場所、經指定之高溫/粉塵/鉛/四烷基鉛/有機溶劑/特定化學物質作業場所、其他指定公告之作業場所。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 17(2): indoor sites with central air-conditioning, underground sites, sites with significant noise, designated high-temperature/dust/lead/tetraalkyl lead/organic solvent/specified chemical sites, and other designated sites.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第17條第2項第4款經中央主管機關指定之作業場所，不包括下列何者？
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT among the designated operation sites in Enforcement Rules Article 17(2)(4)?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第17條第2項第4款列六類：高溫作業場所、粉塵作業場所、鉛作業場所、四烷基鉛作業場所、有機溶劑作業場所、特定化學物質作業場所。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 17(2)(4) lists six categories: high-temperature, dust, lead, tetraalkyl lead, organic solvent and specified chemical substance operation sites.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第19條所定「管制性化學品」，其分類依據為何？
questions.b_zh: 優先管理化學品中屬致癌物質第一級、生殖細胞致突變性物質第一級或生殖毒性物質第一級，且經評估具高度暴露風險者
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 19, 'controlled chemicals' are classified as:
questions.b_en: Priority management chemicals that are Category 1 carcinogens, Category 1 germ cell mutagens or Category 1 reproductive toxicants under CNS 15030 and assessed as high exposure risk
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第19條：管制性化學品指第20條所定優先管理化學品中，依CNS15030分類屬致癌物質第一級、生殖細胞致突變性物質第一級或生殖毒性物質第一級，且經中央主管機關評估具高度暴露風險者，及其他經指定公告者。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 19: controlled chemicals are priority management chemicals classified under CNS 15030 as Category 1 carcinogens, germ cell mutagens or reproductive toxicants and assessed by the central competent authority as high exposure risk, plus other designated chemicals.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者不屬施行細則第22條所列具有危險性之機械？
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT dangerous machinery under Enforcement Rules Article 22?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第22條：危險性機械指一定容量以上之固定式起重機、移動式起重機、人字臂起重桿、營建用升降機、營建用提升機、吊籠及其他指定公告者。動力堆高機屬第12條指定機械。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 22: dangerous machinery includes fixed cranes, mobile cranes, derricks, construction elevators, construction hoists, gondolas and other designated machinery above a certain capacity. A powered forklift is designated under Article 12.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬施行細則第23條所列具有危險性之設備？
questions.q_en: Which of the following is dangerous equipment under Enforcement Rules Article 23?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第23條：危險性設備指一定容量以上之鍋爐、壓力容器、高壓氣體特定設備、高壓氣體容器及其他指定公告者。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 23: dangerous equipment includes boilers, pressure vessels, specified high-pressure gas equipment, high-pressure gas containers and other designated equipment above a certain capacity.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者不是施行細則第24條所列危險性機械設備之檢查項目？
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT an inspection item for dangerous machinery and equipment under Enforcement Rules Article 24?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第24條列八項：熔接檢查、構造檢查、竣工檢查、定期檢查、重新檢查、型式檢查、使用檢查、變更檢查。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 24 lists eight items: welding, structural, completion, periodic, re-inspection, type, use and alteration inspections.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 作業場所有易燃液體之蒸氣或可燃性氣體滯留，達爆炸下限值之百分之多少以上，屬施行細則第25條「有立即發生危險之虞」？
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 25, flammable vapor or combustible gas accumulating at what percentage of the lower explosive limit constitutes 'imminent danger'?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第25條第4款：於作業場所有易燃液體之蒸氣或可燃性氣體滯留，達爆炸下限值之百分之三十以上，致有發生爆炸、火災危險之虞時。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 25(4): flammable liquid vapor or combustible gas accumulating at 30% or more of the lower explosive limit, with risk of explosion or fire.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 於高度幾公尺以上作業，未設置防墜設施及未使勞工使用適當個人防護具，屬「有立即發生危險之虞」？
questions.q_en: Working at a height of how many meters or more without fall-prevention facilities and appropriate PPE constitutes 'imminent danger'?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第25條第7款：於高度二公尺以上作業，未設置防墜設施及未使勞工使用適當之個人防護具，致有發生墜落危險之虞時。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 25(7): work at a height of 2 meters or more without fall-prevention facilities and appropriate personal protective equipment.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 從事河川工程、河堤、海堤或圍堰等作業，因何種情形致有發生危險之虞，屬施行細則第25條之情形？
questions.q_en: For river works, embankments, seawalls or cofferdams, which condition creates 'imminent danger' under Enforcement Rules Article 25?
questions.d_en: Strong wind, heavy rain or earthquake
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第25條第2款：從事河川工程、河堤、海堤或圍堰等作業，因強風、大雨或地震，致有發生危險之虞時。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 25(2): river works, embankments, seawalls or cofferdam operations where strong wind, heavy rain or earthquake creates a risk of danger.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第27條所稱「特殊健康檢查」，其對象為何？
questions.a_zh: 從事特別危害健康作業之勞工
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 27, who is the target of 'special health examinations'?
questions.a_en: Laborers engaged in especially health-hazardous work
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第27條第2項第2款：特殊健康檢查指對從事特別危害健康作業之勞工，為發現健康有無異常，以提供健康指導、適性配工及分級管理等措施，依其作業危害性於一定期間或變更工作時所實施者。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 27(2)(2): special health examinations target laborers engaged in especially health-hazardous work, conducted periodically or upon job change to provide health guidance, fitness-based assignment and graded management.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 勞工自行於其他符合規定之醫療機構接受相當種類及項目之檢查，並將結果提供雇主者，效力如何？
questions.a_zh: 須經勞動檢查機構核可
questions.b_zh: 不予承認，仍須重新檢查
questions.c_zh: 視為已接受本法第20條第1項之檢查
questions.q_en: If a laborer undergoes equivalent examinations at another qualified medical institution and provides the results to the employer, what is the effect?
questions.a_en: Requires approval by the labor inspection agency
questions.c_en: Deemed to have undergone the examination under Article 20(1) of the Act
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第29條第2項：勞工自行於其他符合規定之醫療機構接受相當種類及項目之檢查，並將檢查結果提供予雇主者，視為已接受本法第二十條第一項之檢查。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 29(2): such examinations are deemed to satisfy Article 20(1) of the Act.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第32條所定安全衛生組織中，「職業安全衛生委員會」之功能為何？
questions.c_zh: 審議、協調、考核及建議職業安全衛生有關業務
questions.d_zh: 擬訂、規劃、推動及督導職業安全衛生有關業務
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 32, what is the function of the 'Occupational Safety and Health Committee'?
questions.c_en: To deliberate, coordinate, evaluate and advise on OSH matters
questions.d_en: To draft, plan, promote and supervise OSH matters
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第32條：職業安全衛生管理單位為擬訂、規劃、推動及督導之組織；職業安全衛生委員會為審議、協調、考核及建議之組織。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 32: the OSH management unit drafts, plans, promotes and supervises; the OSH committee deliberates, coordinates, evaluates and advises.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者不屬施行細則第33條所稱之安全衛生人員？
questions.a_zh: 職業安全衛生業務主管
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT 'safety and health personnel' under Enforcement Rules Article 33?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第33條：安全衛生人員包括職業安全衛生業務主管、職業安全管理師、職業衛生管理師、職業安全衛生管理員。勞動檢查員為政府人員。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 33: safety and health personnel include the OSH business supervisor, occupational safety management specialist, occupational hygiene management specialist and OSH administrator. A labor inspector is a government official.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 本法第26條所定交付承攬時之事前告知，依施行細則第36條應以何種方式辦理？
questions.d_zh: 提供書面或電子文件，或召開協商會議並作成紀錄
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 36, how shall the prior notification under Article 26 of the Act be made when contracting out?
questions.c_en: By posting on a bulletin board
questions.d_en: By providing written or electronic documents, or by holding a consultation meeting with minutes
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第36條：事前告知應依下列方式之一辦理：一、於交付承攬時，提供書面或電子文件。二、召開協商會議，並作成紀錄。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 36: prior notification shall be made by providing written or electronic documents at the time of contracting, or by holding a consultation meeting with written records.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第37條所稱「共同作業」，指下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 不同公司在不同地點各自作業
questions.b_zh: 承攬人在自己廠房作業
questions.c_zh: 同一公司員工輪班作業
questions.d_zh: 事業單位與承攬人、再承攬人之工作者，於同一期間、同一工作場所從事工作
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 37, 'joint operation' means:
questions.a_en: Different companies working separately at different sites
questions.b_en: A contractor working in its own factory
questions.c_en: Employees of one company working in shifts
questions.d_en: Workers of the enterprise, contractors and subcontractors working during the same period at the same workplace
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第37條：共同作業，指事業單位與承攬人、再承攬人之工作者，於同一期間、同一工作場所從事工作。
