questions.d_en: Fixed fencing; movable fencing or warning-tape zones
questions.explain_zh: 第8條：工作場所周圍應設置固定式圍籬並於明顯位置裝設警告標示；大規模施工之土木工程或設置固定式圍籬有困難者，得以移動式圍籬、警示帶圍成之警示區替代。
questions.explain_en: Article 8: fixed fencing with warning signs; large-scale civil works or where fixed fencing is difficult may use movable fencing or warning-tape zones.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 工作場所人員及車輛機械出入口處，下列何者正確？
questions.b_zh: 人員與車輛共用同一出入口以節省空間
questions.d_zh: 人員出入口與車輛機械出入口應分隔設置，並置管制人員
questions.q_en: Regarding site entrances for personnel and vehicles, which is correct?
questions.b_en: Share one entrance to save space
questions.d_en: Personnel and vehicle entrances shall be separate, with gate control personnel
questions.explain_zh: 第11條：事前調查地下埋設物；出入口應設拉開式大門，車輛出入頻繁時應置交通引導人員；人員出入口與車輛機械出入口應分隔設置（設有足以防止事故之警告標誌者除外）；應置管制人員管制人員防護具及車輛許可文件。
questions.explain_en: Article 11: survey underground utilities; sliding gates; traffic guides where vehicle traffic is frequent; separate personnel and vehicle entrances (unless warning signs suffice); gate control staff check PPE and vehicle permits.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 依民國115年修正之營造標準第11條之2，進入營繕工程工作場所作業人員應於事前接受何種訓練？該條自何時施行？
questions.a_zh: 中央主管機關指定之營造作業安全訓練；一百十六年七月一日
questions.b_zh: 一般安全衛生教育訓練三小時；一百十五年七月一日
questions.d_zh: 急救訓練；一百十六年一月一日
questions.q_en: Under Article 11-2 (2026 amendment), what training must workers receive before entering a construction site, and when does it take effect?
questions.a_en: Construction work safety training designated by the central authority; 1 July 2027 (ROC 116)
questions.explain_zh: 第11條之2：進入營繕工程工作場所作業人員，應於事前使其接受中央主管機關指定之營造作業安全訓練（已依教育訓練規則第4、5、7或10條受訓者除外）。第174條：第11條之2自一百十六年七月一日施行。
questions.explain_en: Article 11-2: workers shall receive construction work safety training designated by the central competent authority (exempt if trained under Articles 4, 5, 7 or 10 of the Training Rules); Article 174: effective 1 July ROC 116 (2027).

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 勞工鄰近水域作業有落水之虞時，備置之救生船筏每艘應配備多長、直徑多少之聚丙烯纖維繩索？
questions.a_zh: 長度五公尺、直徑八毫米
questions.b_zh: 長度十公尺、直徑六毫米
questions.c_zh: 長度十五公尺、直徑九點五毫米
questions.d_zh: 長度三十公尺、直徑十二毫米
questions.q_en: For work near water with drowning risk, each rescue boat shall carry a polypropylene rope of what length and diameter?
questions.explain_zh: 第14條：應設置防止落水設施或使勞工著用救生衣；備置動力救生船、救生艇等，每艘船筏應配備長度十五公尺、直徑九點五毫米之聚丙烯纖維繩索，並掛繫與最大可救援人數相同數量之救生圈、船鈎及救生衣。
questions.explain_en: Article 14: fall-prevention or life jackets; rescue boats each with a 15 m, 9.5 mm polypropylene rope carrying life rings, boat hooks and life jackets equal to the maximum number of rescuees.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 高度二公尺以上作業有墜落之虞者，應訂定墜落災害防止計畫，其風險控制先後順序中，第一優先為何？
questions.b_zh: 經由設計或工法之選擇，儘量使勞工於地面完成作業
questions.q_en: In the fall-hazard prevention plan for work at 2 m or higher, what is the first priority in the hierarchy of controls?
questions.b_en: Choose designs or methods that let workers finish the job at ground level
questions.explain_zh: 第17條順序：一、設計或工法選擇使勞工於地面完成作業；二、施工程序變更優先施作永久構造物之上下設備或防墜設施；三、設置護欄、護蓋；四、張掛安全網；五、警示線系統；六、限制人員進入管制區；七、使勞工佩掛安全帶；八、增加危險之作業應訂保護計畫。
questions.explain_en: Article 17 hierarchy: (1) design/method to work at ground level; (2) change sequence to build permanent access or fall protection first; (3) guardrails and covers; (4) safety nets; (5) warning lines; (6) restricted zones; (7) harnesses; (8) protection plans for higher-risk work.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 屋頂斜度大於幾度（高底比二比三以上）或為滑溜之屋頂從事作業時，應設置護欄及寬度四十公分以上之工作臺？
questions.q_en: On roofs steeper than what angle (rise-to-run 2:3 or more) or slippery roofs must guardrails and 40 cm work platforms be installed?
questions.explain_zh: 第18條第1項第2款：於斜度大於三十四度，即高底比為二比三以上，或為滑溜之屋頂從事作業者，應設置適當之護欄、寬度四十公分以上之工作臺及安裝牢穩之梯子；設置護欄有困難者應提供背負式安全帶。
questions.explain_en: Article 18(1)(2): on roofs steeper than 34° (2:3) or slippery roofs, install guardrails, work platforms at least 40 cm wide and secure ladders; where guardrails are impractical, provide full-body harnesses.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 依營造標準設置之護欄，上欄杆高度應在多少公分以上？上下開口距離不得大於多少公分？
questions.a_zh: 七十五公分；四十五公分
questions.b_zh: 一百二十公分；五十公分
questions.q_en: Guardrails under the Standards shall have a top rail at least how high, with vertical openings not exceeding:
questions.explain_zh: 第20條第1款：具有高度九十公分以上之上欄杆、中欄杆、腳趾板及杆柱；其上欄杆、中欄杆及地盤面與樓板面間之上下開口距離應不大於五十五公分。
questions.explain_en: Article 20(1): top rail at least 90 cm, with mid-rail, toe board and posts; vertical openings between top rail, mid-rail and floor not exceeding 55 cm.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 以鋼管構成之護欄，其上欄杆、中欄杆及杆柱之直徑均不得小於多少公分？杆柱相鄰間距不得超過多少公尺？
questions.a_zh: 三點八公分；二點五公尺
questions.q_en: For steel-pipe guardrails, the minimum diameter of rails and posts, and the maximum post spacing are:
questions.explain_zh: 第20條第3款：以鋼管構成者，其上欄杆、中欄杆及杆柱之直徑均不得小於三點八公分，杆柱相鄰間距不得超過二點五公尺。木材構成者上欄杆斷面三十平方公分以上、杆柱間距不得超過二公尺。護欄應能抵抗七十五公斤荷重。
questions.explain_en: Article 20(3): steel pipes at least 3.8 cm in diameter with posts no more than 2.5 m apart; wooden top rails at least 30 cm² section with posts not over 2 m apart; guardrails must withstand 75 kg.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 護欄前方多少公尺內之樓板、地板，不得堆放物料、設備，並不得使用梯子、合梯作業？
questions.q_en: Within how many meters in front of a guardrail may no materials or equipment be stacked and no ladders or stools used?
questions.explain_zh: 第20條第7款：護欄前方二公尺內之樓板、地板，不得堆放任何物料、設備，並不得使用梯子、合梯、踏凳作業及停放車輛機械供勞工使用。但護欄高度超過堆放物最高部達九十公分以上或已採適當安全設施者不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 20(7): within 2 m in front of a guardrail, no materials or equipment may be placed and no ladders, stepladders, stools or parked vehicles used, unless the rail is 90 cm above the top of such items or other safeguards exist.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 供車輛通行之護蓋，得以車輛後軸載重之幾倍設計？柵狀構造者柵條間隔不得大於多少公分？臨時開口護蓋表面應漆何色？
questions.q_en: Covers for vehicle passage may be designed for how many times the rear-axle load, grating bars spaced no more than what, and temporary-opening covers painted what color?
questions.explain_zh: 第21條：護蓋應具人員及車輛安全通過之強度；供車輛通行者得以車輛後軸載重之二倍設計；柵狀構造者柵條間隔不得大於三公分；臨時性開口處使用之護蓋表面漆以黃色並書以警告訊息。
questions.explain_en: Article 21: strength for persons and vehicles; vehicle covers designed for twice the rear-axle load; grating gaps not over 3 cm; temporary-opening covers painted yellow with warning text.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 安全網之工作面至安全網架設平面之攔截高度，不得超過多少公尺？安全網及其組件應多久檢查一次？
questions.q_en: The interception height from the work surface to a safety net shall not exceed how much, and how often are nets inspected?
questions.explain_zh: 第22條：攔截高度不得超過七公尺（鋼構組配作業得依第151條辦理）；安全網應符合CNS 14252或CNS 16079-1、16079-2；攔截後應即測試；每週應檢查一次。
questions.explain_en: Article 22: interception height not over 7 m (steel erection may follow Article 151); nets per CNS 14252 or CNS 16079-1/-2; test after arresting a fall; inspect weekly.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 結構物四周之安全網，攔截高度超過三公尺者，至少應延伸多少公尺？
questions.q_en: Perimeter safety nets with an interception height over 3 m shall extend outward at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第22條第3款：攔截高度在一點五公尺以下者至少延伸二點五公尺；超過一點五公尺且在三公尺以下者至少延伸三公尺；超過三公尺者至少延伸四公尺。
questions.explain_en: Article 22(3): interception height ≤1.5 m: extend 2.5 m; >1.5 to 3 m: 3 m; >3 m: 4 m.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 安全母索之最小斷裂強度應在多少公斤以上？安全帶或母索繫固之錨錠至少應能承受每人多少公斤之拉力？
questions.c_zh: 二千三百公斤；二千三百公斤
questions.d_zh: 一千公斤；一千五百公斤
questions.q_en: The minimum breaking strength of a horizontal lifeline, and the anchor strength per person, shall be at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第23條：安全母索最小斷裂強度應在二千三百公斤以上；錨錠至少應能承受每人二千三百公斤之拉力；安全帶不得鈎掛於護欄杆件（強度符合者除外）。
questions.explain_en: Article 23: lifeline breaking strength at least 2,300 kg; anchors at least 2,300 kg per person; harnesses must not be hooked to guardrail members unless of adequate strength.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 水平安全母索之設置高度應大於多少公尺？相鄰二錨錠點間之最大間距計算值超過多少公尺者以該值計？
questions.q_en: A horizontal lifeline shall be installed higher than what, and the maximum anchor spacing is capped at:
questions.explain_zh: 第23條第8款：水平安全母索之設置高度應大於三點八公尺，相鄰二錨錠點間之最大間距得採 L=4(H-3) 計算，其計算值超過十公尺者以十公尺計；錨錠點間之母索僅能繫掛一條安全帶。
questions.explain_en: Article 23(8): installed above 3.8 m; anchor spacing L = 4(H − 3), capped at 10 m; only one harness per span between anchors.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 垂直安全母索，每條原則上應僅提供幾名勞工使用？
questions.b_zh: 一名（作業位置水平間距一公尺以下者得二人共用）
questions.q_en: A vertical lifeline shall in principle serve how many workers?
questions.b_en: One (two may share if their positions are within 1 m horizontally)
questions.explain_zh: 第23條第9款：每條垂直安全母索應僅提供一名勞工使用。但勞工作業或爬昇位置之水平間距在一公尺以下者，得二人共用一條安全母索；母索下端應有防止鎖扣脫落之設施。
questions.explain_en: Article 23(9): one worker per vertical lifeline, except two workers whose positions are within 1 m horizontally may share; the lower end must stop the fall-arrester from sliding off.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 坡度小於十五度之作業區域，距開口部分超過多少公尺時，得設置警示線代替護欄？警示線應距開口多少公尺以上？
questions.q_en: In work areas with slope under 15°, warning lines may replace guardrails when more than how far from an edge, and lines must be at least how far from the edge?
questions.explain_zh: 第24條：坡度小於十五度之作業區域，距離開口部分、開放邊線超過二公尺時，得設置警示線、管制通行區代替護欄；警示線應距開口二公尺以上；每隔二點五公尺以下設高九十公分以上杆柱，警示繩帶張力二百二十五公斤以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 24: more than 2 m from an opening or open edge; warning lines at least 2 m from the edge, posts ≥90 cm every 2.5 m or less, rope/tape tensile strength ≥225 kg.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 置放於高處，位能超過多少公斤‧公尺之物件有飛落之虞者，應予以固定？
questions.q_en: Objects placed at height with potential energy exceeding how much must be secured against falling?
questions.explain_zh: 第26條：置放於高處，位能超過十二公斤‧公尺之物件有飛落之虞者，應予以固定之。第27條：覆網攔截位能小於十二公斤‧公尺之物件，網目邊長不得大於二公分，覆網最低點離作業平面三公尺以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 26: objects with potential energy over 12 kg·m must be secured; Article 27: debris nets for smaller objects have mesh not over 2 cm and hang at least 3 m above the work surface.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主得否使勞工以投擲之方式運送物料？
questions.b_zh: 不得，但設置滑槽、圍屏、警示線及專責監視人員者不在此限
questions.q_en: May workers throw materials to move them?
questions.b_en: No, unless chutes, screens, warning lines and a full-time watcher are provided
questions.explain_zh: 第28條：不得使勞工以投擲方式運送任何物料。但劃定滑槽承受區域、設置阻擋彈跳之圍屏並依第24條設警示線，且設專責監視人員全時監視者，不在此限；遇強風大雨應即停止。
questions.explain_en: Article 28: throwing materials is prohibited unless a chute landing zone with screens, warning lines under Article 24 and a full-time watcher are in place; stop in strong wind or heavy rain.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 磚、瓦、管料、鋼筋等營建材料之堆放高度不得超過多少公尺？鄰近開口時應距離開口多少公尺以上？
questions.q_en: Stacks of bricks, tiles, pipes or rebar shall not exceed what height, and shall be at least how far from openings?
questions.explain_zh: 第35條：磚、瓦、木塊、管料、鋼筋、鋼材等之堆放應置放於穩固平坦處，整齊緊靠堆置，高度不得超過一點八公尺，儲存位置鄰近開口部分時應距離該開口二公尺以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 35: stacked neatly on firm level ground, not over 1.8 m high, and at least 2 m from any opening.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 袋裝材料之儲存，堆放高度不得超過幾層？至少每幾層應交錯一次方向？
questions.q_en: Bagged materials may be stacked no higher than how many layers, and direction alternated at least every how many layers?
questions.explain_zh: 第36條：堆放高度不得超過十層；至少每二層交錯一次方向；五層以上部分應向內退縮以維持穩定。
questions.explain_en: Article 36: not over 10 layers; alternate direction at least every 2 layers; layers above the fifth stepped inward.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 高度七公尺以上且立面面積達多少平方公尺之施工架，其構築及拆除應由專任工程人員或執業技師依結構力學設計並簽章？
questions.q_en: Scaffolds 7 m or higher with a facade area of at least how much require design and signature by a full-time engineer or licensed professional?
questions.explain_zh: 第40條：施工構臺、懸吊式施工架、懸臂式施工架、高度七公尺以上且立面面積達三百三十平方公尺之施工架、高度七公尺以上之吊料平臺等，應由專任工程人員或委由執業技師依結構力學原理設計，置備施工圖說及強度計算書並簽章。
questions.explain_en: Article 40: work platforms, suspended and cantilever scaffolds, scaffolds ≥7 m high with facade area ≥330 m², and material platforms ≥7 m require structural design, drawings and calculations signed by a full-time engineer or licensed professional.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 高度幾公尺以上施工架之組配及拆除作業，應指派施工架組配作業主管於現場辦理？
questions.q_en: A scaffold assembly supervisor must be present on site for assembling or dismantling scaffolds of at least what height?
questions.explain_zh: 第41條：懸吊式施工架、懸臂式施工架及高度五公尺以上施工架之組配及拆除作業，應指派施工架組配作業主管於作業現場決定作業方法、實施檢點、監督使用防護具、確認設備有效狀況等。
questions.explain_en: Article 41: suspended, cantilever and scaffolds 5 m or higher require a scaffold assembly supervisor on site to decide methods, inspect, supervise PPE use and confirm safety equipment.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 施工架組配作業於紮緊、拆卸及傳遞構材時，應設寬度多少公分以上之施工架踏板？
questions.q_en: During scaffold assembly (tying, dismantling, passing members), planks of at least what width are required?
questions.explain_zh: 第42條第4款：於紮緊、拆卸及傳遞施工架構材等之作業時，設寬度在二十公分以上之施工架踏板，並採取使勞工使用安全帶等防止墜落之設備與措施；惡劣天候應即停止作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 42(4): planks at least 20 cm wide plus fall protection such as harnesses; stop work in severe weather.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 構築施工架使用之竹材，應以竹尾末梢外徑多少公分以上之圓竹為限？
questions.q_en: Bamboo used for scaffolding must have a tip outer diameter of at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第43條：竹材應以竹尾末梢外徑四公分以上之圓竹為限，不得有裂隙或腐蝕；木材不得有顯著損及強度之裂隙等並應剝除樹皮，不得油漆隱蔽缺陷；鋼材應符合CNS 4750同等以上抗拉強度。
questions.explain_en: Article 43: round bamboo with tip diameter of at least 4 cm, free of cracks or rot; timber must be debarked without strength-reducing defects and not painted to hide flaws; steel per CNS 4750.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 施工架與構造物之連接，其間隔在垂直方向及水平方向分別以不超過多少公尺為限？
questions.a_zh: 垂直二公尺、水平三公尺
questions.b_zh: 垂直三公尺、水平五公尺
questions.c_zh: 垂直九公尺、水平八公尺
questions.d_zh: 垂直五點五公尺、水平七點五公尺
questions.q_en: Scaffold ties to the structure shall be spaced no more than how far vertically and horizontally?
questions.explain_zh: 第45條第3款：施工架在適當之垂直、水平距離處與構造物妥實連接，其間隔在垂直方向以不超過五點五公尺，水平方向以不超過七點五公尺為限。施工架不得與模板支撐連接；獨立施工架拆除前至少三分之一踏腳桁不得移動。
questions.explain_en: Article 45(3): ties at intervals not exceeding 5.5 m vertically and 7.5 m horizontally; scaffolds must not connect to formwork supports; at least one third of ledgers stay until final dismantling.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主得否使勞工在施工架上使用梯子、合梯或踏凳從事作業？
questions.q_en: May workers use ladders, stepladders or stools on scaffolds?
questions.explain_zh: 第47條：雇主不得使勞工在施工架上使用梯子、合梯或踏凳等從事作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 47: workers must not use ladders, stepladders or stools to work on scaffolds.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 高度二公尺以上施工架之工作臺寬度應在多少公分以上？踏板間縫隙不得大於多少公分？
questions.q_en: Work platforms on scaffolds 2 m or higher shall be at least how wide, with plank gaps not exceeding:
questions.explain_zh: 第48條：工作臺寬度應在四十公分以上並舖滿密接之踏板，支撐點二處以上並綁結固定，踏板間縫隙不得大於三公分；工作臺應低於施工架立柱頂點一公尺以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 48: at least 40 cm wide, fully planked with at least two supports and tied down, gaps not over 3 cm; the platform shall be at least 1 m below the top of the standards.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 活動式踏板使用木板時，寬度應在多少公分以上、厚度多少公分以上、長度多少公尺以上？
questions.a_zh: 寬三十公分、厚二公分、長二公尺
questions.b_zh: 寬十五公分、厚五公分、長四公尺
questions.c_zh: 寬四十公分、厚六公分、長五公尺
questions.d_zh: 寬二十公分、厚三點五公分、長三點六公尺
questions.q_en: Loose wooden scaffold planks shall be at least how wide, thick and long?
questions.d_en: 20 cm wide, 3.5 cm thick, 3.6 m long
questions.explain_zh: 第48條第3款：活動式踏板使用木板時，寬度二十公分以上、厚度三點五公分以上、長度三點六公尺以上；寬度大於三十公分時厚度六公分以上、長度四公尺以上；板端突出支撐點十公分以上但不大於板長十八分之一；重疊部分不得小於二十公分。
questions.explain_en: Article 48(3): at least 20 cm × 3.5 cm × 3.6 m (if wider than 30 cm: 6 cm thick and 4 m long); overhang 10 cm or more but not over 1/18 of length; overlaps at least 20 cm.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 施工架任一處步行至最近上下設備之距離，應在多少公尺以下？
questions.q_en: From any point on a scaffold, the walking distance to the nearest access (ladder/stair) shall not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第51條：於施工架上設置人員上下設備時，應檢查穩固性並將上下設備架設處之立柱與建築物牢固連接；施工架任一處步行至最近上下設備之距離應在三十公尺以下。
questions.explain_en: Article 51: the standards at access points shall be tied to the building; walking distance from any point to the nearest access shall be 30 m or less.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 懸吊式施工架之吊纜或懸吊鋼索安全係數應在多少以上？吊鈎安全係數應在多少以上？
questions.q_en: For suspended scaffolds, the safety factor of suspension ropes and of hooks shall be at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第56條第3款：吊纜或懸吊鋼索之安全係數應在十以上，吊鈎之安全係數應在五以上，施工架下方及上方支座之安全係數，鋼材二點五以上、木材五以上。每一橫梁應有三處以上懸吊點。
questions.explain_en: Article 56(3): suspension ropes at least 10, hooks at least 5, supports 2.5 for steel and 5 for timber; each beam needs three or more suspension points.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 棧橋式施工架，下列規定何者正確？
questions.a_zh: 可建於輕型懸吊式施工架之上
questions.c_zh: 不能構築兩層以上，構築高度不得高出地面四公尺以上
questions.q_en: Which is correct for trestle (bridge-type) scaffolds?
questions.a_en: May be built on light suspended scaffolds
questions.c_en: No more than one tier and not higher than 4 m above the floor
questions.explain_zh: 第57條：棧橋式施工架寬度應使工作臺留有足夠運送物料及人員通行空間；架設牢固；不能構築兩層以上；構築高度不得高出地面或地板四公尺以上；不得建於輕型懸吊式施工架之上。
questions.explain_en: Article 57: wide enough for materials and passage, firmly erected, not more than one tier, not over 4 m above floor level, and not built on light suspended scaffolds.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 鋼管施工架之壁連座間距，單管施工架垂直方向及水平方向分別為多少公尺以下？
questions.a_zh: 垂直九公尺、水平八公尺
questions.b_zh: 垂直三公尺、水平四公尺
questions.c_zh: 垂直五公尺、水平五點五公尺
questions.d_zh: 垂直七公尺、水平六公尺
questions.q_en: For tube-and-coupler (single-pipe) steel scaffolds, wall ties shall be spaced at most how far vertically and horizontally?
questions.explain_zh: 第59條第5款表：單管施工架垂直五公尺、水平五點五公尺；框式施工架（高度未滿五公尺者除外）垂直九公尺、水平八公尺。移動式施工架勞工作業時腳部應固定，不得移動施工架。
questions.explain_en: Article 59(5) table: single-pipe scaffolds 5 m vertical / 5.5 m horizontal; frame scaffolds (except under 5 m high) 9 m / 8 m. Mobile scaffolds must have wheels locked and not be moved with workers on them.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 單管式鋼管施工架之立柱間距，縱向及梁間方向分別應在多少公尺以下？立柱載重以多少公斤為限？
questions.a_zh: 縱向三公尺、梁間二公尺；六百公斤
questions.b_zh: 縱向一點八五公尺、梁間一點五公尺；四百公斤
questions.c_zh: 縱向二公尺、梁間二公尺；五百公斤
questions.d_zh: 縱向一點五公尺、梁間一公尺；三百公斤
questions.q_en: For single-pipe steel scaffolds, standards shall be spaced at most how far longitudinally and transversely, and the load per standard limited to:
questions.explain_zh: 第60條：立柱之間距縱向為一點八五公尺以下，梁間方向為一點五公尺以下；橫檔垂直間距不得大於二公尺；立柱上端量起三十一公尺以下部分應使用二根鋼管；立柱之載重應以四百公斤為限。
questions.explain_en: Article 60: standards at most 1.85 m longitudinally and 1.5 m transversely; ledgers not more than 2 m apart vertically; double standards for the top 31 m; load per standard limited to 400 kg.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 框式鋼管式施工架，應於最上層及每隔幾層設置水平梁？高度超過二十公尺者主框架應在多少公尺以下？
questions.a_zh: 每隔二層；二點五公尺以下
questions.d_zh: 每隔十層；一點五公尺以下
questions.q_en: Frame scaffolds shall have horizontal beams at the top and every how many tiers, and when over 20 m high the main frames shall be no taller than:
questions.explain_zh: 第61條：最上層及每隔五層應設置水平梁；框架與托架應以水平牽條或鉤件防止水平滑動；高度超過二十公尺及架上載有物料者，主框架應在二公尺以下且其間距應保持在一點八五公尺以下。
questions.explain_en: Article 61: horizontal beams at the top and every 5 tiers; when over 20 m or loaded with materials, main frames not over 2 m high and spaced 1.85 m or less.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 施工構臺遭遇強風、大雨或幾級以上地震後，使勞工作業前應確認主要構材狀況？
questions.q_en: After strong wind, heavy rain or an earthquake of what intensity or greater must a work platform's main members be checked before work resumes?
questions.explain_zh: 第62條之2：施工構臺遭遇強風、大雨等惡劣氣候或四級以上地震後，或局部解體、變更後，作業前應確認支柱滑動下沉、構材損傷、覆工板狀況、連結部分鬆動、護欄等，異常未改善前不得作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 62-2: after severe weather, an intensity-4 or stronger earthquake, or partial dismantling/modification, check for settlement, damage, deck condition, loose connections and guardrails before work.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 以人工開挖露天開挖作業，砂質土壤地層之開挖面傾斜度不得大於水平與垂直多少之比？開挖面高度不超過多少公尺？
questions.b_zh: 一比一（四十五度）；二公尺
questions.c_zh: 一．五比一（三十五度）；五公尺
questions.q_en: For manual open excavation in sandy soil, the slope shall not exceed what horizontal-to-vertical ratio, and the face height not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第64條：砂質土壤開挖面傾斜度不得大於水平一．五與垂直一之比（三十五度），高度不超過五公尺；因爆破易崩壞之地層不得大於一比一（四十五度），高度不超過二公尺；岩磐未滿五公尺九十度以下、五公尺以上七十五度以下。
questions.explain_en: Article 64: sandy soil 1.5H:1V (35°) up to 5 m; blast-loosened strata 1:1 (45°) up to 2 m; rock under 5 m up to 90°, 5 m or more up to 75°.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 露天開挖作業，作業前、大雨或幾級以上地震後，應指定專人確認地面有無龜裂、湧水等情形？
questions.q_en: Before open excavation work, and after heavy rain or an earthquake of what intensity, must a designated person check the ground for cracks and seepage?
questions.explain_zh: 第65條第1款：作業前、大雨或四級以上地震後，應指定專人確認作業地點及其附近之地面有無龜裂、湧水、土壤含水狀況、地層變化等，並採取必要安全措施；開挖土石不得堆積於開挖面上方或坡肩寬度範圍內。
questions.explain_en: Article 65(1): before work and after heavy rain or an intensity-4 or stronger earthquake; excavated soil must not be piled above the face or within a shoulder width equal to the face height.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 露天開挖作業，開挖垂直深度達多少公尺以上者，應指定露天開挖作業主管？
questions.q_en: An open-excavation work supervisor must be designated when the vertical depth reaches at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第66條：為防止土石崩塌應指定專人於現場辦理；開挖垂直深度達一點五公尺以上者，應指定露天開挖作業主管，決定作業方法、實施檢點、監督防護具使用、確認設備有效狀況等。
questions.explain_en: Article 66: a designated person is required; at vertical depth of 1.5 m or more, an open-excavation work supervisor must direct methods, inspect, supervise PPE and confirm safety equipment.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 以機械從事露天開挖作業，車輛機械應裝設何種裝置以警示周遭人員？
questions.d_zh: 倒車或旋轉之警示燈及蜂鳴器
questions.q_en: Machinery used for open excavation shall be fitted with what to warn nearby workers?
questions.explain_zh: 第69條：應規劃施工方法避免損壞地下埋設物；事前決定運行路線並告知勞工；指派專人指揮防止翻覆；嚴禁操作人員以外之勞工進入操作半徑；車輛機械應裝設倒車或旋轉之警示燈及蜂鳴器。
questions.explain_en: Article 69: plan methods to avoid damaging utilities, set routes and inform workers, assign a director, bar others from the operating radius, and fit reversing/rotation warning lights and buzzers.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 露天開挖深度在多少公尺以上，使勞工進入開挖面作業者，應設擋土支撐？
questions.q_en: Shoring is required when workers enter an open excavation of at least what depth?
questions.explain_zh: 第71條：開挖深度在一點五公尺以上，使勞工進入開挖面作業者，應設擋土支撐。但地質特殊或採取替代方法，經專任工程人員或執業技師簽認其安全性者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 71: at 1.5 m or deeper, shoring is required, unless special geology or an alternative method is certified safe by a full-time engineer or licensed professional.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 擋土支撐之構築，壓力構材之接頭應採何種方式？
questions.q_en: In shoring construction, joints of compression members shall be:
questions.explain_zh: 第73條第5款：壓力構材之接頭應採對接，並應加設護材；支撐接頭應墊承鈑並以螺栓或焊接固定；不得以支撐及橫檔作為施工架或承載重物；擋土支撐應由專任工程人員或執業技師依土壤力學設計簽章。
questions.explain_en: Article 73(5): butt joints with added protective members; joints seated on bearing plates and bolted or welded; struts and wales must not serve as scaffolds or carry loads; design by a full-time engineer or licensed professional.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 擋土支撐設置後開挖進行中，除指定專人確認地層變化外，應每隔多久或於何種情況後實施檢查？
questions.a_zh: 每週或四級以上地震後
questions.b_zh: 每季或六級以上地震後
questions.c_zh: 每日或三級以上地震後
questions.d_zh: 每月或五級以上地震後
questions.q_en: After shoring is installed, inspections are required at what interval or after what event?
questions.a_en: Weekly or after an intensity-4 or stronger earthquake
questions.explain_zh: 第75條：於每週或於四級以上地震後，或因大雨等致地層有急劇變化之虞，或觀測系統顯示土壓變化未按預期時，檢查構材損傷變形、支撐桿鬆緊、連接部分狀況；有異狀應即補強。
questions.explain_en: Article 75: weekly, after an intensity-4+ earthquake, after heavy rain likely to change strata, or when monitoring shows unexpected earth pressure; check for damage, strut tightness and connections.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 傾斜地面上之開挖作業，二人以上同時作業時應如何？
questions.d_zh: 切實保持連繫，並指派其中一人擔任領班指揮作業
questions.q_en: When two or more workers excavate on sloping ground at the same time, they shall:
questions.c_en: Be directed by the most junior worker
questions.d_en: Keep in close contact, with one designated as foreman to direct the work
questions.explain_zh: 第79條：不得使勞工同時在不同高度之地點從事作業（已採保護措施者除外）；隨時清除開挖面土石方；二人以上同時作業應切實保持連繫並指派其中一人擔任領班指揮；有墜落之虞應使用安全帶。
questions.explain_en: Article 79: no simultaneous work at different heights without protection; clear loose material continuously; two or more workers must maintain contact with one designated foreman; use harnesses where fall risk exists.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 隧道、坑道開挖作業，雇主應於勞工進出隧道、坑道時如何辦理？
questions.q_en: For tunnel excavation, what must the employer do when workers enter and exit the tunnel?
questions.explain_zh: 第80條：事前實施地質調查並繪出詳圖；依調查結果訂定施工計畫（開挖方法、支撐、換氣、照明、搬運、通訊、防火、湧水處理等）；雇主應於勞工進出隧道、坑道時予以清點或登記。
questions.explain_en: Article 80: geological survey with detailed drawings; a construction plan covering excavation method, support, ventilation, lighting, transport, communication, fire and water inflow; workers counted or registered on entry and exit.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 隧道、坑道作業之勞工應佩戴安全帽並穿著何種服裝？
questions.c_zh: 反光背心或具反光標示之服裝
questions.q_en: Tunnel workers shall wear helmets and what clothing?
questions.c_en: Reflective vests or clothing with reflective markings
questions.explain_zh: 第87條：應使作業勞工佩戴安全帽、穿著反光背心或具反光標示之服裝及其他必要防護具，並置備緊急搶救器材、吊升搶救設施、安全燈、呼吸防護器材、氣體檢知警報系統、通訊信號及備用電源。
questions.explain_en: Article 87: helmets, reflective vests or clothing, other PPE; plus emergency rescue equipment, hoisting rescue facilities, safety lamps, respiratory protection, gas detection alarms, communication signals and backup power.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 隧道、坑道之鋼拱支撐，支撐組之間隔應在多少公尺以下？
questions.q_en: Steel arch supports in tunnels shall be spaced no more than:
questions.explain_zh: 第93條：鋼拱支撐組之間隔應在一．五公尺以下（以噴凝土或岩栓支撐岩體荷重者除外）；使用連接螺栓、連接桿或斜撐將主構材連接；防止縱向傾倒；設襯板防止土石崩塌。
questions.explain_en: Article 93: steel arch sets spaced 1.5 m or less (except where shotcrete or rock bolts carry the load), connected with bolts, rods or braces, braced against longitudinal tipping, with lagging against collapse.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 隧道、坑道開挖作業，豎坑深度超過多少公尺者，應設專供人員緊急出坑之安全吊升設備？
questions.q_en: For tunnel work, a dedicated emergency hoist for evacuating personnel is required when a shaft is deeper than:
questions.explain_zh: 第98條：豎坑深度超過二十公尺者，應設專供人員緊急出坑之安全吊升設備。第99條：應於每五百公尺設置與外界隨時保持正常通訊之有線通訊設備。
questions.explain_en: Article 98: shafts deeper than 20 m need a dedicated safe emergency hoist; Article 99 requires wired communication with the outside every 500 m.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 以潛盾工法施工之隧道開挖作業，下列何者正確？
questions.b_zh: 柴油引擎以外之內燃機不得在隧道內使用
questions.c_zh: 汽油引擎可在隧道內使用
questions.d_zh: 未經許可可攜帶打火機進入
questions.q_en: For shield-tunneling work, which is correct?
questions.b_en: Internal combustion engines other than diesel must not be used in the tunnel
questions.c_en: Gasoline engines may be used in the tunnel
questions.d_en: Lighters may be brought in without permission
questions.explain_zh: 第101條：未經許可禁止在隧道內進行氣體熔接、熔斷或電焊；未經許可禁止攜帶火柴、打火機等火源進入；柴油引擎以外之內燃機不得在隧道內使用。
questions.explain_en: Article 101: no gas welding/cutting or arc welding without permission; no matches, lighters or other ignition sources without permission; no internal combustion engines other than diesel.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 沉箱、沉筒、井筒內部開挖作業，刃口至頂版或梁底之淨距應在多少公尺以上？刃口下端不得下挖多少公分以上？
questions.q_en: Inside caissons or open-well shafts, the clear distance from the cutting edge to the roof slab shall be at least, and digging below the cutting edge shall not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第103條：依下沉關係圖決定開挖方法及載重量；刃口至頂版或梁底之淨距應在一點八公尺以上；刃口下端不得下挖五十公分以上。第104條：開挖深度超過二十公尺應設通信系統及換氣裝置。
questions.explain_en: Article 103: at least 1.8 m clear from cutting edge to slab or beam soffit; no digging more than 50 cm below the cutting edge; Article 104: over 20 m deep requires communication and ventilation.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 藉壓氣沉箱、壓氣潛盾等施工法作業時，應選任何種主管？
questions.q_en: For compressed-air caisson or shield work, which supervisor must be appointed?
questions.explain_zh: 第106條：應選任高壓室內作業主管，告知可燃物在高氣壓下之危險性、禁止攜帶火源、禁止氣體熔接電焊、禁止可能產生火花之機械與電源開關、規定穿著不易引起靜電之服裝、離開時依異常氣壓危害預防標準辦理。
questions.explain_en: Article 106: a hyperbaric (compressed-air) work supervisor who informs workers of fire risk under pressure, bans ignition sources, welding, spark-producing tools and switches, requires anti-static clothing, and applies decompression rules.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 基樁等施工設備之捲揚鋼纜，下列何種情形不得使用？
questions.q_en: Which hoisting wire rope on piling equipment must NOT be used?
questions.explain_zh: 第110條：有接頭者、鋼纜一撚間有百分之十以上素線截斷者、直徑減少達公稱直徑百分之七以上者、已扭結者、有顯著變形或腐蝕者，不得使用。第111條：捲胴上至少保留二卷以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 110: ropes with joints, 10% or more broken wires in one lay, diameter reduced 7% or more, kinks, or significant deformation/corrosion are prohibited; Article 111: keep at least two wraps on the drum.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 基樁等施工設備捲揚裝置之捲胴軸與頭一個環槽滑輪軸間之距離，應保持在捲胴寬度多少倍以上？
questions.q_en: On piling equipment, the distance between the winch drum axis and the first sheave axis shall be at least how many times the drum width?
questions.explain_zh: 第115條：應將捲揚裝置之捲胴軸與頭一個環槽滑輪軸間之距離，保持在捲揚裝置之捲胴寬度十五倍以上；環槽滑輪應通過捲胴中心且置於軸之垂直面上。
questions.explain_en: Article 115: at least 15 times the drum width, with the sheave passing through the drum center in the vertical plane of the axis.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 基樁等施工設備之作業，應訂定一定信號並如何辦理？
questions.c_zh: 指派專人於作業時從事傳達信號工作
questions.q_en: For piling equipment operations, fixed signals shall be established and:
questions.c_en: A designated person assigned to relay signals during work
questions.explain_zh: 第123條：應訂定一定信號，並指派專人於作業時從事傳達信號工作；操作者應遵從該信號。第124條：裝配、解體、變更或移動作業應指派專人依安全作業標準指揮。
questions.explain_en: Article 123: fixed signals with a designated signal person whom the operator must obey; Article 124: assembly, dismantling, modification or moving requires a designated person directing per safe work standards.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 吊運長度超過多少公尺之鋼筋時，應在適當距離之二端以吊鏈鈎住或拉索捆紮拉緊？
questions.q_en: When hoisting rebar longer than what must both ends be hooked or tied with tag lines to prevent swinging?
questions.explain_zh: 第129條第5款：吊運長度超過五公尺之鋼筋時，應在適當距離之二端以吊鏈鈎住或拉索捆紮拉緊，保持平穩以防擺動；搬運鋼筋應戴手套；鋼筋不得散放於施工架上；禁止以鋼筋作為拉索支持物或工作架。
questions.explain_en: Article 129(5): rebar over 5 m long must be hooked or tied at both ends; wear gloves when handling; do not scatter rebar on scaffolds; do not use rebar as guy supports or work frames.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 高度在七公尺以上且面積達多少平方公尺以上之模板支撐，其構築及拆除應由專任工程人員或執業技師依結構力學設計並簽章？
questions.q_en: Formwork supports 7 m or higher with an area of at least how much require structural design signed by a full-time engineer or licensed professional?
questions.explain_zh: 第131條第1款：高度在七公尺以上且面積達三百三十平方公尺以上之模板支撐，應由專任工程人員或委由執業技師依結構力學原理設計，置備施工圖說及強度計算書並簽章；訂定混凝土澆置計畫及查驗機制。
questions.explain_en: Article 131(1): 7 m or higher and 330 m² or more require design, drawings and calculations signed by a full-time engineer or licensed professional, plus a pouring plan and verification mechanism.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 模板支撐組配、拆除作業，應指派何種主管於作業現場辦理？
questions.q_en: Assembly and dismantling of formwork supports requires which supervisor on site?
questions.explain_zh: 第133條：模板支撐組配、拆除作業應指派模板支撐作業主管於作業現場決定作業方法、實施檢點、監督防護具使用、確認設備有效狀況、管制人員進入。
questions.explain_en: Article 133: a formwork support work supervisor to decide methods, inspect, supervise PPE, confirm safety equipment and control entry.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 以可調鋼管支柱為模板支撐之支柱時，下列何者正確？
questions.a_zh: 可連接使用以增加高度
questions.b_zh: 調整高度可用鋼筋替代插銷
questions.c_zh: 可調鋼管支柱不得連接使用；高度超過三點五公尺者每隔二公尺內設水平繫條
questions.q_en: When adjustable steel pipe props are used as formwork supports, which is correct?
questions.a_en: Props may be joined to gain height
questions.b_en: Rebar may replace the adjustment pin
questions.c_en: Props must not be joined end-to-end; over 3.5 m high, horizontal bracing every 2 m
questions.explain_zh: 第135條：可調鋼管支柱不得連接使用；高度超過三點五公尺者，每隔二公尺內設置縱向、橫向水平繫條並與構造物連結；調整高度應以制式金屬附屬配件為之，不得以鋼筋等替代；上端支以貫材時應置鋼製頂板或托架。
questions.explain_en: Article 135: no end-to-end joining; over 3.5 m, longitudinal and transverse horizontal ties within every 2 m connected to the structure; adjust only with standard metal fittings, never rebar; steel head plates under beams.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 以木材為模板支撐之支柱時，每一支柱最多僅能有幾處接頭？每根支柱之淨高不得超過多少公尺？
questions.q_en: Timber formwork props may have at most how many joints per prop, and a clear height not exceeding:
questions.explain_zh: 第138條：木材以連接方式使用時，每一支柱最多僅能有一處接頭，對接時應以二個以上牽引板固定；每根支柱之淨高不得超過四公尺；木材支柱最小斷面積應大於三十一點五平方公分；每二公尺內設水平繫條。
questions.explain_en: Article 138: at most one joint per prop (butt joints fixed with two or more cleats); clear height not over 4 m; minimum section over 31.5 cm²; horizontal ties every 2 m.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 混凝土澆置作業使用起重機具吊運混凝土桶時，其擺動夾角不得超過幾度？
questions.q_en: When hoisting concrete buckets with a crane, the swing angle shall not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第142條第5款：混凝土桶之載重量不得超過容許限度，其擺動夾角不得超過四十度；禁止勞工乘坐於混凝土澆置桶上及位於輸送管下方作業；吊運桶下方禁止人員進入。
questions.explain_en: Article 142(5): swing angle not over 40°; no riding on buckets or working under delivery pipes; no one beneath hoisted buckets.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 鋼構吊運長度超過多少公尺之構架時，應在二端以拉索捆紮拉緊？使用多少公尺以上長跨度格柵梁時應安裝臨時構件？
questions.q_en: Steel members longer than what require tag lines at both ends when hoisted, and long-span joists of what length require temporary members before releasing the hoist?
questions.explain_zh: 第148條：吊運長度超過六公尺之構架應在適當距離之二端以拉索捆紮拉緊；鋼梁於最後安裝吊索鬆放前，二端腹鈑接頭應有二個以上螺栓裝妥；使用十二公尺以上長跨度格柵梁或桁架時於鬆放吊索前應安裝臨時構件。
questions.explain_en: Article 148: members over 6 m need tag lines at both ends; beams need at least two bolts at each web connection before releasing; joists or trusses 12 m or longer need temporary bracing before releasing the hoist.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 營造標準第149條所定應指派鋼構組配作業主管之「鋼構」，其範圍包括高度在多少公尺以上之鋼構建築物？橋梁跨距多少公尺以上之金屬橋梁上部結構？
questions.q_en: The 'steel structures' requiring a steel erection supervisor under Article 149 include steel buildings of at least what height, and metal bridge superstructures of at least what span?
questions.explain_zh: 第149條：鋼構範圍包括高度五公尺以上之鋼構建築物、高度五公尺以上之鐵塔或金屬煙囪、高度五公尺以上或跨距三十公尺以上之金屬橋梁上部結構、塔式起重機、人字臂起重桿、室外升降機升降路塔、金屬施工構臺。
questions.explain_en: Article 149: steel buildings ≥5 m, towers or chimneys ≥5 m, metal bridge superstructures ≥5 m high or ≥30 m span, tower cranes, derricks, exterior hoist towers and metal work platforms.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 鋼構組配進行組合時，於最高永久性樓板上組合之骨架，不得超過幾層？
questions.q_en: During steel erection, the frame assembled above the highest permanent floor shall not exceed how many stories?
questions.explain_zh: 第150條：應逐次構築永久性之樓板，於最高永久性樓板上組合之骨架不得超過八層（設計已考慮整體安全性者除外）。第152條：地面或最高永久性樓板層上不得有超過四層樓以上之鋼構尚未鉚接、熔接或螺栓緊者。
questions.explain_en: Article 150: not more than 8 stories above the highest permanent floor (unless overall stability is designed for); Article 152: no more than 4 stories of steel may remain unriveted, unwelded or unbolted.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 不適於舖設臨時性構臺之鋼構建築，未使用施工架而落距差超過幾層樓或多少公尺以上者，應張設安全網？
questions.q_en: For steel buildings without temporary decks or scaffolds, safety nets are required when the potential fall exceeds:
questions.explain_zh: 第151條第2款：落距差超過二層樓或七點五公尺以上者應張設安全網，其下方應有足夠淨空；安全網使用前須確認已實施耐衝擊試驗。第3款：鋼梁正下方二層樓或七點五公尺高度內應安裝密實舖板。
questions.explain_en: Article 151(2): nets when the fall distance exceeds 2 stories or 7.5 m, with adequate clearance below and impact testing verified; item 3: solid decking within 2 stories or 7.5 m below beams being worked on.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 拆除構造物前，下列何者為應辦理事項？
questions.b_zh: 保持電源以便使用電動工具
questions.d_zh: 切斷電源並拆除配電設備及線路；切斷可燃性氣體管、蒸汽管或水管
questions.q_en: Before demolishing a structure, which is required?
questions.b_en: Keep power on for power tools
questions.d_en: Cut off power and remove electrical equipment and wiring; cut off gas, steam and water pipes
questions.explain_zh: 第155條：檢查預定拆除之各構件；不穩定部分予以支撐；切斷電源並拆除配電設備及線路；切斷可燃性氣體管、蒸汽管或水管，殘存氣體應安全釋放；設置圍柵或標示禁止非作業人員進入；鄰近通道人員保護設施完成前不得拆除。
questions.explain_en: Article 155: inspect members; support unstable parts; cut power and remove wiring; cut gas, steam and water lines and safely release residual gas; fence and post signs; protect adjacent passages first.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 拆除構造物時，拆除順序應如何？
questions.b_zh: 按序由上而下逐步拆除
questions.q_en: In what order shall a structure be demolished?
questions.explain_zh: 第157條：不得使勞工同時在不同高度拆除（有適當設施者除外）；應按序由上而下逐步拆除；拆除材料不得過度堆積或靠牆堆放；惡劣氣候應停止；有塵土飛揚應灑水；拉倒方式應使勞工退避。
questions.explain_en: Article 157: no simultaneous work at different heights without protection; demolish top-down in sequence; do not over-stack or lean debris against walls; stop in severe weather; sprinkle water for dust; keep workers clear when pulling down.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 使用重力錘拆除構造物時，應以撞擊點為中心，構造物高度幾倍以上之距離為半徑設置作業區？使用夾斗或曲臂機具時，作業區周圍應大於運行線多少公尺以上？
questions.q_en: When demolishing with a wrecking ball, the work zone radius shall be at least how many times the structure height, and for grapples or articulated arms the zone shall extend beyond the travel line by at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第159條：使用重力錘時應以撞擊點為中心、構造物高度一點五倍以上之距離為半徑設置作業區；使用夾斗或曲臂機具時，作業區周圍應大於夾斗或曲臂運行線八公尺以上；作業區內除操作人員外禁止進入。
questions.explain_en: Article 159: wrecking ball zone radius ≥1.5× the structure height centered on the impact point; grapple/articulated-arm zone ≥8 m beyond the travel line; only operators inside.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 未能設置作業區時，於拆除構造物外牆邊緣設置之承受臺，其寬度應在多少公尺以上？應能承受每平方公尺多少公斤以上之活載重？
questions.q_en: Where a demolition work zone cannot be set up, catch platforms at the outer wall shall be at least how wide and support a live load of at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第160條：承受臺寬應在一點五公尺以上；臺面應由外向內傾斜且密舖板料；應能承受每平方公尺六百公斤以上之活載重；臺面距拆除層位之高度不超過二層（拆除層位距地面三層以下者除外）。
questions.explain_en: Article 160: at least 1.5 m wide, sloped inward and fully planked, supporting at least 600 kg/m² live load, and no more than two stories below the demolition level.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 以人工拆除高煙囪時，施工架之工作臺不得高出煙囪頂多少公分及低於多少公尺？
questions.q_en: When manually demolishing a tall chimney, the scaffold work platform shall not be more than how far above the chimney top, nor more than how far below it?
questions.explain_zh: 第164條：指派專人監督；不得以爆破或整體翻倒方式拆除高煙囪（四週有足夠地面者除外）；人工拆除應設施工架，工作臺不得高出煙囪頂二十五公分及低於一．五公尺；不得使勞工站立於煙囪壁頂；煙囪底部應有開孔防物料積集。
questions.explain_en: Article 164: a designated supervisor; no blasting or toppling unless there is enough clear ground; platforms not more than 25 cm above nor 1.5 m below the top; no standing on the chimney wall; a bottom opening to prevent debris build-up.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 噴漆作業場所，下列何者正確？
questions.b_zh: 可使用加熱器加速乾燥
questions.c_zh: 不得有明火、加熱器或其他火源，並揭示嚴禁煙火標示
questions.q_en: In spray-painting areas, which is correct?
questions.b_en: Heaters may be used to speed drying
questions.c_en: No open flames, heaters or other ignition sources, with 'No fire' signs posted
questions.explain_zh: 第166條：油漆作業場所應有適當通風換氣。第167條：噴漆作業場所不得有明火、加熱器或其他火源發生之虞之裝置或作業，並在該範圍內揭示嚴禁煙火之標示。
questions.explain_en: Article 166 requires ventilation in painting areas; Article 167 prohibits open flames, heaters or ignition sources in spray-painting areas, with 'no fire' signs posted.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 營造工程之臨時房舍，下列何者正確？
questions.a_zh: 寢室與廚房可共用同一空間
questions.c_zh: 應選擇乾燥及排水良好之地點搭建，用餐地點、寢室及盥洗設備應分設
questions.q_en: For temporary site accommodation, which is correct?
questions.a_en: Bedrooms and kitchen may share one space
questions.c_en: Build on dry, well-drained ground; dining, sleeping and washing areas kept separate
questions.d_en: Drinking water need not meet standards
questions.explain_zh: 第172條：選擇乾燥及排水良好之地點搭建；適當通風及照明；使用合於飲用水衛生標準之飲用水及洗濯用水；用餐地點、寢室及盥洗設備應分設並保持清潔；設置冰箱、食品貯存及廢物處理等衛生設備。
questions.explain_en: Article 172: dry, well-drained sites; ventilation and lighting; water meeting drinking-water standards; separate dining, sleeping and washing areas kept clean; refrigerators, food storage and waste facilities.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 受工作場所負責人指揮或監督從事勞動之人員，於事業單位工作場所從事勞動時，是否適用營造安全衛生設施標準？
questions.d_zh: 比照該事業單位之勞工適用
questions.q_en: Do the Standards apply to persons working under the direction or supervision of a workplace manager at an enterprise's site?
questions.d_en: Yes, they are treated like the enterprise's own laborers
questions.explain_zh: 第173條之1：自營作業者獨立作業或以其作業交付承攬時，適用本標準有關雇主義務之規定；受工作場所負責人指揮或監督從事勞動之人員，比照該事業單位之勞工，適用本標準之規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 173-1: self-employed persons are subject to the employer obligations; persons working under a workplace manager's direction are treated like that enterprise's laborers.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 機械設備器具安全標準所稱「快速停止機構」，係指衝剪機械之何種機構？
questions.a_zh: 防止滑塊意外下降之安全擋塊
questions.b_zh: 檢出危險或異常時，能自動停止滑塊等動作之機構
questions.c_zh: 手推刨床之覆蓋自動開閉裝置
questions.d_zh: 以人為操作使滑塊緊急停止之裝置
questions.q_en: Under the Machinery, Equipment and Tools Safety Standards, a 'quick-stop mechanism' of a press/shear is:
questions.a_en: A safety block preventing accidental slide descent
questions.b_en: A mechanism that automatically stops the slide when danger or abnormality is detected
questions.c_en: A planer cover that opens and closes automatically
questions.d_en: A device stopping the slide by manual operation in an emergency
questions.explain_zh: 第3條：快速停止機構指衝剪機械檢出危險或異常時，能自動停止滑塊、刀具或撞錘動作之機構；緊急停止裝置則指以人為操作使滑塊等緊急停止之裝置；可動式接觸預防裝置為手推刨床覆蓋隨加工材進給自動開閉之裝置。
questions.explain_en: Article 3: a quick-stop mechanism automatically stops the slide, blade or ram on detecting danger; an emergency stop device stops it by human operation; a movable contact-prevention device is a planer cover that opens/closes with the workpiece feed.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 衝剪機械之「安全模」，其上死點之上模與下模之間等構件間隙應在多少毫米以下？
questions.q_en: For a press 'safety die', the gap between upper and lower dies at top dead center shall be no more than:
questions.explain_zh: 第5條第2款：安全模之上死點上模與下模之間、上模與脫料板之間、導柱與軸襯之間，其間隙應在八毫米以下；安全護圍應使手指不致通過或自外側觸及危險界限。
questions.explain_en: Article 5(2): gaps between upper and lower die at top dead center, between upper die and stripper plate, and between guide posts and bushings shall be 8 mm or less; safety enclosures must keep fingers from reaching the danger zone.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 下列何者不屬於機械標準第6條所定衝剪機械安全裝置之機能類型？
questions.q_en: Which is NOT a type of press safety device under Article 6?
questions.explain_zh: 第6條四類：連鎖防護式、雙手操作式（安全一行程式、雙手起動式）、感應式、拉開式或掃除式安全裝置；並應具有安全機能不易減損及變更之構造。
questions.explain_en: Article 6 lists four types: interlocking guard, two-hand control (safety single-stroke and two-hand start), presence-sensing, and pull-back or sweep-away devices, all with tamper-resistant construction.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 「安全一行程式」與「雙手起動式」雙手操作式安全裝置之差異為何？
questions.a_zh: 安全一行程式於脫手後至手達到危險界限前能使滑塊停止；雙手起動式則於手離開時使手無法達到危險界限
questions.c_zh: 安全一行程式只能單手操作
questions.q_en: What distinguishes a 'safety single-stroke' from a 'two-hand start' two-hand control device?
questions.a_en: Safety single-stroke stops the slide before a released hand reaches the danger zone; two-hand start ensures the hand cannot reach it during closing
questions.explain_zh: 第6條第2款：安全一行程式在手指離開操作部後至該手達到危險界限前，能使滑塊等停止動作；雙手起動式以雙手作動操作部，於滑塊閉合動作中手離開操作部時使手無法達到危險界限。
questions.explain_en: Article 6(2): safety single-stroke stops the slide after a hand leaves the control before it can reach the danger zone; two-hand start ensures a released hand cannot reach the danger zone while the slide closes.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 安全一行程雙手操作式安全裝置之安全距離計算公式為何？
questions.q_en: The safety distance formula for a safety single-stroke two-hand control device is:
questions.explain_zh: 第8條：安全一行程雙手操作式 D=1.6(Tl+Ts)，Tl為手離開操作部至快速停止機構開始動作之時間、Ts為快速停止機構動作至滑塊停止之時間（毫秒），D單位毫米；雙手起動式 D=1.6Tm；光電式 D=1.6(Tl+Ts)+C。
questions.explain_en: Article 8: safety single-stroke D = 1.6(Tl + Ts) with Tl = time from hand release to quick-stop actuation and Ts = actuation to slide stop (ms), D in mm; two-hand start D = 1.6Tm; photoelectric D = 1.6(Tl + Ts) + C.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 光電式安全裝置安全距離公式中之追加距離C，連續遮光幅在三十毫米以下者，C值為多少毫米？
questions.q_en: In the photoelectric safety-distance formula, the additional distance C for a continuous light-shielding width of 30 mm or less is:
questions.explain_zh: 第8條表：連續遮光幅30毫米以下 C=0；超過30至35毫米 C=200；超過35至45毫米 C=300；超過45至50毫米 C=400。

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 雙手操作式安全裝置，左右手動作時間差非在多少秒以內，滑塊等無法動作？兩按鈕外側至少應距離多少毫米以上？
questions.q_en: For two-hand controls, the slide must not operate unless both hands act within what time difference, and buttons must be at least how far apart (outer edges)?
questions.explain_zh: 第10條第4款：左右手之動作時間差非在零點五秒以內，滑塊等無法動作；第6款：一按鈕外側與其他按鈕外側至少距離三百毫米以上（設有護蓋、擋板者得酌減）；按鈕不得凸出按鈕盒表面。
questions.explain_en: Article 10(4): left and right hand actuation within 0.5 s; (6): at least 300 mm between outer edges of buttons (reducible with guards or barriers); buttons must not protrude from the box surface.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 衝壓機械光電式安全裝置之連續遮光幅（檢出機構能感應遮光棒之最小直徑）應在多少毫米以下？
questions.q_en: For press photoelectric safety devices, the continuous light-shielding width (minimum detectable rod diameter) shall be no more than:
questions.explain_zh: 第12條第3款：投光器及受光器之光軸數須二個以上，連續遮光幅在五十毫米以下；具啟動控制功能之光電式安全裝置，其連續遮光幅為三十毫米以下。
questions.explain_en: Article 12(3): at least two beams, with continuous shielding width of 50 mm or less; for devices with start-control function, 30 mm or less.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 使用具起動控制功能之光電式安全裝置之衝剪機械，其台盤水平面須距離地面多少毫米以上？台盤深度須在多少毫米以下？
questions.a_zh: 七百五十毫米；一千毫米
questions.c_zh: 一千毫米；一千五百毫米
questions.q_en: For presses using a photoelectric device with start-control function, the bolster surface shall be at least how far above the floor, and its depth no more than:
questions.explain_zh: 第12條之3：台盤水平面須距離地面七百五十毫米以上（設安全圍柵者除外）；台盤深度須在一千毫米以下；衝程在六百毫米以下；曲軸衝床過定點停止監視裝置停止點設定十五度以內；三十秒內未完成滑塊作動須重新執行起動準備。
questions.explain_en: Article 12-3: bolster at least 750 mm above floor (unless fenced); depth 1,000 mm or less; stroke 600 mm or less; overrun monitor stop within 15°; restart preparation if the slide does not act within 30 s.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 摺床用雷射感應式安全裝置，滑塊等在閉合動作中檢知遮斷光線時，應能將滑塊移動速度降為每秒多少毫米以下（低閉合速度）？
questions.q_en: A press-brake laser safety device shall be able to reduce the slide's closing speed to no more than what per second (low closing speed)?
questions.explain_zh: 第12條之4：檢知身體之一部或加工物遮斷光線，或滑塊到達設定位置仍須繼續動作者，具有能將滑塊移動速度降為每秒十毫米以下（低閉合速度）之構造。
questions.explain_en: Article 12-4: when the beam is interrupted or the slide reaches the set position and must continue, the slide speed shall be reducible to 10 mm/s or less (low closing speed).

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 拉開式安全裝置之牽引帶，其直徑應為多少毫米以上？已安裝調節配件者切斷荷重應在多少公斤以上？
questions.q_en: For pull-back safety devices, the pull cord shall be at least what diameter, and with adjusting fittings have a breaking load of at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第13條：牽引帶牽引量須能調節且為盤床深度二分之一以上；牽引帶材料為合成纖維、直徑四毫米以上、已安裝調節配件者切斷荷重一百五十公斤以上；肘節傳送帶為皮革等材質、連接部能耐五十公斤靜荷重。
questions.explain_en: Article 13: adjustable pull-in of at least half the bolster depth; synthetic-fiber cord at least 4 mm with breaking load of 150 kg or more when fitted with adjusters; leather wristbands whose joints withstand 50 kg static load.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 衝壓機械設置掃除式安全裝置，其每分鐘行程數須在多少以下？行程長度須在多少毫米以上？
questions.a_zh: 一百二十以下；四十毫米以上
questions.b_zh: 一百五十以下；三十毫米以上
questions.c_zh: 六十以下；五十毫米以上
questions.d_zh: 三百以下；二十毫米以上
questions.q_en: A sweep-away safety device may be installed only on presses with strokes per minute of at most, and a stroke length of at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第14條之1：構造屬確動式離合器且雙手操作起動；行程長度四十毫米以上且在防護板寬度以下；每分鐘行程數一百二十以下，始得設置掃除式安全裝置；腳踏式快速停止機構者不得使用掃除式（併用其他安全裝置者除外）。
questions.explain_en: Article 14-1: positive clutch with two-hand start, stroke length 40 mm or more but not over the guard-plate width, and 120 strokes per minute or less; not on foot-operated quick-stop presses unless combined with another safety device.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 衝剪機械安全裝置之操作用電氣回路電壓，應在多少伏特以下？
questions.q_en: The operating circuit voltage of press safety devices shall not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第15條第9款：操作用電氣回路之電壓在一百六十伏特以下；承受作用力之金屬零配件表面硬度洛氏C硬度四十五以上五十以下；電氣零件故障或停電時滑塊不致意外動作。第25條衝壓機械操作用電氣回路亦為一百六十伏特以下。
questions.explain_en: Article 15(9): operating circuits at 160 V or less; load-bearing metal parts hardened to Rockwell C 45–50; no unexpected slide motion on component failure or power loss. Article 25 applies 160 V to press operating circuits too.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 衝壓機械應具有何種機構？
questions.q_en: A press machine shall be equipped with:
questions.explain_zh: 第18條：衝壓機械應具有一行程一停止機構。第19條：衝壓機械應具有快速停止機構（使用確動式離合器、不致使身體介入危險界限之構造者除外）。
questions.explain_en: Article 18: presses shall have a single-stroke single-stop mechanism; Article 19: a quick-stop mechanism, except positive-clutch presses or designs that keep the body out of the danger zone.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 衝壓機械緊急停止裝置之操作部，應為何種型式？
questions.q_en: The actuator of a press emergency stop device shall be:
questions.explain_zh: 第21條：紅色之凸出型按鈕或其他簡易、明顯、迅速有效之人為操作裝置；設置於各操作區；台身兩側最大距離超過一千八百毫米者分別設置於側壁之正面及背面。
questions.explain_en: Article 21: a red protruding button or equally simple, visible and effective manual device, at each operating station; presses wider than 1,800 mm need them on both front and rear of each side.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 衝壓機械之寸動機構，限制滑塊移動速度在每秒多少毫米以下，或每段滑塊移動行程不得超過多少毫米？
questions.q_en: A press inching mechanism shall limit slide speed to no more than what per second, or each inch movement to no more than:
questions.explain_zh: 第22條：寸動機構應具有限制滑塊移動速度在每秒十毫米以下，或限制每段滑塊移動行程不得超過六毫米且未離開操作部無法再起動之構造。
questions.explain_en: Article 22: slide speed limited to 10 mm/s or less, or each inching stroke limited to 6 mm with no restart unless the control is released.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 衝壓機械應具有防止滑塊意外下降之安全擋塊；下列何種衝壓機械得以安全插栓、安全鎖替代？
questions.b_zh: 台盤各邊長度一千五百毫米以上之機械衝床
questions.q_en: Presses need safety blocks against accidental slide descent; which press may use safety plugs or safety locks instead?
questions.b_en: Mechanical presses with bolsters 1,500 mm or larger
questions.d_en: Press brakes (and mechanical presses with bolster under 1,500 mm or die height under 700 mm)
questions.explain_zh: 第23條：摺床，及摺床以外台盤各邊長度未滿一千五百毫米或模高未滿七百毫米之機械衝床，使用安全擋塊有困難者，得使用安全插栓、安全鎖或同等安全功能之裝置；安全插栓配置於每一操作區、安全鎖能遮斷主電動機電源。
questions.explain_en: Article 23: press brakes, and other mechanical presses with bolster sides under 1,500 mm or die height under 700 mm, may use safety plugs (at each station) or safety locks (cutting the main motor power) when blocks are impractical.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 置有滑動銷或滾動鍵離合器之機械衝床，其曲軸偏心軸之停止角度應在幾度以內？
questions.q_en: For mechanical presses with sliding-pin or rolling-key clutches, the crankshaft stopping angle shall be within:
questions.explain_zh: 第37條：曲軸偏心軸之停止角度應在十度以內（不致使身體介入危險界限之構造者除外）。第38條：每分鐘三百轉以下之曲軸衝床應具超限運轉監視裝置，設定停止點停止角度二十五度以內。
questions.explain_en: Article 37: within 10° (except designs that keep the body out of the danger zone); Article 38: crank presses at 300 rpm or less need an overrun monitor with a set stop angle within 25°.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 使用確動式離合器之機械衝床，每分鐘行程數超過一百五十或壓力能力超過一百五十噸者，其快速停止機構應如何？
questions.a_zh: 不得置有快速停止機構
questions.d_zh: 必須置有快速停止機構
questions.q_en: Positive-clutch mechanical presses exceeding 150 strokes per minute or 150 tonnes capacity:
questions.a_en: Must NOT have a quick-stop mechanism
questions.explain_zh: 第43條：確動式離合器每分鐘行程數一百五十以下且壓力能力一百五十噸以下、置有腳踏開關者，應具防止身體介入之構造或快速停止機構；第44條：每分鐘行程數超過一百五十或壓力能力超過一百五十噸者，不得置有快速停止機構。
questions.explain_en: Article 43: positive-clutch presses at ≤150 spm and ≤150 t with foot controls need guarding or a quick-stop; Article 44: those over 150 spm or 150 t must not have a quick-stop mechanism.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 手推刨床刃部接觸預防裝置之覆蓋，其下方與加工材進給側平台面間之間隙應在多少毫米以下？
questions.q_en: On a hand-fed planer, the gap between the cutter guard's underside and the infeed table shall be no more than:
questions.explain_zh: 第50條第2項：覆蓋下方與加工材之進給側平台面間之間隙在八毫米以下；除固定刨削寬度者外應使用可動式接觸預防裝置。第54條：進給側平台與刃部前端之間隙在三毫米以下。
questions.explain_en: Article 50(2): 8 mm or less, using a movable guard except for fixed-width planing; Article 54: the infeed table to cutter-edge gap shall be 3 mm or less.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 手推刨床應設置遮斷動力時可使刀軸停止之制動裝置，但遮斷動力時可於幾秒內停止刀軸旋轉者不在此限？
questions.q_en: Hand-fed planers need a brake unless the cutter shaft stops within how many seconds after power is cut?
questions.explain_zh: 第51條：手推刨床應設置制動裝置，但遮斷動力時可使其於十秒內停止刀軸旋轉者，或使用單相線繞轉子型串激電動機之攜帶用手推刨床，不在此限。第62條圓盤鋸亦同（十秒）。
questions.explain_en: Article 51: a brake is required unless the shaft stops within 10 s, or for portable planers with single-phase series-wound motors; Article 62 applies the same 10 s rule to circular saws.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 手推刨床之刀軸應採用何種型式？
questions.q_en: The cutter shaft of a hand-fed planer shall be of what type?
questions.explain_zh: 第58條：手推刨床之刀軸，應採用圓胴。第56條：刀刃應符合CNS 2904 SKH2規格之鋼料。
questions.explain_en: Article 58: the cutter shaft shall be a round cylinder; Article 56: blades of CNS 2904 SKH2 high-speed steel.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 木材加工用圓盤鋸應設置之安全裝置為何？
questions.b_zh: 反撥預防裝置及鋸齒接觸預防裝置
questions.q_en: Woodworking circular saws shall be fitted with:
questions.b_en: A kickback-prevention device (riving knife) and a blade-contact prevention device (guard)
questions.explain_zh: 第60條：圓盤鋸應設置反撥預防裝置（橫鋸用或反撥不致引起危害者除外）及鋸齒接觸預防裝置（製材用圓盤鋸及設有自動輸送裝置者除外）。
questions.explain_en: Article 60: a kickback-prevention device (except cross-cut saws or where kickback is harmless) and a blade-contact prevention device (except sawmill saws and those with automatic feed).

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 木材加工用圓盤鋸之撐縫片與其面對之圓鋸片鋸齒前端之間隙應在多少毫米以下？
questions.q_en: The gap between the riving knife and the saw-blade teeth on a woodworking circular saw shall be no more than:
questions.explain_zh: 第61條第2款：撐縫片與其面對之圓鋸片鋸齒前端之間隙在十二毫米以下；撐縫片與鋸齒接觸預防裝置應與圓鋸片位於同一平面。第67條：攜帶式圓盤鋸平板外側端與鋸齒距離應在十二毫米以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 61(2): 12 mm or less, with the riving knife and guard in the same plane as the blade; Article 67: portable saw base plates extend at least 12 mm beyond the teeth.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 圓盤鋸撐縫片之厚度應為圓鋸片厚度之幾倍以上？圓鋸片直徑超過多少毫米者應使用懸垂式撐縫片？
questions.b_zh: 一點五倍；四百五十毫米
questions.c_zh: 一點一倍；六百一十毫米
questions.q_en: A riving knife shall be at least how many times the blade thickness, and blades over what diameter require a two-end-fixed (suspended) riving knife?
questions.explain_zh: 第68條：撐縫片厚度為圓鋸片厚度之一點一倍以上；安裝螺栓二個以上並具防鬆脫性能；圓鋸片直徑超過六百一十毫米者應使用懸垂式（兩端固定）撐縫片。第69條：圓鋸片直徑超過四百五十毫米者使用反撥防止爪、輥以外型式之反撥預防裝置。
questions.explain_en: Article 68: at least 1.1× blade thickness, two or more anti-loosening bolts, and blades over 610 mm need a suspended (both-end-fixed) riving knife; Article 69: blades over 450 mm need kickback devices other than anti-kickback fingers or rollers.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 堆高機頂蓬強度應足以承受堆高機最大荷重幾倍之等分布靜荷重（逾四公噸者為四公噸）？上框各開口寬度或長度不得超過多少公分？
questions.q_en: A forklift overhead guard shall withstand a distributed static load of how many times the maximum load (capped at 4 t), with top-frame openings no larger than:
questions.explain_zh: 第79條：頂蓬強度足以承受最大荷重之二倍之等分布靜荷重（其值逾四公噸者為四公噸）；上框各開口寬度或長度不得超過十六公分；座式操作者駕駛座上面至頂蓬下端九十五公分以上；立式操作者一點八公尺以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 79: twice the maximum load (capped at 4 tonnes); openings not over 16 cm; at least 95 cm from seat to guard for seated operation and 1.8 m from floor for standing operation.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 堆高機應於左右各設一個方向指示器，但最高時速未達多少公里且操控方向盤中心至最外側未達六十五公分、機內無駕駛座者得免設？
questions.q_en: Forklifts need turn indicators on both sides, except those with a top speed under what, steering-wheel center to outer edge under 65 cm, and no driver's seat?
questions.explain_zh: 第76條：堆高機應於其左右各設一個方向指示器。但最高時速未達二十公里之堆高機，其操控方向盤之中心至堆高機最外側未達六十五公分，且機內無駕駛座者，得免設方向指示器。第77、78條並應設警報裝置及前後照燈。
questions.explain_en: Article 76: exempt when top speed is under 20 km/h, steering center to outer edge under 65 cm and no onboard seat; Articles 77–78 require alarms and head/rear lights.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 堆高機貨叉在基準承重中心加以最大荷重時，貨叉所生應力值應在該鋼材降伏強度值之幾分之一以下？
questions.q_en: With the maximum load at the standard load center, the stress in forklift forks shall be no more than what fraction of the steel's yield strength?
questions.explain_zh: 第82條：貨叉材料為鋼材且無顯著損傷變形腐蝕；在基準承重中心加以最大荷重時，貨叉所生應力值在該貨叉鋼材降伏強度值之三分之一以下。第83條：裝卸裝置鏈條安全係數應在五以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 82: steel forks free of damage; stress under maximum load at the standard load center no more than one third of yield strength; Article 83: lift chains with a safety factor of 5 or more.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 堆高機裝卸裝置使用之鏈條，其安全係數應在多少以上？
questions.q_en: The safety factor of forklift lift chains shall be at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第83條：堆高機裝卸裝置使用之鏈條，其安全係數應在五以上；安全係數為鏈條之斷裂荷重值除以加諸於鏈條荷重之最大值所得之值。
questions.explain_en: Article 83: at least 5, defined as breaking load divided by the maximum load applied to the chain.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 配衡型堆高機及側舉型堆高機之駕駛座，應配置何種防護設施？
questions.d_zh: 防止車輛傾倒時駕駛者被壓傷之安全帶、護欄或其他防護設施
questions.q_en: Seats of counterbalance and side-loading forklifts shall be fitted with:
questions.d_en: Seat belts, guard rails or other protection against the driver being crushed in a tip-over
questions.explain_zh: 第84條：駕駛座採升降方式者應設扶手及防墜設備；座式操作者駕駛座應使用緩衝材料；配衡型及側舉型堆高機之駕駛座應配置防止車輛傾倒時駕駛者被壓傷之安全帶、護欄或其他防護設施。
questions.explain_en: Article 84: elevating seats need handholds and fall protection; seated forklifts need cushioned seats; counterbalance and side-loaders need seat belts, guard rails or other tip-over crush protection.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 直徑在一百毫米以上之研磨輪，每批製品應以最高使用周速度值乘以多少倍之速度實施旋轉試驗？
questions.q_en: Grinding wheels of 100 mm diameter or larger shall be spin-tested per batch at the maximum operating peripheral speed multiplied by:
questions.explain_zh: 第86條：直徑一百毫米以上之研磨輪，每批製品應以最高使用周速度乘以一點五倍之速度實施旋轉試驗；試驗用研磨輪取製品數百分之十以上（未滿五個時為五個）；異常率百分之五以下者除異常品外視為合格。
questions.explain_en: Article 86: at 1.5× the maximum operating peripheral speed; sample at least 10% of the batch (minimum 5); a batch passes if the defect rate is 5% or less (excluding defective wheels).

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 盤形研磨輪之衝擊試驗，應向相對之二處施以多少焦耳之衝擊？
questions.q_en: In the impact test of depressed-center (disc) grinding wheels, an impact of how many joules is applied at two opposite points?
questions.explain_zh: 第87條：盤形研磨輪應就每種同一規格製品實施衝擊試驗（彈性研磨輪除外），分別就二個以上研磨輪向相對之二處施以九十八焦耳之衝擊；衝擊值最低數值每平方毫米零點零二九七焦耳以上者視為合格。
questions.explain_en: Article 87: 98 J at two opposite points on two or more wheels of each specification (elastic wheels exempt); pass if the minimum impact value is at least 0.0297 J/mm².

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 桌上用研磨機及床式研磨機之護罩，應以舌板使研磨輪周邊與護罩間之間隙可調整在多少毫米以下？舌板厚度應在多少毫米以上、多少毫米以下？
questions.a_zh: 五毫米；二毫米以上十毫米以下
questions.b_zh: 二十毫米；五毫米以上二十毫米以下
questions.c_zh: 十毫米；三毫米以上十六毫米以下
questions.d_zh: 三毫米；一毫米以上五毫米以下
questions.q_en: Bench and pedestal grinder guards shall use a tongue to keep the gap to the wheel adjustable to no more than what, with tongue thickness between:
questions.explain_zh: 第104條：桌上用及床式研磨機之護罩應以舌板或其他方法使研磨必要部分之研磨輪周邊與護罩間之間隙可調整在十毫米以下；舌板為板狀、壓延鋼板、厚度三毫米以上十六毫米以下。第107條：工作物支架與研磨輪間隙應可調整在三毫米以下。
questions.explain_en: Article 104: gap adjustable to 10 mm or less with a rolled-steel tongue 3–16 mm thick; Article 107: the work rest gap adjustable to 3 mm or less.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 攜帶用空氣式研磨機應設置何種裝置？但公稱尺寸未滿多少毫米者不在此限？
questions.q_en: Portable pneumatic grinders shall have what device, except those with a nominal size under:
questions.explain_zh: 第108條：攜帶用空氣式研磨機應設置調速機。但研磨機之公稱尺寸未滿六十五毫米者，不在此限。第109條：直徑未滿五十毫米之研磨輪及其護罩不適用本章規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 108: a speed governor, except grinders of nominal size under 65 mm; Article 109: wheels under 50 mm and their guards are outside this chapter.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 交流電焊機用自動電擊防止裝置之構造及性能，應符合何種國家標準？
questions.q_en: Automatic shock-prevention devices for AC arc welders shall conform to which national standard?
questions.explain_zh: 第111條之1：交流電焊機用自動電擊防止裝置之構造及性能，應符合國家標準CNS 4782。第110條：氣體類防爆電氣設備應符合CNS 3376系列或IEC 60079系列。
questions.explain_en: Article 111-1: CNS 4782; Article 110: gas-atmosphere explosion-proof electrical equipment per CNS 3376 series or IEC 60079 series.

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 堆高機應於明顯易見處標示之事項，不包括下列何者？
questions.q_en: Which is NOT a required marking on a forklift?
questions.explain_zh: 第117條：堆高機應標示製造者名稱、製造年份、製造號碼、最大荷重、容許荷重（依構造材質及貨物重心位置決定之足以承受之最大荷重）。
questions.explain_en: Article 117: manufacturer, year, serial number, maximum load, and rated load (the maximum load the truck can bear based on structure, material and load center).

questions.law: 機械設備器具安全標準
questions.q_zh: 研磨輪應標示之事項包括下列何者？
questions.c_zh: 製造者名稱、結合劑之種類、最高使用周速度、製造號碼或製造批號
questions.q_en: Grinding wheels shall be marked with:
questions.c_en: Manufacturer, bond type, maximum operating peripheral speed, and serial or batch number
questions.explain_zh: 第119條：研磨輪應標示製造者名稱、結合劑之種類、最高使用周速度（得加註旋轉速率）、製造號碼或製造批號；直徑未滿七十五毫米者得在最小包裝單位上標示。
questions.explain_en: Article 119: manufacturer, bond type, maximum operating peripheral speed (optionally rpm), and serial or batch number; wheels under 75 mm may be marked on the smallest package.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 缺氧症預防規則所稱「缺氧」，指空氣中氧氣濃度未滿百分之多少之狀態？
questions.q_en: Under the Hypoxia Prevention Rules, 'oxygen deficiency' means an oxygen concentration below:
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第1款：缺氧指空氣中氧氣濃度未滿百分之十八之狀態；缺氧症指因作業場所缺氧引起之症狀。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(1): oxygen deficiency is an oxygen concentration below 18%; hypoxia refers to symptoms caused by it.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬缺氧症預防規則第2條所定之缺氧危險場所？
questions.a_zh: 長期間未使用之水井、坑井、豎坑、隧道、沈箱之內部
questions.q_en: Which is an 'oxygen-deficiency hazardous place' under Article 2?
questions.a_en: The interior of long-unused wells, pits, shafts, tunnels or caissons
questions.explain_zh: 第2條列舉：長期未使用之水井坑井隧道沈箱內部、貫通特定地層之場所、地下敷設物之暗渠人孔、滯留雨水河水之槽暗渠、置放海水之熱交換器、密閉相當期間之鋼製鍋爐儲槽船艙、置放易吸氧物質之儲槽、乾性油油漆未乾之密閉空間、穀物儲存發酵倉庫、釀造設備、糞尿污水槽、乾冰冷凍庫、惰性氣體設備內部等。
questions.explain_en: Article 2 lists: long-unused wells/shafts/tunnels/caissons, places penetrating certain strata, utility manholes and culverts, tanks that held rainwater or seawater, long-sealed steel boilers/tanks/holds, storage of oxygen-absorbing materials, freshly oil-painted enclosed spaces, grain/fermentation storage, brewing vessels, sewage tanks, dry-ice refrigerators, inert-gas equipment interiors, etc.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 密閉相當期間之鋼製鍋爐、儲槽、反應槽、船艙等內壁易於氧化之設備內部屬缺氧危險場所，但下列何種情形不在此限？
questions.a_zh: 內壁為不銹鋼製品或實施防銹措施者
questions.c_zh: 容量小於一立方公尺者
questions.q_en: Long-sealed steel boilers, tanks or ship holds with easily oxidized inner walls are hazardous places, EXCEPT when:
questions.a_en: The inner wall is stainless steel or rust-proofed
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第2項第6款：密閉相當期間之鋼製鍋爐、儲槽、反應槽、船艙等內壁易於氧化之設備之內部。但內壁為不銹鋼製品或實施防銹措施者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(2)(6): excepted when the inner wall is stainless steel or anti-rust treated.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事缺氧危險作業時，應置備何種儀器？
questions.b_zh: 測定空氣中氧氣濃度之測定儀器
questions.q_en: For oxygen-deficiency hazardous work, the employer shall provide:
questions.b_en: Instruments to measure oxygen concentration in the air
questions.explain_zh: 第4條：應置備測定空氣中氧氣濃度之必要測定儀器，並採取隨時可確認空氣中氧氣濃度、硫化氫等其他有害氣體濃度之措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 4: necessary instruments to measure oxygen concentration, with measures to check oxygen and other harmful gases such as hydrogen sulfide at any time.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 從事缺氧危險作業時應適當換氣，保持氧氣濃度在百分之十八以上；實施換氣時不得使用何種氣體？
questions.q_en: Ventilation must keep oxygen at 18% or above; which gas must NOT be used for ventilation?
questions.explain_zh: 第5條：應予適當換氣以保持氧氣濃度在百分之十八以上（防止爆炸、氧化或作業顯著困難者除外）；實施換氣時不得使用純氧。第9條惰性氣體熔接作業亦同。
questions.explain_en: Article 5: ventilate to keep oxygen at 18% or more (except where explosion, oxidation or work difficulty prevents it); pure oxygen must not be used. Article 9 applies the same to inert-gas welding.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 從事隧道或坑井之開鑿作業，為防止何種氣體突出導致缺氧症，應事前藉鑽探孔調查？
questions.q_en: Before tunnel or shaft excavation, which gases must be surveyed by boreholes to prevent hypoxia from sudden outbursts?
questions.explain_zh: 第6條：為防止甲烷或二氧化碳之突出導致勞工罹患缺氧症，應於事前就作業場所及四周藉鑽探孔或其他適當方法調查，依調查結果決定處理方法、開鑿時期及程序。
questions.explain_en: Article 6: survey for methane or carbon dioxide by boreholes or other suitable methods and decide treatment, timing and procedure based on the results.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 於地下室、機械房、船艙等通風不充分之室內置備以二氧化碳為滅火劑之滅火器時，應有何種措施？
questions.d_zh: 預防勞工誤觸翻倒或確保把柄不易誤動之設施，並公告禁止不當操作
questions.q_en: For CO2 extinguishers in poorly ventilated basements, machine rooms or ship holds, the employer shall:
questions.d_en: Prevent accidental tipping or handle actuation, and post a notice prohibiting improper operation
questions.explain_zh: 第7條：應有預防因勞工誤觸導致翻倒滅火器或確保把柄不易誤動之設施；禁止勞工不當操作，並將禁止規定公告於顯而易見之處所。
questions.explain_en: Article 7: facilities to prevent knocking over or accidental handle operation, prohibit improper operation, and post the prohibition conspicuously.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 使勞工於冷藏室、冷凍室、地窖等密閉設施內部作業時，作業期間應採取何種措施？
questions.a_zh: 使出入口之門或蓋不致閉鎖
questions.c_zh: 將門鎖上以防外人進入
questions.q_en: When workers work inside cold rooms, freezers or cellars, during the work the employer shall:
questions.a_en: Keep the door or hatch from locking shut
questions.c_en: Lock the door to keep outsiders out
questions.explain_zh: 第8條：應採取該設施出入口之門或蓋等不致閉鎖之措施。但門或蓋有易自內部開啟之構造，或設施內部設有通報或警報裝置可與外部有效聯絡者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 8: prevent the entrance door or cover from locking, unless it opens easily from inside or the space has alarm/communication devices linked to the outside.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 使勞工於設有輸送惰性氣體配管之鍋爐、儲槽等內部作業時，關閉閥、旋塞或設置盲板後，還應如何？
questions.a_zh: 予以上鎖，並將其意旨公布於勞工易見之場所
questions.q_en: For work inside boilers or tanks with inert-gas piping, after closing valves or installing blind flanges the employer shall also:
questions.a_en: Lock them and post the fact where workers can see it
questions.explain_zh: 第10條：應關閉輸送配管之閥、旋塞或設置盲板；於顯而易見處標示配管內惰性氣體名稱及開閉方向；關閉閥旋塞或設置盲板時應予上鎖，並將其意旨公布於勞工易見之場所。
questions.explain_en: Article 10: close valves or install blinds, label the gas name and open/close direction, lock the closure and post a notice visible to workers.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 缺氧危險作業之氧氣及有害氣體濃度確認，應於何時實施？其紀錄保存幾年？
questions.d_zh: 當日作業開始前、所有勞工離開後再次開始前及有異常時；三年
questions.q_en: When must oxygen and harmful-gas concentrations be checked for oxygen-deficiency work, and how long are records kept?
questions.d_en: Before daily work, before resuming after all workers leave, and on any abnormality; 3 years
questions.explain_zh: 第16條：於當日作業開始前、所有勞工離開作業場所後再次開始作業前及勞工身體或換氣裝置等有異常時，應確認氧氣、硫化氫等濃度；確認結果應予記錄並保存三年。
questions.explain_en: Article 16: check before daily start, before resuming after all workers have left, and when workers or ventilation show abnormalities; keep records 3 years.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 缺氧危險場所入口應公告之注意事項，包括下列何者？
questions.q_en: Which must be posted at the entrance of an oxygen-deficiency hazardous place?
questions.a_en: The name of the oxygen-deficiency work supervisor
questions.explain_zh: 第18條：應公告有罹患缺氧症之虞之事項、進入時應採取之措施、事故時之緊急措施及聯絡方式、呼吸防護具安全帶測定儀器換氣設備等之保管場所、缺氧作業主管姓名；並禁止非作業勞工擅入。
questions.explain_en: Article 18: risk of hypoxia, measures on entry, emergency measures and contacts, storage locations of respirators, harnesses, instruments and ventilation equipment, and the supervisor's name; unauthorized entry is prohibited.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事缺氧危險作業時，應於每一班次指定何人從事監督事項？
questions.q_en: For each shift of oxygen-deficiency work, the employer shall designate:
questions.explain_zh: 第20條：應於每一班次指定缺氧作業主管，決定作業方法並指揮、辦理濃度確認、當班作業前確認換氣裝置測定儀器呼吸防護具安全帶等狀況、監督防護器具使用等。
questions.explain_en: Article 20: an oxygen-deficiency work supervisor per shift to decide methods, direct work, check concentrations, inspect ventilation, instruments, respirators and harnesses, and supervise PPE use.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 從事缺氧危險作業時，應指派幾人以上之監視人員隨時監視作業狀況？
questions.q_en: How many watchers must be assigned to monitor oxygen-deficiency work continuously?
questions.explain_zh: 第21條：應指派一人以上之監視人員，隨時監視作業狀況，發覺有異常時，應即與缺氧作業主管及有關人員聯繫，並採取緊急措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 21: at least one watcher who monitors continuously and, on abnormality, immediately contacts the supervisor and takes emergency measures.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 發現從事缺氧危險作業之勞工有立即發生缺氧危險之虞時，雇主或工作場所負責人應如何？
questions.c_zh: 即令停止作業，並使全部勞工即刻退避至安全場所
questions.q_en: When workers doing oxygen-deficiency work face imminent danger, the employer or workplace manager shall:
questions.c_en: Immediately stop the work and evacuate all workers to a safe place
questions.explain_zh: 第23條：應即令停止作業，並使從事該作業之全部勞工即刻退避至安全場所；未確認危險已解除前，不得使指定人員以外之勞工進入，並公告其意旨。
questions.explain_en: Article 23: stop work immediately and evacuate all workers; until the danger is confirmed cleared, only designated personnel may enter, with a notice posted.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 從事缺氧危險作業未能依規定實施換氣時，應置備何種防護具並使勞工確實戴用？
questions.d_zh: 空氣呼吸器等呼吸防護具
questions.q_en: When ventilation cannot be provided for oxygen-deficiency work, workers must wear:
questions.explain_zh: 第25條：未能依第5條或第9條實施換氣時，應置備適當且數量足夠之空氣呼吸器等呼吸防護具，並使勞工確實戴用。第27條並應置備呼吸防護具、梯子、安全帶或救生索供緊急避難或救援使用。
questions.explain_en: Article 25: adequate numbers of air respirators (e.g., SCBA) must be provided and worn; Article 27 also requires respirators, ladders, harnesses or lifelines for evacuation and rescue.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 缺氧危險作業場所置救援人員，於其擔任救援作業期間應提供並使其使用何種裝備？
questions.b_zh: 空氣呼吸器等呼吸防護具
questions.q_en: Rescue personnel stationed at oxygen-deficiency worksites shall use what during rescue?
questions.explain_zh: 第28條：雇主應於缺氧危險作業場所置救援人員，於其擔任救援作業期間，應提供並使其使用空氣呼吸器等呼吸防護具。
questions.explain_en: Article 28: rescue personnel must be stationed and provided with air respirators to use during rescue operations.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主使勞工戴用輸氣管面罩之連續作業時間，每次不得超過多久？
questions.q_en: Continuous work while wearing an air-line mask shall not exceed how long per session?
questions.explain_zh: 第30條：雇主使勞工戴用輸氣管面罩之連續作業時間，每次不得超過一小時。
questions.explain_en: Article 30: continuous work with an air-line (hose) mask shall not exceed one hour per session.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬缺氧症之初期症狀，應即由醫師診治？
questions.b_zh: 顏面蒼白或紅暈、脈搏及呼吸加快、呼吸困難、目眩或頭痛
questions.q_en: Which are early symptoms of hypoxia requiring immediate medical treatment?
questions.b_en: Pale or flushed face, rapid pulse and breathing, dyspnea, dizziness or headache
questions.explain_zh: 第31條：初期症狀為顏面蒼白或紅暈、脈搏及呼吸加快、呼吸困難、目眩或頭痛；末期症狀為意識不明、痙攣、呼吸停止或心臟停止跳動；另硫化氫、一氧化碳等中毒症狀亦應即由醫師診治。
questions.explain_en: Article 31: early symptoms are pale/flushed face, rapid pulse and breathing, breathing difficulty, dizziness or headache; late symptoms are unconsciousness, convulsions, respiratory or cardiac arrest; H2S or CO poisoning also requires treatment.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事缺氧危險作業時，對進出各該場所之勞工應如何處理？
questions.q_en: For workers entering and leaving oxygen-deficiency hazardous places, the employer shall:
questions.c_en: Confirm or register them by name
questions.explain_zh: 第17條：對進出各該場所勞工，應予確認或點名登記。第24條並應依教育訓練規則施予必要之安全衛生教育訓練。
questions.explain_en: Article 17: confirm or register by roll call; Article 24 requires necessary safety training per the Training Rules.

questions.law: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準
questions.q_zh: 依高架作業勞工保護措施標準，未設置平台、護欄而已採取必要安全措施之作業，其高度在幾公尺以上屬高架作業？已設置平台護欄者為幾公尺以上？
questions.a_zh: 一．五公尺以上；三公尺以上
questions.b_zh: 五公尺以上；二十公尺以上
questions.c_zh: 三公尺以上；十公尺以上
questions.d_zh: 二公尺以上；五公尺以上
questions.q_en: Under the Work-at-Height Protection Standards, work without platforms or guardrails counts as 'work at height' from what height, and with platforms/guardrails from what height?
questions.explain_zh: 第3條：未設置平台、護欄等設備而已採取必要安全措施，其高度在二公尺以上者；已依規定設置平台、護欄等並採防墜措施，其高度在五公尺以上者，均屬高架作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 3: 2 m or higher without platforms or guardrails (with other safety measures), and 5 m or higher where platforms and guardrails with fall protection are installed.

questions.law: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準
questions.q_zh: 露天作業場所之高架作業高度，應自勞工站立位置半徑多少公尺範圍內最低點之地面或水面起算？
questions.q_en: For outdoor work, the height of work at height is measured from the lowest ground or water point within what radius of the worker's position?
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第2項：露天作業場所，自勞工站立位置半徑三公尺範圍內最低點之地面或水面起至勞工立足點平面間之垂直距離；室內或儲槽等場所，自勞工站立位置與地板間之垂直距離。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(2): outdoors, the vertical distance from the lowest ground or water point within a 3 m radius to the worker's standing surface; indoors or in tanks, from the standing position to the floor.

questions.law: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準
questions.q_zh: 高架作業每連續作業二小時，高度在二公尺以上未滿五公尺者至少應給予幾分鐘休息？二十公尺以上者至少幾分鐘？
questions.q_en: For every two hours of continuous work at height, the minimum rest at 2 to under 5 m, and at 20 m or more, is:
questions.explain_zh: 第4條：每連續作業二小時，高度二公尺以上未滿五公尺者至少二十分鐘休息；五公尺以上未滿二十公尺者至少二十五分鐘；二十公尺以上者至少三十五分鐘。
questions.explain_en: Article 4: 2 to under 5 m: at least 20 min; 5 to under 20 m: at least 25 min; 20 m or more: at least 35 min, per two hours of continuous work.

questions.law: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準
questions.q_zh: 高度在五公尺以上未滿二十公尺之高架作業，每連續作業二小時至少應給予幾分鐘休息？
questions.q_en: For work at heights of 5 m to under 20 m, the minimum rest per two hours of continuous work is:
questions.explain_zh: 第4條第2款：高度在五公尺以上未滿二十公尺者，至少有二十五分鐘休息。第5條：搶修或特殊作業需要，經採取減少工作時間或其他保護措施者得調整。
questions.explain_en: Article 4(2): at least 25 minutes; Article 5 allows adjustment for emergency repairs or special work with reduced hours or other protective measures.

questions.law: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準
questions.q_zh: 勞工有下列何種情事時，雇主不得使其從事高架作業？
questions.d_zh: 身高未達一百七十公分者
questions.q_en: Which worker must NOT be assigned to work at height?
questions.b_en: One who is drunk or likely drunk
questions.explain_zh: 第8條：酒醉或有酒醉之虞者；身體虛弱經醫師診斷身體狀況不良者；情緒不穩定有安全顧慮者；勞工自覺不適從事工作者；其他經主管人員認定者，雇主不得使其從事高架作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 8: drunk or likely drunk; physically weak per a physician; emotionally unstable with safety concerns; feeling unfit; or otherwise determined by a supervisor.

questions.law: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主僱用勞工從事高架作業時，應依何種規定實施勞工健康檢查及管理？
questions.q_en: Health examinations and management for workers at height shall follow:
questions.explain_zh: 第7條：雇主僱用勞工從事高架作業時，應依勞工健康保護規則之規定，實施勞工健康檢查及管理。第6條：應使勞工於安全設施良好之地面或平台等處所休息。
questions.explain_en: Article 7: per the Labor Health Protection Rules; Article 6: rest must be taken on safe ground or platforms.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬高溫作業勞工作息時間標準所定之高溫作業？
questions.q_en: Which is a 'high-temperature operation' under the Standards?
questions.explain_zh: 第2條：於鍋爐房從事之作業、灼熱金屬壓軋鍛造、鑄造間處理熔融金屬、金屬加熱熔煉、處理搪瓷玻璃電石及熔爐高溫熔料、蒸汽火車輪船機房、蒸汽操作燒窯等，且時量平均綜合溫度熱指數達連續作業規定值以上者；已自動化無熱暴露之虞者除外。
questions.explain_en: Article 2: boiler rooms, rolling/forging hot metal, handling molten metal in foundries, metal heating/smelting, enamel/glass/carbide/furnace work, steam locomotive and ship engine rooms, steam operation and kiln firing, where the WBGT reaches the continuous-work threshold; automated operations without heat exposure are excluded.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 戶外有日曬情形之綜合溫度熱指數（WBGT）計算公式為何？
questions.a_zh: 0.7×自然濕球溫度＋0.2×黑球溫度＋0.1×乾球溫度
questions.q_en: The WBGT formula for outdoor work with solar load is:
questions.explain_zh: 第3條：戶外有日曬者 WBGT＝0.7×自然濕球溫度＋0.2×黑球溫度＋0.1×乾球溫度；戶內或戶外無日曬者 WBGT＝0.7×自然濕球溫度＋0.3×黑球溫度。
questions.explain_en: Article 3: outdoors with sun: 0.7 NWB + 0.2 GT + 0.1 DB; indoors or without sun: 0.7 NWB + 0.3 GT.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 戶內或戶外無日曬情形之綜合溫度熱指數計算公式為何？
questions.a_zh: 0.7×自然濕球溫度＋0.2×黑球溫度＋0.1×乾球溫度
questions.q_en: The WBGT formula for indoor work or outdoors without solar load is:
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第2款：戶內或戶外無日曬情形者，綜合溫度熱指數＝0.7×（自然濕球溫度）＋0.3×（黑球溫度）。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(2): WBGT = 0.7 × natural wet-bulb temperature + 0.3 × globe temperature.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 高溫作業標準所稱「重工作」，指下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 於走動中提舉或推動一般重量物體
questions.c_zh: 僅以坐姿或立姿進行手臂部動作以操縱機器
questions.d_zh: 鏟、掘、推等全身運動之工作
questions.q_en: Under the Standards, 'heavy work' means:
questions.a_en: Lifting or pushing ordinary loads while walking
questions.c_en: Operating machines with arm movements while seated or standing
questions.d_en: Whole-body work such as shoveling, digging or pushing
questions.explain_zh: 第4條：輕工作指僅以坐姿或立姿進行手臂部動作以操縱機器者；中度工作指於走動中提舉或推動一般重量物體者；重工作指鏟、掘、推等全身運動之工作者。
questions.explain_en: Article 4: light work = arm movements operating machines while seated or standing; moderate = lifting or pushing ordinary loads while walking; heavy = whole-body work such as shoveling, digging or pushing.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 依高溫作業作息時間表，輕工作之時量平均綜合溫度熱指數達攝氏多少度時，須採每小時百分之五十休息、百分之五十作業？
questions.q_en: Per the work/rest table, at what time-weighted WBGT (°C) must light work follow 50% rest / 50% work per hour?
questions.explain_en: Article 5 table: light work 30.6 (continuous), 31.4 (25% rest), 32.2 (50% rest), 33.0 (75% rest); moderate 28.0/29.4/31.1/32.6; heavy 25.9/27.9/30.0/32.1.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 重工作之時量平均綜合溫度熱指數達攝氏 25.9 度時，其每小時作息比例為何？
questions.q_en: For heavy work at a time-weighted WBGT of 25.9°C, the hourly work/rest ratio is:
questions.explain_zh: 第5條表：重工作 25.9 為連續作業之上限值；27.9 為 25% 休息；30.0 為 50% 休息；32.1 為 75% 休息。
questions.explain_en: Article 5 table: heavy work 25.9 = continuous work limit; 27.9 = 25% rest; 30.0 = 50% rest; 32.1 = 75% rest.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 高溫作業勞工連續暴露達一小時以上者，以每小時計算時量平均綜合溫度熱指數；間歇暴露者以多久計算？
questions.q_en: For continuous exposure of one hour or more the WBGT is time-weighted hourly; for intermittent exposure it is averaged over:
questions.explain_zh: 第5條：連續暴露達一小時以上者以每小時計算；間歇暴露者以二小時計算其暴露時量平均綜合溫度熱指數，並依表分配作業及休息時間。
questions.explain_en: Article 5: hourly for continuous exposure of one hour or more; over two hours for intermittent exposure, then allocate work and rest per the table.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 勞工於操作中須接近黑球溫度攝氏幾度以上之高溫灼熱物體時，雇主應供給身體熱防護設備？
questions.q_en: Body heat-protective equipment is required when workers must approach hot objects with a globe temperature of at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第6條：勞工於操作中須接近黑球溫度五十度以上高溫灼熱物體者，雇主應供給身體熱防護設備並使勞工確實使用；黑球溫度之測定位置為勞工工作時之位置。
questions.explain_en: Article 6: at 50°C globe temperature or above, measured at the worker's position, the employer shall provide and enforce use of body heat protection.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 對於首次從事高溫作業之勞工，雇主應規劃何事？
questions.q_en: For workers newly assigned to high-temperature work, the employer shall plan:
questions.explain_zh: 第6條之1：雇主對於首次從事高溫作業之勞工，應規劃適當之熱適應期間，並採取必要措施，以增加其生理機能調適能力。
questions.explain_en: Article 6-1: plan an appropriate acclimatization period and take measures to build physiological adaptation.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 實施高溫作業作息時間標準後降低工作時間之勞工，其原有工資應如何？
questions.q_en: When working hours are reduced under the Standards, the worker's original wages:
questions.explain_zh: 第7條：實施本標準後降低工作時間之勞工，其原有工資不得減少。第8條：雇主原訂工作條件優於本標準者從其規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 7: original wages must not be reduced; Article 8: better employer terms prevail.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事高溫作業時，應充分供應何物？
questions.q_en: For high-temperature work the employer shall provide plenty of:
questions.explain_zh: 第9條：雇主使勞工從事高溫作業時，應充分供應飲用水及食鹽，並採取指導勞工避免高溫作業危害之必要措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 9: sufficient drinking water and salt, plus guidance to avoid heat hazards.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 依職業安全衛生標示設置準則，「禁止標示」之用途為何？
questions.a_zh: 嚴格管制有發生危險之虞之行為，如禁止煙火、禁止攀越、禁止通行
