questions.b_zh: 提醒避免相對於人員行為而發生之危害
questions.c_zh: 警告既存之危險或有害狀況
questions.q_en: Under the Sign Installation Guidelines, a 'prohibition sign' is used to:
questions.a_en: Strictly control hazardous behaviors, e.g., no fire, no climbing, no passage
questions.b_en: Remind people to avoid hazards from their own actions
questions.explain_zh: 第3條：禁止標示嚴格管制有發生危險之虞之行為（禁止煙火、攀越、通行）；警告標示警告既存之危險（高壓電、墜落、高熱、輻射）；注意標示提醒避免相對於人員行為之危害（當心地面、注意頭頂）；一般說明或提示標示用途處所、操作儀控、說明性質。
questions.explain_en: Article 3: prohibition signs control dangerous behavior; warning signs warn of existing hazards (high voltage, falls, heat, radiation); caution signs remind about hazards from behavior (mind the floor, watch your head); information signs indicate locations, operations or explanations.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 「當心地面」、「注意頭頂」屬於何種標示？
questions.q_en: 'Mind the floor' and 'Watch your head' are what type of sign?
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第1款第3目：注意標示：提醒避免相對於人員行為而發生之危害，包括當心地面、注意頭頂等。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(1)(3): caution signs remind people to avoid hazards arising from their own actions, such as slippery floors or low ceilings.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 依標示設置準則，圓形標示用於何種用途？
questions.q_en: A circular sign is used for:
questions.explain_zh: 第4條：圓形用於禁止；尖端向上之正三角形用於警告；尖端向下之正三角形用於注意；正方形或長方形用於一般說明或提示。
questions.explain_en: Article 4: circle = prohibition; upward-pointing equilateral triangle = warning; downward-pointing triangle = caution; square or rectangle = general information.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 尖端向上之正三角形標示用於何種用途？尖端向下者用於何種用途？
questions.q_en: An upward-pointing triangle sign is used for what, and a downward-pointing one for what?
questions.explain_zh: 第4條：尖端向上之正三角形用於警告；尖端向下之正三角形用於注意。
questions.explain_en: Article 4: upward-pointing equilateral triangle = warning; downward-pointing = caution.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 正方形或長方形之標示用於何種用途？
questions.q_en: Square or rectangular signs are used for:
questions.explain_zh: 第4條第4款：正方形或長方形用於一般說明或提示。
questions.explain_en: Article 4(4): squares or rectangles are for general information or instruction.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 標示之文字書寫方式，直式應如何？橫式應如何？
questions.a_zh: 直式由上而下、由左而右；橫式由右而左
questions.b_zh: 直式由上而下、由右而左；橫式由左而右（有箭號者依箭號方向）
questions.d_zh: 直式由下而上；橫式由右而左
questions.q_en: How is sign text written vertically and horizontally?
questions.a_en: Vertical: top to bottom, left to right; horizontal: right to left
questions.b_en: Vertical: top to bottom, right to left; horizontal: left to right (or following an arrow)
questions.d_en: Vertical: bottom to top; horizontal: right to left
questions.explain_zh: 第6條：標示應力求簡明，文字及圖案併用，文字以中文為主；直式由上而下、由右而左；橫式由左而右，但有箭號指示方向者依箭號方向。
questions.explain_en: Article 6: concise text and pictograms, Chinese as the main language; vertical text top-to-bottom and right-to-left; horizontal text left-to-right, or following any arrow.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 標示之顏色應依何種國家標準之規定？
questions.q_en: Sign colors shall follow which national standard?
questions.c_en: CNS 9328 General Rules for Safety Colors
questions.explain_zh: 第7條：標示之顏色應依國家標準CNS 9328安全用顏色通則之規定，其底色、外廓、文字及圖案之用色應力求對照顯明，以利識別。
questions.explain_en: Article 7: CNS 9328 safety colors, with background, border, text and pictogram colors chosen for clear contrast.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 標示之設置，下列何者正確？
questions.b_zh: 大小及位置力求明顯易見，材質堅固耐久並處理尖角銳邊
questions.q_en: Regarding sign installation, which is correct?
questions.b_en: Size and position clearly visible, durable material, sharp corners and edges treated
questions.c_en: As small as possible to save space
questions.explain_zh: 第5條：標示應依永久性或暫時性採固定式或移動式；大小及位置力求明顯易見、安裝穩妥；材質堅固耐久，並適當處理所有尖角銳邊以免危險。
questions.explain_en: Article 5: fixed or movable depending on permanence; conspicuous size and position, securely mounted; durable material with all sharp corners and edges treated.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 異常氣壓危害預防標準所稱「潛水作業」，指於水深超過多少公尺之水中實施之作業？
questions.q_en: Under the Abnormal Pressure Hazard Prevention Standards, 'diving work' means work in water deeper than:
questions.explain_zh: 第2條：高壓室內作業指沈箱、壓氣潛盾等壓氣施工法中於表壓力超過大氣壓之作業室或豎管內部實施之作業；潛水作業指使用水肺或水面供氣設備等，於水深超過十公尺之水中實施之作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 2: hyperbaric chamber work is work in caissons or compressed-air shields above atmospheric pressure; diving work uses scuba or surface-supplied air at depths exceeding 10 m.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 「耐氧試驗」係指對從事異常氣壓作業勞工在高壓艙以每平方公分多少公斤之壓力，使其呼吸純氧多久之試驗？
questions.d_zh: 一點八公斤（六十呎）；三十分鐘
questions.q_en: The 'oxygen tolerance test' exposes the worker in a chamber to what pressure breathing pure oxygen for how long?
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第2款：耐氧試驗指在高壓艙以每平方公分一點八公斤（六十呎）之壓力，使其呼吸純氧三十分鐘之試驗；氣閘室指對高壓室內作業勞工實施加減壓之處所。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(2): 1.8 kg/cm² (60 ft) breathing pure oxygen for 30 minutes; an air lock is where workers are compressed and decompressed.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 高壓室內作業，作業室內每一勞工占有之氣積應在多少立方公尺以上？氣閘室內每一勞工占有之氣積應在多少立方公尺以上？
questions.a_zh: 六立方公尺；二立方公尺
questions.b_zh: 二立方公尺；零點三立方公尺
questions.c_zh: 四立方公尺；零點六立方公尺
questions.d_zh: 十立方公尺；一立方公尺
questions.q_en: In hyperbaric work, the minimum air volume per worker in the working chamber and in the air lock is:
questions.explain_zh: 第5條：作業室每一勞工占有之氣積應在四立方公尺以上。第6條：氣閘室每一勞工占有之氣積應在零點六立方公尺以上，底面積應在零點三平方公尺以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 5: at least 4 m³ per worker in the working chamber; Article 6: at least 0.6 m³ per worker and 0.3 m² floor area in the air lock.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 氣閘室內供勞工減壓用之排氣管，其內徑應在多少公厘以下？
questions.q_en: The exhaust pipe used for decompressing workers in the air lock shall have an inside diameter no greater than:
questions.explain_zh: 第9條：作業室或氣閘室應設置專用之排氣管；氣閘室內供勞工減壓用之排氣管，其內徑在五十三公厘以下。第7條：輸氣管不得通過豎管，接近作業室處應設逆止閥。
questions.explain_en: Article 9: dedicated exhaust pipes; the air-lock decompression exhaust pipe inside diameter must be 53 mm or less; Article 7: air supply lines must not pass through the shaft and need a check valve near the chamber.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 高壓室內作業所用壓力表之刻度盤，應使用單位刻度在每平方公分多少公斤以下者？
questions.q_en: Pressure gauges for hyperbaric work shall have a scale graduation no larger than:
questions.explain_zh: 第10條第2項：壓力表之刻度盤，應使用單位刻度在每平方公分零點二公斤以下者。操作場所設於外部時應設壓力表，設於內部時操作勞工應攜帶攜帶式壓力表。
questions.explain_en: Article 10(2): graduations of 0.2 kg/cm² or finer; gauges are required at external valve-operating positions, and operators inside carry portable gauges.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事高壓室內作業時，應置備何種用具？
questions.c_zh: 呼吸用防護具、繩索、緊急照明裝置及緊急避難或救出之必要用具
questions.q_en: For hyperbaric chamber work the employer shall provide:
questions.c_en: Respirators, ropes, emergency lighting and equipment for rapid evacuation or rescue
questions.explain_zh: 第13條：應置備呼吸用防護具、繩索、緊急照明裝置及發生緊急狀況時可使勞工迅即避難或救出之必要用具。第12條：氣閘室外應設觀察孔或可掌握室內狀況之設施。
questions.explain_en: Article 13: respiratory protection, ropes, emergency lighting and equipment for rapid evacuation or rescue; Article 12: an observation port or means to monitor inside the air lock.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 潛水作業使用水面供氣時，備用氣槽內空氣壓力應經常維持在最深潛水深度時壓力之幾倍以上？
questions.q_en: For surface-supplied diving, the emergency reserve air tank pressure shall be kept at least how many times the pressure at the deepest diving depth?
questions.explain_zh: 第14條：應對每一潛水勞工設置調節用氣槽及緊急備用氣槽；備用氣槽內空氣壓力應經常維持在最深潛水深度時壓力之一點五倍以上，內容積應大於 V=(0.03D+4)×60/P。
questions.explain_en: Article 14: a regulating tank and an emergency reserve tank per diver; reserve tank pressure at least 1.5× the pressure at maximum depth, with volume greater than V = (0.03D + 4) × 60 / P.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 潛水作業深度超過多少公尺且超過免減壓潛水時間限制者，應於現場設置減壓艙？
questions.q_en: A decompression chamber must be on site when diving exceeds what depth and the no-decompression time limits?
questions.explain_zh: 第15條之1：潛水作業深度超過三十點五公尺（一百呎），且超過附表所定免減壓潛水時間限制者，應於現場設置減壓艙。
questions.explain_en: Article 15-1: deeper than 30.5 m (100 ft) and beyond the no-decompression limits in the tables.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 高壓室內作業，應於每一高壓室內置何種人員？
questions.q_en: Each hyperbaric working chamber must have:
questions.explain_zh: 第16條：應於每一高壓室內置高壓室內作業主管，負責勞工配置及指揮、檢點氣體濃度測定儀器、清點進出勞工、與閥操作勞工連繫維持壓力及加減壓速率、健康異常時採緊急措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 16: a hyperbaric chamber work supervisor to assign and direct workers, check gas instruments, count workers, coordinate pressure and compression/decompression rates, and respond to health emergencies.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 在氣閘室對高壓室內作業實施加壓時，其加壓速率每分鐘應維持在每平方公分多少公斤以下？
questions.q_en: When compressing workers in the air lock, the rate shall not exceed per minute:
questions.explain_zh: 第18條：加壓速率每分鐘應維持在每平方公分零點八公斤以下。第25條：減壓速率亦為每分鐘零點八公斤以下，並依附表於各減壓階停止。
questions.explain_en: Article 18: compression rate 0.8 kg/cm² per minute or less; Article 25: decompression also 0.8 kg/cm²/min with stops per the tables.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 勞工當日從事二次以上高壓室內作業時，為減少體內氮氣殘留，前次減壓終了起應給與之時間稱為何？在此時間內不得從事何種作業？
questions.c_zh: 中間壓減時間；重體力作業
questions.q_en: For a second hyperbaric session on the same day, the interval after the previous decompression is called what, and what work is prohibited during it?
questions.c_en: Intermediate decompression interval; heavy physical work
questions.explain_zh: 第20條：當日二次以上作業，於前次減壓終了時起算連續給與「中間壓減時間」，且在此時間內不得使其從事重體力作業。第21條：當日終了後之時間稱「終工壓減時間」，同樣不得從事重體力作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 20: the 'intermediate decompression interval' during which heavy physical work is prohibited; Article 21: the 'end-of-work decompression interval' after the last session, also without heavy work.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 為防止二氧化碳危害高壓室內作業勞工，應抑制二氧化碳之分壓，使其不超過相當一大氣壓下之濃度多少 ppm？
questions.q_en: In hyperbaric chambers, CO2 partial pressure shall be kept below the equivalent of what concentration at one atmosphere?
questions.explain_zh: 第23條：應在作業室及氣閘室採取換氣及其他措施，抑制二氧化碳之分壓，使其不超過相當一大氣壓下之濃度為五千 ppm；換算公式 C=P1×1,000,000/P。
questions.explain_en: Article 23: not exceeding 5,000 ppm equivalent at 1 atm, via ventilation and other measures; C = P1 × 1,000,000 / P.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 氣閘室實施減壓時，氣閘室底面之照明應在多少米燭光以上？溫度在攝氏幾度以下時應供給毛毯？
questions.q_en: During decompression in the air lock, the floor illumination shall be at least, and blankets are provided when the temperature is at or below:
questions.explain_zh: 第27條：氣閘室底面之照明應在二十米燭光以上；氣閘室溫度在攝氏十度以下時應供給毛毯或其他保暖用具；減壓時間在一小時以上者應供給椅子等休憩用具；事前將當次減壓時間告知勞工。
questions.explain_en: Article 27: at least 20 lux; blankets at 10°C or below; seats when decompression exceeds one hour; workers told the decompression time beforehand.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 高壓室內作業之氣閘室壓力自動記錄表紀錄（併同勞工姓名、減壓日期及時間），應保存幾年？
questions.q_en: Automatic pressure recorder logs of each worker's decompression in the air lock shall be kept for:
questions.explain_zh: 第28條：應在氣閘室內設置壓力自動記錄表，將每一勞工受減壓之狀況併同姓名、減壓日期及時間每日作成紀錄，並保存十五年。第30條檢點紀錄保存三年。
questions.explain_en: Article 28: daily records with worker name, date and time, kept 15 years; Article 30 inspection records are kept 3 years.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 高壓室內作業之輸氣管、排氣管及通話設備應多久檢點一次？自動警報裝置與輸氣用空氣壓縮機應多久檢點一次？
questions.q_en: For hyperbaric work, air supply/exhaust pipes and communication equipment are inspected how often, and the automatic alarm and air compressor how often?
questions.explain_zh: 第30條：每日檢點輸氣管、排氣管、通話設備、輸排氣調節閥旋塞、空壓機附屬冷卻裝置、緊急用具；每週檢點自動警報裝置、輸氣用空氣壓縮機；每月檢點壓力表、空氣清淨裝置、電路。紀錄保存三年。
questions.explain_en: Article 30: daily for supply/exhaust pipes, communication, valves, compressor cooling and emergency tools; weekly for the automatic alarm and compressor; monthly for gauges, air cleaners and circuits; records kept 3 years.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 實施高壓室內作業前，就沈箱、壓氣潛盾等應有之防火設備及措施，下列何者正確？
questions.b_zh: 嚴禁煙火，禁止攜帶火柴打火機進入，不得在作業室內從事熔接熔斷或電弧作業
questions.q_en: Regarding fire prevention in caissons or compressed-air shields, which is correct?
questions.a_en: Ordinary light bulbs may be used
questions.b_en: No fire; no matches or lighters brought in; no welding, cutting or arc work inside the chamber
questions.c_en: Welding inside the chamber is allowed
questions.explain_zh: 第34條：應將高壓下可著燃物質之燃燒危險性告知勞工；使用置有護罩之安全電燈；使用不發生火花或電弧之電路開關；不因高溫引火之暖氣設備；嚴禁煙火並禁止攜帶火源進入；不得在作業室內從事熔接、熔斷或使用煙火、電弧作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 34: inform workers of combustion risk under pressure; guarded safety lamps; spark-free switches; safe heaters; strict no-fire rule with ignition sources banned; no welding, cutting, open flame or arc work inside.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 為防止沈箱之異常沈降致危害高壓室內作業勞工，刃口下方之掘深度不得超過多少公分？
questions.q_en: To prevent abnormal caisson sinking, excavation below the cutting edge shall not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第35條：刃口下方之掘深度不得超過五十公分。第36條：高壓室內作業主管應攜帶手電筒、緊急用信號設備、壓力表及高壓下可測定二氧化碳等濃度之測定儀器。
questions.explain_en: Article 35: not more than 50 cm below the cutting edge; Article 36: the supervisor carries a flashlight, emergency signaling device, pressure gauge and a CO2/gas meter usable under pressure.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 水肺空氣潛水作業之最大深度限制為多少？水面供氣空氣潛水為多少？
questions.d_zh: 三十九點六公尺（一百三十呎）；五十七點九公尺（一百九十呎）
questions.q_en: The maximum depth for scuba air diving and for surface-supplied air diving is:
questions.explain_zh: 第37條第2項：水肺空氣潛水最大深度三十九點六公尺（一百三十呎）；水面供氣空氣潛水五十七點九公尺（一百九十呎）；人工調和混合氣潛水最大九十一點五公尺（三百呎），氮氧混合氣不得超過四十二點七公尺（一百四十呎）。
questions.explain_en: Article 37(2): scuba air 39.6 m (130 ft); surface-supplied air 57.9 m (190 ft); mixed gas up to 91.5 m (300 ft), nitrox not beyond 42.7 m (140 ft).

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 人工調和混合氣潛水，潛水深度達多少公尺至九十一點五公尺，或減壓時間超過多少分鐘者，需使用潛水鐘？
questions.b_zh: 六十七點一公尺（二百二十呎）；一百二十分鐘
questions.d_zh: 八十公尺；一百八十分鐘
questions.q_en: In mixed-gas diving, a diving bell is required at depths from what to 91.5 m, or when decompression exceeds how long?
questions.explain_zh: 第37條第2項第2款：潛水深度達六十七點一公尺（二百二十呎）至九十一點五公尺（三百呎）或減壓時間超過一百二十分鐘者，需使用潛水鐘。
questions.explain_en: Article 37(2)(2): from 67.1 m (220 ft) to 91.5 m (300 ft), or when decompression time exceeds 120 minutes, a diving bell must be used.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主實施潛水作業所僱用之勞工，應具備下列何種資格之一？
questions.c_zh: 職業潛水職類職業訓練結訓證書、潛水人員技術士證，或國外相當執照經中央主管機關認可
questions.q_en: Divers employed for diving work must hold one of:
questions.c_en: A commercial diving vocational training certificate, a diver technician license, or an approved equivalent foreign license
questions.explain_zh: 第37條第1項：持有依法設立訓練機構辦理之職業潛水職類職業訓練結訓證書；領有中央主管機關認可之潛水人員技術士證；或於國外受訓領有相當職業潛水執照經報請中央主管機關認可。
questions.explain_en: Article 37(1): a commercial diving training certificate from a legally established institution, a diver technician certificate recognized by the central authority, or an equivalent foreign license approved by the central authority.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事潛水作業前，應訂定何種計畫據以實施？
questions.a_zh: 潛水作業安全衛生計畫
questions.q_en: Before diving work, the employer shall formulate:
questions.a_en: A diving work safety and health plan
questions.explain_zh: 第37條之1：應訂定潛水作業安全衛生計畫，內容包括潛水目的、作業環境、作業編組、人員名冊與資格、器具設備、作業時間、正常程序及緊急應變處理程序等。
questions.explain_en: Article 37-1: a diving safety and health plan covering purpose, environment, team organization, personnel roster and qualifications, equipment, work time, normal procedures and emergency response.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 潛水作業現場應設置幾名救援潛水員？其應如何待命？
questions.c_zh: 一名，全程穿著潛水裝備待命下水
questions.q_en: How many standby rescue divers are required on site, and how do they stand by?
questions.b_en: One, who may leave the site
questions.c_en: One, fully dressed in dive gear throughout the operation, ready to enter the water
questions.explain_zh: 第38條：作業現場應設置救援潛水員一名，該救援潛水員應於潛水作業全程穿著潛水裝備（水面供氣之頭盔及配重帶除外），待命下水。
questions.explain_en: Article 38: one standby diver wearing dive equipment (except surface-supply helmet and weight belt) for the entire operation, ready to dive.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 潛水作業主管之設備檢點與作業檢點紀錄應保存幾年？潛水日誌應保存幾年？
questions.q_en: Diving supervisor equipment/work inspection records are kept how long, and the diving log how long?
questions.explain_zh: 第39條：潛水作業主管應確認潛水計畫、現場技術指揮、確認連繫方法、待命船隻及後送程序、確認工作手冊、實施設備與作業檢點（紀錄保存五年）、填具潛水日誌記錄每位潛水人員作業情形及減壓時間（保存十五年）。
questions.explain_en: Article 39: the diving supervisor confirms the plan, directs on site, confirms communications, standby vessel and evacuation, work handbooks, inspects equipment and personnel (records 5 years), and keeps a diving log with decompression times (15 years).

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用水面供氣設備潛水作業期間，應每小時檢查何事？
questions.c_zh: 風向及調整空壓機進氣口位置
questions.q_en: During surface-supplied diving, what must be checked every hour?
questions.c_en: Wind direction, adjusting the compressor air intake position
questions.explain_zh: 第39條第3項第1款：使用水面供氣設備者，應檢點潛水器、供氣管、信號索、安全索及壓力調節器，並於作業期間每小時檢查風向及調整空壓機進氣口位置。
questions.explain_en: Article 39(3)(1): inspect the diving apparatus, air hose, signal line, safety line and regulator, and check wind direction hourly to adjust the compressor intake.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主使勞工從事潛水作業前應公告之資料，包括下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 減壓艙所在地、潛水病醫療機構及醫師、海陸空運輸資訊、國軍或急難救援單位
questions.q_en: Before diving work, the employer shall post information including:
questions.a_en: Location of the decompression chamber, diving-medicine facilities and doctors, sea/land/air transport, military or rescue units
questions.explain_zh: 第40條：應備置必要之急救藥品及器材，並公告減壓艙所在地、潛水病醫療機構及醫師、海陸空運輸有關資訊、國軍或其他急難救援單位。
questions.explain_en: Article 40: first-aid supplies plus posted information on the chamber location, hyperbaric medical facilities and physicians, transport options, and military or other rescue units.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用水肺或水面供氣空氣潛水，正常上浮速率不得超過每分鐘多少公尺？潛水紀錄應保存幾年？
questions.b_zh: 九點一公尺（三十呎）；五年
questions.q_en: For scuba or surface-supplied air diving, the normal ascent rate shall not exceed, and dive records are kept for:
questions.explain_zh: 第43條：正常上浮速率不得超過每分鐘九點一公尺（三十呎），潛水程序依深度、滯底時間、減壓站停留時間、總上浮時間、重複潛水組群等從事，不得超過附表規定，並每次作成紀錄保存五年。
questions.explain_en: Article 43: ascent not faster than 9.1 m (30 ft) per minute, following the tables for depth, bottom time, stops, total ascent time and repetitive groups; records kept 5 years.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 水面使用氧氣減壓時，自十二點二公尺減壓站上浮至水面、卸裝、進入減壓艙並加壓至十五點二公尺深度，此水面間歇總時間不得超過幾分鐘？
questions.q_en: For surface oxygen decompression, the total surface interval from leaving the 12.2 m stop to reaching 15.2 m in the chamber shall not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第44條：於離開十二點二公尺（四十呎）減壓站開始，以每分鐘十二點二公尺速率上浮至水面、卸裝、進入減壓艙，以每分鐘三十點五公尺速率加壓至艙內十五點二公尺（五十呎），正常水面間歇總時間不得超過五分鐘；每一氧氣呼吸單元為呼吸純氧三十分鐘及呼吸空氣休息五分鐘。
questions.explain_en: Article 44: ascend from the 12.2 m (40 ft) stop at 12.2 m/min, undress, enter the chamber and pressurize at 30.5 m/min to 15.2 m (50 ft); total surface interval not over 5 minutes; each oxygen unit is 30 min oxygen plus 5 min air break.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用氮氧人工調和混合氣潛水時，其氧氣濃度不得超過百分之多少？氧分壓不得超過多少絕對大氣壓力？
questions.q_en: For nitrox diving, oxygen concentration shall not exceed, and oxygen partial pressure shall not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第45條之1：使用氮氧人工調和混合氣供氣時，應參照相當空氣潛水深度依減壓時程作業，其氧氣濃度不得超過百分之四十，且氧分壓不得超過一點四絕對大氣壓力。
questions.explain_en: Article 45-1: follow the equivalent air depth tables; oxygen not over 40% and oxygen partial pressure not over 1.4 ATA.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 因緊急事故增加上浮速率或縮短減壓站停留後，進入減壓艙再加壓時，加壓速率不得超過每分鐘多少公尺？
questions.c_zh: 二十四點四公尺（八十呎）
questions.q_en: After an emergency rapid ascent, recompression in the chamber shall not exceed a rate of:
questions.explain_zh: 第48條：緊急救出後，有症狀者立即送醫；無症狀者依附表四之三處置；進入減壓艙再加壓時，加壓速率依潛水人員可容忍範圍為之，但不得超過每分鐘二十四點四公尺（八十呎）。
questions.explain_en: Article 48: symptomatic divers go to hospital; asymptomatic ones follow the table; recompression at a tolerable rate not exceeding 24.4 m (80 ft) per minute.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用水面供氣設備供氣時，應於潛水深度壓力下對每一潛水勞工每分鐘供給多少公升以上？
questions.q_en: Surface-supplied air must deliver to each diver, at depth pressure, at least how many liters per minute?
questions.explain_zh: 第50條：使用水面供氣設備供氣時，應於潛水深度壓力下，對每一潛水作業勞工每分鐘供給六十公升以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 50: at least 60 liters per minute per diver at the pressure of the diving depth.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用充填壓力超過每平方公分多少公斤之氣瓶供氣時，應使用二段以上減壓方式的壓力調節器？
questions.q_en: Cylinders filled above what pressure require a two-stage (or more) regulator?
questions.explain_zh: 第52條：使用充填壓力超過每平方公分十公斤之氣瓶供氣時，應使用有二段以上減壓方式的壓力調節器。第51條：單人潛水需有繩索繫著，二人共潛需在互相視線可及之處。
questions.explain_en: Article 52: above 10 kg/cm², a regulator with two or more stages; Article 51: solo divers must be tethered and buddy divers within sight of each other.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 充填氧氣、空氣、混合氣之水肺氣瓶及高壓氣瓶，每幾年應送合格檢驗單位以工作壓力之幾倍實施水壓測試？
questions.q_en: Scuba and high-pressure cylinders must be hydrostatically tested every how many years, at how many times the working pressure?
questions.explain_zh: 第54條第5款：充填氧氣、空氣、混合氣之水肺氣瓶、緊急備用氣瓶、高壓氣瓶每五年應送至合格檢驗單位，以工作壓力之一點五倍實施水壓測試。檢點紀錄保存五年。
questions.explain_en: Article 54(5): every 5 years at 1.5× working pressure by a qualified testing body; inspection records kept 5 years.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 潛水作業之呼吸供氣不得使用純氧；其供氣氣體標準中一氧化碳應低於多少 ppm？二氧化碳應低於多少 ppm？
questions.q_en: Diving breathing air must not be pure oxygen; CO must be below, and CO2 below:
questions.explain_zh: 第55條：呼吸供氣不得使用純氧；換算一大氣壓下水氣低於六十七 ppm、一氧化碳低於十 ppm、二氧化碳低於一千 ppm、油霧低於每立方公尺五毫克。
questions.explain_en: Article 55: no pure oxygen; at 1 atm equivalent, water vapor below 67 ppm, CO below 10 ppm, CO2 below 1,000 ppm, oil mist below 5 mg/m³.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用水面供氣設備潛水時應至少置連絡員一名；潛水勞工超過一人者，每增加幾人再置連絡員一名？
questions.q_en: Surface-supplied diving requires at least one tender; for more than one diver, one additional tender per how many additional divers?
questions.explain_zh: 第56條：應至少置連絡員一名，潛水作業勞工超過一人者，每增加二人再置連絡員一名，負責與潛水勞工連繫指導下潛上浮、與供氣設備操作勞工連繫、異常時立即連繫、確認頭盔式潛水器正確著裝。
questions.explain_en: Article 56: at least one tender; one more per two additional divers, to guide descent/ascent, liaise with the air supply operator, respond to faults, and check helmet dress.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用水肺從事潛水作業時，除攜帶水中計時器、深度表及潛水刀外，並應使勞工著用何物？
questions.q_en: Scuba divers must carry a dive timer, depth gauge and dive knife, and also wear:
questions.explain_zh: 第57條：水面供氣潛水應攜帶緊急用水肺、信號索、水中計時器、深度表及潛水刀（可通話者得免信號索）；使用水肺潛水應攜帶水中計時器、深度表及潛水刀，並應著用救生衣。
questions.explain_en: Article 57: surface-supplied divers carry a bailout scuba, signal line, timer, depth gauge and knife; scuba divers carry timer, depth gauge and knife and wear a life jacket.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用再壓室時，下列何者正確？
questions.a_zh: 可使用純氧加壓以加快速度
questions.c_zh: 主室與副室門應保持開啟
questions.d_zh: 不得使用純氧加壓；應持續監視並記錄每次加減壓狀況
questions.q_en: When using a recompression chamber, which is correct?
questions.a_en: Pure oxygen may be used to speed up
questions.c_en: Keep the door between main and auxiliary chambers open
questions.d_en: Never pressurize with pure oxygen; continuously monitor and record every compression and decompression
questions.explain_zh: 第64條：當日使用前檢點輸排氣設備、通話設備及警報裝置；不得使用純氧加壓；除進出必要外應關閉主室與副室間之門且使各室壓力相等；應持續監視加減壓狀況並記錄每次狀況。
questions.explain_en: Article 64: daily pre-use checks; no pure oxygen pressurization; keep the inner door closed except when passing with pressures equalized; monitor continuously and record each session.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 再壓室及減壓艙內部，下列何者為正確規定？
questions.d_zh: 內部不得設置開關及插座等電路連接器，電路不得有分歧
questions.q_en: Inside recompression and decompression chambers, which is correct?
questions.d_en: No switches, sockets or other electrical connectors inside, and no branched circuits
questions.explain_zh: 第73、75、89、91條：再壓室及減壓艙內部不得設置開關及插座等電路連接器；內部電路不得有分歧；電氣機械器具不得產生火花電弧；照明器具應直接附置於頂上、可耐最高使用壓力、具金屬護罩；地面床具應為不燃性材料。
questions.explain_en: Articles 73/75/89/91: no switches or sockets inside; no branched circuits; no spark- or arc-producing electrical equipment; ceiling-mounted pressure-rated lights with metal guards; non-combustible floors and furnishings.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 減壓艙主供氣系統之氣量應足夠供減壓艙加壓至多少公尺深度幾次並安全上升至水面？
questions.q_en: A decompression chamber's main air supply must suffice to pressurize the chamber to what depth how many times and return safely to the surface?
questions.explain_zh: 第86條：主供氣系統應足夠供減壓艙加壓至五十公尺深度兩次並安全上升至水面全程供氣；副供氣系統足夠加壓至五十公尺一次及安全上升之一小時供氣；並應有呼吸用專用空壓機及過濾器、純氧供氣瓶組。
questions.explain_en: Article 86: main system: two pressurizations to 50 m plus full ascent; backup: one pressurization to 50 m plus one hour of ascent supply; plus a dedicated breathing-air compressor with filter and pure-oxygen cylinders.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則所稱「危害性化學品」，其分類依據為何？
questions.q_en: 'Hazardous chemicals' under the Labeling and Hazard Communication Rules are classified according to:
questions.explain_zh: 第2條：危險物指符合國家標準CNS 15030分類具有物理性危害者；有害物指符合CNS 15030分類具有健康危害者。
questions.explain_en: Article 2: dangerous substances have physical hazards and harmful substances have health hazards, both classified per CNS 15030 (the GHS-based standard).

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者不適用危害性化學品標示及通識規則？
questions.c_zh: 食品、飲料、藥品、醫療器材、化粧品
questions.q_en: Which is NOT covered by the Hazardous Chemicals Labeling and Communication Rules?
questions.c_en: Food, beverages, pharmaceuticals, medical devices and cosmetics
questions.explain_zh: 第4條不適用：事業廢棄物、菸草或菸草製品、食品飲料藥品醫療器材化粧品、製成品、非工業用途之一般民生消費商品、滅火器、反應槽或製程中正在反應之中間產物、其他指定者。
questions.explain_en: Article 4 exemptions: industrial waste; tobacco products; food, beverages, drugs, medical devices, cosmetics; articles (manufactured items); non-industrial consumer goods; fire extinguishers; intermediates reacting in process vessels; others designated.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 規則所稱「製成品」，其特徵為何？
questions.b_zh: 已形成特定形狀或設計，最終用途決定於該形狀，且正常使用下不會釋放危害性化學品
questions.c_zh: 任何包裝完成之化學品
questions.q_en: An 'article' (manufactured item) under the Rules is characterized by:
questions.b_en: A specific shape or design that determines its end use, and no release of hazardous chemicals in normal use
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第1款：製成品指在製造過程中已形成特定形狀或依特定設計，其最終用途全部或部分決定於該特定形狀或設計，且在正常使用狀況下不會釋放出危害性化學品之物品。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(1): an article has a specific shape or design that wholly or partly determines its end-use function and does not release hazardous chemicals under normal use.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 裝有危害性化學品之容器，應標示之事項不包括下列何者？
questions.d_zh: 警示語、危害警告訊息、危害防範措施
questions.q_en: Which is NOT a required element on a hazardous chemical container label?
questions.d_en: Signal word, hazard statements and precautionary statements
questions.explain_zh: 第5條：應標示危害圖式，及名稱、危害成分、警示語、危害警告訊息、危害防範措施、製造者輸入者或供應者之名稱地址及電話；文字以中文為主，必要時輔以外文。
questions.explain_en: Article 5: pictogram; name; hazardous ingredients; signal word; hazard statements; precautionary statements; manufacturer/importer/supplier name, address and phone; Chinese text, with foreign language where needed.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 容器之容積在多少毫升以下者，得僅標示名稱、危害圖式及警示語？
questions.q_en: Containers of what volume or less may be labeled with only the name, pictogram and signal word?
questions.explain_zh: 第5條第3項：容器之容積在一百毫升以下者，得僅標示名稱、危害圖式及警示語。
questions.explain_en: Article 5(3): containers of 100 mL or less may show only the name, hazard pictogram and signal word.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 危害圖式之形狀及顏色規定為何？
questions.c_zh: 直立四十五度角之正方形（菱形），符號黑色、背景白色、紅框
questions.q_en: What are the shape and colors of a hazard pictogram?
questions.c_en: A square set at 45° (diamond) with black symbol, white background and red border
questions.explain_zh: 第7條：危害圖式形狀為直立四十五度角之正方形，大小需能辨識清楚；圖式符號應使用黑色，背景為白色，圖式之紅框有足夠警示作用之寬度。
questions.explain_en: Article 7: a square rotated 45°, clearly legible, with a black symbol on a white background inside a sufficiently wide red frame.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何種容器得免標示？
questions.b_zh: 勞工使用之可攜帶容器，其化學品取自有標示之容器，且僅供裝入之勞工當班立即使用
questions.q_en: Which container may be exempt from labeling?
questions.b_en: A portable container filled from a labeled container for immediate use by that worker during the shift
questions.explain_zh: 第8條免標示：外部容器已標示僅供內襯且不再取出之內部容器；內部容器已標示且由外部可見之外部容器；勞工使用之可攜帶容器取自有標示容器且僅供裝入之勞工當班立即使用；取自有標示容器供實驗室自行實驗研究之用。
questions.explain_en: Article 8 exemptions: inner liners not removed when the outer container is labeled; outer containers through which an inner label is visible; portable containers filled from labeled containers for the filling worker's immediate use that shift; lab containers for the lab's own research.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 裝有危害性化學品之導管或配管系統，得以何種方式代替容器標示？
questions.c_zh: 設置公告板，或掛使用牌、漆規定識別顏色及記號
questions.q_en: For pipelines and piping systems carrying hazardous chemicals, container labels may be replaced by:
questions.c_en: A posted notice board, or hanging usage tags or painting the prescribed identification colors and marks
questions.explain_zh: 第9條：裝同一種化學品之數個容器置於同一處所、導管或配管系統、反應器蒸餾塔等化學設備、冷卻攪拌壓縮裝置、輸送裝置，得於明顯處設置公告板代替容器標示；屬管系者得掛使用牌或漆有規定識別顏色及記號替代。
questions.explain_en: Article 9: notice boards may replace labels for grouped containers, pipelines, chemical equipment (reactors, columns), cooling/mixing/compression equipment and conveyors; piping may use tags or prescribed color codes.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 製造者、輸入者或供應者提供危害性化學品與事業單位前，應辦理何事？
questions.d_zh: 於容器上予以標示，並提供安全資料表
questions.q_en: Before supplying hazardous chemicals to an enterprise, manufacturers, importers or suppliers shall:
questions.d_en: Label the container and provide a safety data sheet
questions.explain_zh: 第11條：提供危害性化學品與事業單位或自營作業者前，應於容器上予以標示，準用第5至9條規定。第13條：並應提供安全資料表，混合物應依混合後之危害性製作。
questions.explain_en: Article 11: label containers per Articles 5–9; Article 13: provide an SDS, prepared for the mixture's overall hazards.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主對含有危害性化學品之每一化學品，應提供勞工何種文件？其文字規定為何？
questions.d_zh: 安全資料表；以中文為主，必要時輔以勞工能瞭解之外文
questions.q_en: For each hazardous chemical, the employer shall provide workers with what document, in which language?
questions.d_en: A safety data sheet; mainly Chinese, supplemented by a language workers understand where needed
questions.explain_zh: 第12條：雇主對含有危害性化學品或符合附表三規定之每一化學品，應依附表四提供勞工安全資料表；所用文字以中文為主，必要時並輔以作業勞工所能瞭解之外文。
questions.explain_en: Article 12: an SDS per Annex 4 for each hazardous chemical, mainly in Chinese with a foreign language workers understand where necessary.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 安全資料表至少應每幾年檢討一次？其更新紀錄應保存幾年？
questions.q_en: SDSs must be reviewed at least every how many years, and update records kept how long?
questions.explain_zh: 第15條：製造者、輸入者、供應者或雇主應依實際狀況檢討安全資料表內容正確性，適時更新，並至少每三年檢討一次；更新之內容、日期、版次等紀錄應保存三年。
questions.explain_en: Article 15: review accuracy and update as needed, at least every three years; keep update records (content, date, version) for three years.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主為使勞工知悉危害性化學品之危害資訊，應採取之措施不包括下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 製作危害性化學品清單
questions.b_zh: 將安全資料表鎖在主管辦公室
questions.c_zh: 訂定危害通識計畫並執行，紀錄保存三年
questions.d_zh: 將安全資料表置於工作場所易取得之處
questions.q_en: Which is NOT a required hazard communication measure?
questions.b_en: Locking SDSs in the manager's office
questions.c_en: A hazard communication program, implemented with 3-year records
questions.d_en: SDSs placed where workers can easily access them
questions.explain_zh: 第17條：依實際狀況訂定危害通識計畫並執行（紀錄保存三年）；製作危害性化學品清單；將安全資料表置於工作場所易取得之處；使勞工接受製造處置使用危害性化學品之教育訓練；其他必要措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 17: a hazard communication program (records 3 years), a chemical inventory, SDSs readily accessible in the workplace, training per the Training Rules, and other necessary measures.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 危害通識計畫應包含哪些必要項目？
questions.b_zh: 危害性化學品清單、安全資料表、標示、危害通識教育訓練之擬訂執行紀錄及修正
questions.q_en: A hazard communication program must include:
questions.b_en: Planning, implementation, records and revision of the chemical inventory, SDSs, labeling and hazard communication training
questions.explain_zh: 第17條第2項：危害通識計畫應含危害性化學品清單、安全資料表、標示、危害通識教育訓練等必要項目之擬訂、執行、紀錄及修正措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 17(2): the program covers the chemical inventory, SDSs, labels and training, with planning, implementation, records and revisions.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 製造者、輸入者或供應者為保護商品營業秘密，欲保留揭示安全資料表中之危害成分名稱等，應向何機關申請核定？
questions.q_en: To withhold trade-secret ingredient information from an SDS, the manufacturer, importer or supplier must apply for approval to:
questions.explain_zh: 第18條：為維護國家安全或商品營業秘密，保留揭示成分名稱、CAS號碼、含量或供應者名稱時，應檢附證明、對策、經濟利益評估、危害性分類說明等文件，向中央主管機關申請核定；補正以二次為限，每次三十日內。
questions.explain_en: Article 18: apply to the central competent authority with proof of national security or trade secret, protective measures, economic impact assessment and hazard classification; corrections within 30 days, at most twice.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何種危害性化學品成分，不得申請保留安全資料表內容之揭示？
questions.d_zh: 致癌物質、生殖毒性物質、勞工作業場所容許暴露標準所列之化學物質
questions.q_en: Which ingredients can NOT be withheld from SDS disclosure as trade secrets?
questions.d_en: Carcinogens, reproductive toxicants and substances listed in the workplace exposure standards
questions.explain_zh: 第18條之1：勞工作業場所容許暴露標準所列之化學物質；CNS 15030分類之急毒性物質第一至三級、腐蝕或刺激皮膚第一級、嚴重損傷眼睛第一級、呼吸道或皮膚致敏物質、生殖細胞致突變性物質、致癌物質、生殖毒性物質、特定標的器官毒性單一及重複暴露第一級、吸入性危害第一級，不得申請保留揭示。
questions.explain_en: Article 18-1: substances in the permissible exposure standards; CNS 15030 acute toxicity categories 1–3, skin corrosion/irritation cat. 1, serious eye damage cat. 1, respiratory/skin sensitizers, germ cell mutagens, carcinogens, reproductive toxicants, STOT single/repeated cat. 1, aspiration hazard cat. 1.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 主管機關、勞動檢查機構或醫師、緊急應變人員因緊急醫療及搶救需要，要求提供安全資料表及其保留揭示之資訊時，製造者、供應者或事業單位得否拒絕？
questions.a_zh: 不得拒絕；取得營業秘密者有保密義務
questions.q_en: When authorities, inspectors, physicians or emergency responders request an SDS and withheld information for emergency care, may the supplier or enterprise refuse?
questions.a_en: No; recipients of trade secrets must keep them confidential
questions.explain_zh: 第19條：主管機關、勞動檢查機構為執行業務或醫師、緊急應變人員為緊急醫療及搶救之需要，得要求提供安全資料表及其保留揭示之資訊，不得拒絕；取得商品營業秘密者有保密之義務。
questions.explain_en: Article 19: they must not refuse; anyone who obtains trade secrets this way has a duty of confidentiality.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 民國115年8月26日修正發布之第5條附表一及第12條附表四，自何時施行？
questions.q_en: The 2026 (ROC 115) amendments to Annex 1 of Article 5 and Annex 4 of Article 12 take effect on:
questions.explain_zh: 第23條：一百十五年八月二十六日修正發布之第五條附表一、第十二條附表四，自一百十八年一月一日施行；其餘修正條文自發布日施行。
questions.explain_en: Article 23: the Annex 1 and Annex 4 amendments promulgated on 26 August ROC 115 take effect on 1 January ROC 118 (2029); other amendments took effect on promulgation.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 混合物未作整體測試者，其健康危害性應如何認定？
questions.b_zh: 除有科學資料佐證外，依 CNS 15030 之混合物分類標準
questions.q_en: How is the health hazard of an untested mixture determined?
questions.a_en: By the ingredient with the highest content
questions.b_en: Per the CNS 15030 mixture classification criteria, unless scientific data show otherwise
questions.explain_zh: 第6條：混合物已作整體測試者依整體測試結果；未作整體測試者，其健康危害性除有科學資料佐證外，應依CNS 15030分類之混合物分類標準；燃燒、爆炸及反應性等物理性危害使用有科學根據之資料評估。
questions.explain_en: Article 6: tested mixtures use test results; untested ones follow CNS 15030 mixture classification for health hazards unless scientific evidence exists; physical hazards are assessed with scientifically based data.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 裝有危害性化學品之容器於運輸時已依交通法規設置標示者，該容器於工作場所內運輸時是否須再依附表一標示？
questions.q_en: If a container already bears transport labeling under traffic regulations, must it be relabeled per Annex 1 while transported within the workplace?
questions.b_en: No, it is exempt during in-plant transport
questions.d_en: The transport label must be removed
questions.explain_zh: 第10條：於運輸時已依交通法規有關運輸之規定設置標示者，該容器於工作場所內運輸時得免再依附表一標示；但勞工從事卸放、搬運、處置或使用時，雇主仍應依本規則辦理。
questions.explain_en: Article 10: exempt during transport within the workplace, but once workers unload, handle, process or use the chemical the Rules apply.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 缺氧症預防規則係依職業安全衛生法第幾條規定訂定？
questions.q_en: The Hypoxia Prevention Rules are enacted under which article of the OSH Act?
questions.explain_zh: 第1條：本規則依職業安全衛生法第六條第三項規定訂定之。
questions.explain_en: Article 1: enacted under Article 6(3) of the Occupational Safety and Health Act.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 貫通或鄰接下列何種地層之坑井、隧道內部屬缺氧危險場所？
questions.b_zh: 含有亞鐵鹽類或亞錳鹽類之地層
questions.q_en: Shafts or tunnels penetrating or adjacent to which stratum are hazardous places?
questions.b_en: Strata containing ferrous or manganous salts
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第2項第2款：上層覆有不透水層之砂礫層中無含水或湧水較少之部分；含有亞鐵鹽類或亞錳鹽類之地層；含有甲烷、乙烷或丁烷之地層；湧出碳酸水之虞之地層；腐泥層。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(2)(2): dry gravel under impermeable layers; strata with ferrous or manganous salts; strata with methane, ethane or butane; strata that may emit carbonated water; putrid mud layers.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 置放煤、褐煤、硫化礦石、鋼材、鐵屑、原木片、乾性油、魚油等物質之儲槽或倉庫內部屬缺氧危險場所，原因為何？
questions.d_zh: 該等物質易吸收空氣中之氧氣
questions.q_en: Why are storages of coal, sulfide ore, steel, iron scrap, wood chips, drying oil or fish oil hazardous places?
questions.d_en: These materials readily absorb oxygen from the air
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第2項第7款：置放煤、褐煤、硫化礦石、鋼材、鐵屑、原木片、木屑、乾性油、魚油或其他易吸收空氣中氧氣之物質之儲槽、船艙、倉庫、地窖、貯煤器等之內部。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(2)(7): such materials readily absorb atmospheric oxygen, so tanks, holds, warehouses, cellars and coal bunkers holding them are hazardous.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 使用乾冰從事冷凍、冷藏之冷凍庫、冷凍貨車或冷凍貨櫃內部，屬缺氧危險場所之原因為何？
questions.a_zh: 乾冰昇華產生二氧化碳排擠氧氣
questions.q_en: Why are freezers, reefer trucks or containers using dry ice hazardous places?
questions.a_en: Sublimating dry ice releases CO2 that displaces oxygen
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第2項第12款：使用乾冰從事冷凍、冷藏或水泥乳之脫鹼等之冷藏庫、冷凍庫、冷凍貨車、船艙或冷凍貨櫃之內部。乾冰昇華釋出二氧化碳而降低氧氣濃度。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(2)(12): cold rooms, freezers, reefer trucks, holds or containers using dry ice; sublimation releases CO2 and reduces oxygen.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 於儲槽、鍋爐內部使用氬、二氧化碳或氦從事熔接作業時，應保持氧氣濃度在百分之多少以上？
questions.q_en: During welding with argon, CO2 or helium inside tanks or boilers, oxygen must be kept at or above:
questions.explain_zh: 第9條：於儲槽、鍋爐或反應槽內部或其他通風不充分場所使用氬、二氧化碳或氦等從事熔接作業時，應予適當換氣以保持氧氣濃度在百分之十八以上；不得使用純氧換氣。
questions.explain_en: Article 9: ventilate to keep oxygen at 18% or more inside tanks, boilers or other poorly ventilated places; never ventilate with pure oxygen.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 於通風不充分之室內作業場所，為防止儲槽、反應槽安全閥排出之惰性氣體流入，應設置何種設施？
questions.c_zh: 可使安全閥排出之氣體直接排放於外部之設施
questions.q_en: In poorly ventilated indoor workplaces, to prevent inert gas from tank relief valves flowing in, the employer shall install:
questions.c_en: Facilities that discharge relief-valve gas directly outdoors
questions.explain_zh: 第11條：應設置可使安全閥等所排出之氣體直接排放於外部之設施。
questions.explain_en: Article 11: facilities to vent gases from safety valves directly to the outside.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 採用壓氣施工法之作業場所，鄰近特定地層時應調查何事？
questions.d_zh: 作業之井或配管有否空氣漏洩、漏洩程度及作業場所氧氣濃度
questions.q_en: For compressed-air construction near specified strata, the employer shall survey:
questions.d_en: Whether and how much air leaks from wells or piping, and the oxygen concentration at the site
questions.explain_zh: 第13條：採用壓氣施工法之場所存有或鄰近第2條第2項第2款第1目或第2目地層時，應調查該作業之井或配管有否空氣之漏洩、漏洩之程度及該作業場所空氣中氧氣之濃度。第19條發現漏洩時應即通知並公告緊急措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 13: check for air leakage from wells or piping, its extent, and the oxygen concentration; Article 19: on finding oxygen-deficient air leaking in, notify personnel and post emergency measures.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 於地下室或溝內部從事拆卸或安裝輸送甲烷、乙烷、丙烷、丁烷等氣體配管作業時，應採取何種措施？
questions.c_zh: 確實遮斷該氣體之設施，使其不致流入作業場所
questions.q_en: When removing or installing piping for methane, ethane, propane or butane in basements or trenches, the employer shall:
questions.c_en: Reliably isolate the gas so it cannot flow into the work area
questions.d_en: Test for gas with a flame
questions.explain_zh: 第15條：於地下室或溝之內部及其他通風不充分之室內作業場所拆卸或安裝輸送主成分為甲烷、乙烷、丙烷、丁烷或此類混入空氣的氣體配管作業時，應採取確實遮斷該氣體之設施。
questions.explain_en: Article 15: install facilities that positively shut off the gas so it cannot enter the removal or installation area.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 從事缺氧危險作業受鄰接作業場所影響致有缺氧危險之虞時，雇主應如何？
questions.a_zh: 與各該作業場所密切保持聯繫
questions.b_zh: 停止鄰接作業場所之作業
questions.q_en: When adjacent worksites could cause an oxygen-deficiency risk, the employer shall:
questions.a_en: Maintain close liaison with those worksites
questions.explain_zh: 第22條：如受鄰接作業場所之影響致有發生缺氧危險之虞時，應與各該作業場所密切保持聯繫。
questions.explain_en: Article 22: keep in close contact with the adjacent worksites.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 勞工從事缺氧危險作業有因缺氧致墜落之虞時，雇主應供給何物？
questions.q_en: When a worker may fall due to hypoxia, the employer shall provide:
questions.a_en: A ladder, safety harness or lifeline
questions.explain_zh: 第26條：應供給該勞工使用之梯子、安全帶或救生索，並使勞工確實使用。第29條：應定期或每次作業開始前確認第25至28條防護設備之數量及效能。
questions.explain_en: Article 26: ladders, harnesses or lifelines, and ensure their use; Article 29: check the quantity and function of protective equipment regularly or before each job.

questions.law: 缺氧症預防規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬缺氧症之末期症狀？
questions.b_zh: 意識不明、痙攣、呼吸停止或心臟停止跳動
questions.q_en: Which are late-stage symptoms of hypoxia?
questions.b_en: Unconsciousness, convulsions, respiratory arrest or cardiac arrest
questions.explain_zh: 第31條第2款：意識不明、痙攣、呼吸停止或心臟停止跳動等為缺氧症之末期症狀，應即由醫師診治。
questions.explain_en: Article 31(2): unconsciousness, convulsions, respiratory or cardiac arrest are late symptoms requiring immediate medical care.

questions.law: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準
questions.q_zh: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準係依職業安全衛生法第幾條規定訂定？
questions.q_en: The Work-at-Height Protection Standards are enacted under which OSH Act article?
questions.explain_zh: 第1條：本標準依職業安全衛生法第十九條第二項規定訂定之（高溫作業標準、異常氣壓標準亦依第19條第2項）。
questions.explain_en: Article 1: under Article 19(2) of the OSH Act, the same basis as the high-temperature and abnormal-pressure standards.

questions.law: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準
questions.q_zh: 室內作業或儲槽等場所之高架作業高度，如何計算？
questions.c_zh: 自勞工頭頂至天花板之距離
questions.d_zh: 自勞工站立位置與地板間之垂直距離
questions.q_en: Indoors or in tanks, the height of work at height is measured as:
questions.d_en: The vertical distance from the worker's standing position to the floor
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第2項第2款：室內作業或儲槽等場所，自勞工站立位置與地板間之垂直距離。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(2)(2): the vertical distance between the worker's standing position and the floor.

questions.law: 高架作業勞工保護措施標準
questions.q_zh: 身體虛弱經醫師診斷認為身體狀況不良之勞工，雇主得否使其從事高架作業？
questions.q_en: May an employer assign work at height to a worker a physician has diagnosed as physically unfit?
questions.explain_zh: 第8條第2款：身體虛弱，經醫師診斷認為身體狀況不良者，雇主不得使其從事高架作業；第3款情緒不穩定有安全顧慮者、第4款勞工自覺不適者亦同。
questions.explain_en: Article 8(2): no; likewise for emotionally unstable workers with safety concerns and workers who feel unfit.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 高溫作業已採取自動化操作方式且勞工無暴露熱危害之虞者，是否適用高溫作業標準？
questions.q_en: Are automated operations with no worker heat exposure covered as high-temperature work?
questions.explain_zh: 第2條第2項：前項作業，不包括已採取自動化操作方式且勞工無暴露熱危害之虞者。
questions.explain_en: Article 2(2): operations that are automated with no risk of heat exposure are excluded.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 時量平均綜合溫度熱指數之計算方式為何？
questions.a_zh: 各次熱指數乘各次工作時間之總和，除以總工作時間
questions.c_zh: 各次熱指數之簡單平均
questions.q_en: The time-weighted average WBGT is calculated as:
questions.a_en: Sum of each WBGT times its work period, divided by total work time
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第2項：時量平均綜合溫度熱指數＝(第一次熱指數×第一次工作時間＋…＋第n次熱指數×第n次工作時間)÷(第一次工作時間＋…＋第n次工作時間)，均以攝氏表示。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(2): sum of WBGT × time for each period, divided by total time, in degrees Celsius.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 於走動中提舉或推動一般重量物體之工作，屬何種工作？
questions.q_en: Lifting or pushing ordinary loads while walking is classified as:
questions.explain_zh: 第4條：中度工作指於走動中提舉或推動一般重量物體者。
questions.explain_en: Article 4: moderate work means lifting or pushing objects of ordinary weight while walking.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 中度工作之時量平均綜合溫度熱指數達攝氏 29.4 度時，每小時作息比例為何？
questions.q_en: For moderate work at a time-weighted WBGT of 29.4°C, the hourly ratio is:
questions.explain_en: Article 5 table: moderate work 28.0 continuous, 29.4 = 25% rest, 31.1 = 50% rest, 32.6 = 75% rest.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 重工作之時量平均綜合溫度熱指數達攝氏 32.1 度時，每小時作業比例最多為多少？
questions.q_en: For heavy work at a time-weighted WBGT of 32.1°C, the maximum hourly work proportion is:
questions.explain_zh: 第5條表：重工作 32.1 對應 75% 休息、25% 作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 5 table: heavy work at 32.1 = 75% rest / 25% work.

questions.law: 高溫作業勞工作息時間標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主原訂高溫作業勞工之工作條件優於高溫作業標準者，應如何？
questions.q_en: If an employer's existing conditions for high-temperature workers are better than the Standards:
questions.c_en: They must be lowered to the Standards
questions.explain_zh: 第8條：雇主原訂高溫作業勞工之工作條件優於本標準者，從其規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 8: the more favorable employer terms prevail.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主僱用勞工從事異常氣壓作業時，應依何規定實施健康檢查及管理？
questions.q_en: Health examinations for abnormal-pressure workers shall follow:
questions.explain_zh: 第4條：應依勞工健康保護規則之規定，實施勞工健康檢查及管理。
questions.explain_en: Article 4: per the Labor Health Protection Rules.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 空氣壓縮機與作業室或氣閘室之間應設置何種裝置？
questions.q_en: Between the air compressor and the working chamber or air lock, the employer shall install:
questions.explain_zh: 第8條：應於空氣壓縮機與作業室或與氣閘室之間設置空氣清淨裝置，以清淨輸往各該室之空氣。第11條：另應設置防止異常升溫之自動警報裝置。
questions.explain_en: Article 8: an air purifier to clean the supplied air; Article 11: an automatic alarm for abnormal temperature rise.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 為防止空氣壓縮機輸往作業室之空氣發生異常升溫，應設置何種裝置？
questions.c_zh: 能迅即告知操作勞工之自動警報裝置
questions.q_en: To guard against abnormal temperature rise in compressed air sent to the chamber, the employer shall install:
questions.c_en: An automatic alarm that immediately alerts the compressor operator
questions.explain_zh: 第11條：應設置能迅即告知操作該空氣壓縮機之勞工及其他有關人員之自動警報裝置。
questions.explain_en: Article 11: an automatic alarm notifying the compressor operator and related personnel immediately.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 雇主對與工作無關人員擅進作業室及氣閘室，應如何？
questions.a_zh: 嚴禁，並將禁止事項揭示於沈箱外面顯明處
questions.q_en: Regarding unauthorized persons entering the working chamber or air lock, the employer shall:
questions.a_en: Strictly prohibit it and post the prohibition conspicuously outside the caisson
questions.explain_zh: 第17條：應嚴禁與工作無關人員擅進作業室及氣閘室，並將有關禁止事項揭示於沈箱、壓氣潛盾等之外面顯明易見之處所。
questions.explain_en: Article 17: strictly prohibit entry and post the prohibition clearly outside the caisson or shield.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 高壓室內作業「高壓下時間」係指何段時間？作業壓力在每平方公分四公斤以下且一日作業次數二次以下者依何附表？
questions.a_zh: 自進入作業室至離開之時間；附表二
questions.d_zh: 自開始加壓至開始減壓之時間；附表一
questions.q_en: 'Time under pressure' in hyperbaric work runs from when to when, and which table applies at 4 kg/cm² or less with at most two sessions a day?
questions.a_en: From entering to leaving the chamber; Table 2
questions.d_en: From start of compression to start of decompression; Table 1
questions.explain_zh: 第19條：高壓下時間指自開始加壓至開始減壓之時間；作業壓力四公斤以下且一日二次以下者依附表一；超過四公斤或超過二次者依附表二並依附表三修正。
questions.explain_en: Article 19: from the start of compression to the start of decompression; Table 1 for 4 kg/cm² or less and two sessions or fewer; Table 2 with Table 3 corrections otherwise.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 為防止作業室內危險或有害氣體危害高壓室內作業勞工，應採取何措施？
questions.c_zh: 換氣、測定氣體濃度及其他必要措施
questions.q_en: To protect hyperbaric workers from dangerous or harmful gases, the employer shall:
questions.c_en: Ventilate, measure gas concentrations and take other necessary measures
questions.explain_zh: 第24條：應採取換氣、測定氣體濃度及其他必要措施。第16條主管亦須檢點測定二氧化碳、一氧化碳、甲烷、硫化氫等濃度之儀器。
questions.explain_en: Article 24: ventilation, gas measurement and other measures; Article 16: the supervisor checks meters for CO2, CO, methane and H2S.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 因緊急事故增加減壓速率使高壓室內勞工避難後，雇主應如何處置？
questions.d_zh: 迅即送入再壓室或氣閘室，加壓至原作業相等之壓力
questions.q_en: After an emergency rapid decompression to evacuate hyperbaric workers, the employer shall:
questions.d_en: Promptly place them in a recompression chamber or air lock and recompress to the original working pressure
questions.explain_zh: 第26條：緊急時得在必要限度內增加減壓速率或縮短停止時間，但應於勞工避難或救出後迅即送入再壓室或氣閘室，加壓至原高壓室內作業相等之壓力，加壓速率依第18條。
questions.explain_en: Article 26: recompress promptly to the original pressure in a recompression chamber or air lock, at the rate in Article 18.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 高壓室內作業之通話設備故障時之連絡方法，雇主應如何處理？
questions.c_zh: 事前告知相關勞工並揭示於易見處
questions.q_en: The contact method for when the hyperbaric communication system fails must be:
questions.c_en: Set in advance, told to workers and posted where they can see it
questions.explain_zh: 第29條：應設置通話設備並於氣閘室附近配置連絡員；應規定通話設備故障時之連絡方法，事前告知相關勞工並揭示於勞工易見之處所。
questions.explain_en: Article 29: install communication equipment with a liaison near the air lock, and pre-establish, communicate and post the fallback contact method.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 輸氣設備發生故障、出水或其他異常致高壓室內勞工有遭受危害之虞時，雇主應如何？
questions.a_zh: 迅即使勞工自沈箱撤離並採取避難措施，確認安全前不得使指定人員以外者進入
questions.q_en: When the air supply fails or water enters and hyperbaric workers are endangered, the employer shall:
questions.a_en: Evacuate workers from the caisson immediately, and allow only designated personnel in until safety is confirmed
questions.explain_zh: 第31條：應迅即使勞工撤離並採取避難措施；之後確認輸氣設備是否正常、沈箱有無異常沈降傾斜；非確認安全前不得使指定人員以外之人員進入。
questions.explain_en: Article 31: evacuate immediately, then verify the air supply and check for abnormal sinking or tilting; only designated personnel may enter before safety is confirmed.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 為沈降沈箱而抽出作業室內空氣時，應先如何？
questions.d_zh: 撤出該室內作業之勞工
questions.q_en: Before extracting air from the working chamber to sink the caisson, the employer shall:
questions.d_en: Withdraw the workers from the chamber
questions.explain_zh: 第32條：為沈降沈箱而抽出作業室內之空氣時，應先撤出該室內作業之勞工；之後確認無出水或有害氣體，安全前不得使指定人員以外者進入。
questions.explain_en: Article 32: withdraw workers first; afterwards confirm there is no water ingress or harmful gas before non-designated personnel enter.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 於作業室內施炸後，在何種條件下始可允許人員進入？
questions.c_zh: 確認作業室內空氣恢復至正常狀態
questions.q_en: After blasting in the working chamber, entry is allowed only when:
questions.c_en: The air in the chamber is confirmed to be back to normal
questions.explain_zh: 第33條：作業室內施炸後，為防止缺氧或有害氣體之危害，在確認該作業室內之空氣恢復至正常狀態前，應嚴禁任何人進入作業室。
questions.explain_en: Article 33: no one may enter until the chamber air is confirmed normal, to prevent hypoxia or harmful gases.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 潛水作業場所有船隻進入或進行爆破、拖網之虞時，雇主應如何？
questions.c_zh: 安排船舶戒護，並設置潛水作業警告旗誌、警示燈、錨標等警告標示
questions.q_en: When vessels, blasting or trawling may endanger divers, the employer shall:
questions.c_en: Arrange guard vessels and post warning signals such as dive flags, warning lights and buoys
questions.explain_zh: 第41條：應安排船舶戒護，並於作業場所設置必要而顯著之警告標示及措施，包括符合規定之潛水作業警告旗誌、警示燈、錨標。
questions.explain_en: Article 41: guard boats plus conspicuous warnings including the prescribed dive flag, warning lights and anchor buoys.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬應提供必要裝備並告知特殊危害預防事項之特殊危險潛水作業？
questions.a_zh: 水下切割及熔接、進出沈船洞穴、夜間低能見度水域、高速水流水域
questions.q_en: Which are 'special hazardous diving operations' requiring extra equipment and hazard briefing?
questions.a_en: Underwater cutting/welding, wreck or cave penetration, night or low-visibility water, strong currents
questions.explain_zh: 第42條列舉：水下爆破、水下切割及熔接、進出沈船洞穴佈設海底管線、寒冷或高溫水域、海域探測、遭受污染水域、夜間及低能見度水域、高速水流或渦流水域、特殊海洋生物危害等潛水作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 42: underwater blasting, cutting and welding, wrecks/caves/pipelines, cold or hot water, ocean surveys, polluted water, night or low visibility, strong currents or eddies, dangerous marine life.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 於海拔多少公尺以上高海拔地區從事潛水作業，應依附表四之四、四之五規定辦理？
questions.b_zh: 九十一點五公尺（三百呎）
questions.q_en: Diving at altitudes above what elevation must follow Tables 4-4 and 4-5?
questions.explain_zh: 第45條：於九十一點五公尺（三百呎）以上高海拔地區潛水應依附表四之四、四之五辦理；作業後離開據點高程壓力差超過三百零五公尺（一千呎）者，應依附表四之六完成水面上休息並記錄保存五年。
questions.explain_en: Article 45: above 91.5 m (300 ft); leaving to a site with over 305 m (1,000 ft) elevation difference requires a surface interval per Table 4-6, recorded and kept 5 years.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用水肺供氣（緊急用氣瓶外）潛水時，單人潛水應如何？二人共潛應如何？
questions.a_zh: 單人需連絡員；二人不需
questions.b_zh: 單人不需繩索；二人可分開
questions.c_zh: 單人需有繩索繫著；二人需隨時在互相視線可及之處
questions.q_en: For scuba diving, a solo diver must be, and buddy divers must be:
questions.c_en: Tethered by a line; within each other's sight at all times
questions.explain_zh: 第51條：潛水前告知氣瓶供氣能力；設置潛水作業主管全程掌握；單人潛水需有繩索繫著，二人共潛需隨時在互相視線可及之處。
questions.explain_en: Article 51: brief the diver on cylinder capacity, assign a supervisor, tether solo divers, and keep buddy pairs within sight.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 潛水作業供下潛或上浮使用之安全索，應如何標記？
questions.c_zh: 依減壓站之停留深度以木標或布條作記錄
questions.q_en: The descent/ascent safety line must be marked:
questions.c_en: At decompression stop depths with wooden tags or cloth strips
questions.explain_zh: 第53條：應供給下潛或上浮使用之安全索並監督確實使用；安全索應依減壓站之停留深度以木標或布條作記錄。
questions.explain_en: Article 53: provide and enforce use of the safety line, marked at decompression stop depths with wooden markers or cloth strips.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用水面供氣設備潛水時，空氣壓縮機或手動氣泵應多久檢點一次？流量計應多久檢點一次？
questions.q_en: For surface-supplied diving, the compressor or hand pump is inspected how often, and the flow meter how often?
questions.explain_zh: 第54條第1款：每週檢點空氣壓縮機或手動氣泵；每月檢點空氣清淨裝置及深度表；每季檢點水中計時器；每半年檢點流量計。紀錄保存五年。
questions.explain_en: Article 54(1): compressor weekly; air cleaner and depth gauge monthly; dive timer quarterly; flow meter every six months; records 5 years.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使用水肺供氣潛水者，其氣瓶應多久檢點一次？
questions.q_en: For scuba diving, cylinders must be inspected every:
questions.explain_zh: 第54條第2款：使用緊急用氣瓶外之水肺供氣者，每月檢點深度表、每季檢點水中計時器、每半年檢點氣瓶。
questions.explain_en: Article 54(2): depth gauge monthly, dive timer quarterly, cylinders every six months.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 實施高壓室內作業時應設再壓室；再壓室應避免接近何種場所？
questions.d_zh: 危險物、火藥類或大量易燃性物質之處置儲存場所，及有出水土砂崩塌之虞之場所
questions.q_en: A recompression chamber for hyperbaric work must be kept away from:
questions.d_en: Storage of dangerous goods, explosives or large amounts of flammables, and places at risk of flooding or collapse
questions.explain_zh: 第62條：應設再壓室或採取可隨時利用再壓室之措施；再壓室應避免接近危險物火藥類或大量易燃性物質之處置儲存場所，及有出水、土砂崩塌之虞之場所。
questions.explain_en: Article 62: keep away from dangerous goods, explosives or bulk flammables storage, and from places prone to water ingress or earth collapse.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 再壓室應設置主再壓室及副再壓室，但何者不在此限？
questions.q_en: A recompression chamber needs main and auxiliary compartments, except for:
questions.explain_zh: 第66條：再壓室應設置主再壓室及副再壓室，但移動型者不在此限。第67條：兩室之門應保持氣密，壓力相等時可易於開啟；第68條：均應設置可自外面觀察之視窗。
questions.explain_en: Article 66: mobile chambers are exempt; Articles 67–68: airtight doors that open easily when pressures are equal, and viewing windows on both compartments.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 再壓室內應置滅火所必要之水、砂或其他物品，但下列何者不在此限？
questions.b_zh: 設有防火用灑水裝置、軟質水管或移動型再壓室者
questions.q_en: Water, sand or similar firefighting items must be inside a recompression chamber, except when:
questions.b_en: It has a sprinkler system, a soft water hose, or is a mobile chamber
questions.explain_zh: 第77條：再壓室內應置滅火所必要之水、砂或其他物品，但設有防火用灑水裝置、軟質水管或移動型再壓室者不在此限。第93條減壓艙亦同。
questions.explain_en: Article 77: exempt if equipped with sprinklers or a soft water hose, or if mobile; Article 93 applies the same to decompression chambers.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬減壓艙應具備之設備？
questions.a_zh: 內外雙向通話系統、可調節式氧氣呼吸口罩、視窗、深度表、計時表、安全閥
questions.q_en: Which are required decompression chamber equipment?
questions.a_en: Two-way intercom, adjustable oxygen masks, viewports, depth gauge, timer, safety valve
questions.explain_zh: 第78條：內外雙向通話系統、可調節式氧氣呼吸口罩、內外控制供排氣系統、水砂桶等滅火器具、內部照明系統、視窗、供排氣之深度控制閥及深度表、計時表、安全閥；並應置於潛水工作船或工作站等安全處所。
questions.explain_en: Article 78: intercom, adjustable oxygen masks, inside/outside supply and exhaust controls, water/sand fire kit, lighting, viewports, depth control valves and gauge, timer, safety valve; located in a safe place on the dive vessel or station.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 使潛水人員於減壓艙呼吸純氧減壓時，應先確認何事？
questions.b_zh: 潛水人員已休息八小時
questions.d_zh: 該潛水人員曾通過耐氧試驗，並於執行前通知該人員
questions.q_en: Before having a diver breathe pure oxygen for decompression in the chamber, the operator must confirm:
questions.d_en: The diver has passed an oxygen tolerance test and is informed beforehand
questions.explain_zh: 第80條：由具資格之操作員操作；治療潛水病依醫師指示；使用前檢點；依減壓表執行；如醫療需要呼吸純氧減壓時應確定曾通過耐氧試驗並事前通知；持續監視；事先與最近潛水醫療單位連絡；記錄每次作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 80: qualified operator; treatment per physician; pre-use check; follow tables; oxygen only for divers who passed the oxygen tolerance test and are notified; continuous monitoring; contact the nearest dive medical unit; record each session.

questions.law: 異常氣壓危害預防標準
questions.q_zh: 減壓艙使用前，應事先與何單位連絡並保持通訊？
questions.q_en: Before using a decompression chamber, the employer shall contact and stay in touch with:
questions.explain_zh: 第80條第6款：減壓艙使用前，應事先與最近之潛水醫療單位連絡，並保持通訊，以利緊急支援。
questions.explain_en: Article 80(6): contact the nearest diving medical unit in advance and maintain communication for emergency support.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 規則所稱「容器」，不包含下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 交通工具內之引擎、燃料槽或其他操作系統
questions.q_en: The term 'container' under the Rules does NOT include:
questions.a_en: Engines, fuel tanks or operating systems of vehicles
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第2款：容器指任何袋、筒、瓶、箱、罐、桶、反應器、儲槽、管路及其他可盛裝危害性化學品者，但不包含交通工具內之引擎、燃料槽或其他操作系統。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(2): any bag, drum, bottle, box, can, barrel, reactor, tank, piping or other vessel, excluding vehicle engines, fuel tanks and operating systems.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 規則所稱「供應者」係指何者？
questions.c_zh: 製造危害性化學品之廠商
questions.d_zh: 批發或零售危害性化學品之廠商
questions.q_en: A 'supplier' under the Rules is:
questions.d_en: A business that wholesales or retails hazardous chemicals
questions.explain_zh: 第3條：製造者指製造危害性化學品供批發零售處置或使用之廠商；輸入者指從國外進口之廠商；供應者指批發或零售危害性化學品之廠商。
questions.explain_en: Article 3: manufacturer makes the chemicals; importer brings them in from abroad; supplier wholesales or retails them.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 容器內之危害性化學品為混合物者，其應標示之「危害成分」指何者？
questions.a_zh: 混合物中符合 CNS 15030 分類具物理性或健康危害之所有危害物質成分
questions.q_en: For a mixture, the 'hazardous ingredients' to be labeled are:
questions.a_en: All ingredients with physical or health hazards under CNS 15030 classification
questions.explain_zh: 第5條第2項：混合物之危害成分指混合物之危害性中符合CNS 15030分類，具有物理性危害或健康危害之所有危害物質成分。
questions.explain_en: Article 5(2): all hazardous ingredients classified under CNS 15030 as having physical or health hazards.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 導管、化學設備等以公告板代替標示時，因製造者、輸入者或供應者名稱地址電話經常變更，在何條件下得免標示該事項？
questions.q_en: When a notice board replaces labels on piping or chemical equipment, the supplier name/address/phone may be omitted if:
questions.a_en: A safety data sheet is available
questions.explain_zh: 第9條第2項：第2至5款之容器有公告板者，其製造者輸入者或供應者名稱地址電話經常變更，但備有安全資料表者，得免標示第5條第1項第2款第6目之事項。
questions.explain_en: Article 9(2): where supplier details change frequently, they may be omitted if an SDS is kept available.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 同一種類之混合物濃度不同而危害成分、用途及危害性相同時，得否使用同一份安全資料表？
questions.b_zh: 得，但應註明不同化學品名稱
questions.q_en: May mixtures of the same type but different concentrations, with identical hazardous ingredients, use and hazards, share one SDS?
questions.b_en: Yes, but the different product names must be noted
questions.explain_zh: 第14條：混合物屬同一種類之化學品，其濃度不同而危害成分、用途及危害性相同時，得使用同一份安全資料表，但應註明不同化學品名稱。
questions.explain_en: Article 14: one SDS may be shared, provided the different chemical names are indicated.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 製造者提供之安全資料表有誤寫、缺漏等顯然錯誤時，主管機關應如何處理？
questions.d_zh: 令其限期補正，屆期未補正者依職安法第44條第1項及第49條辦理
questions.q_en: If an SDS contains obvious clerical errors or omissions, the authority shall:
questions.d_en: Order correction within a deadline; failure is handled under OSH Act Articles 44(1) and 49
questions.explain_zh: 第15條之1：安全資料表內容有誤寫、缺漏或其他類此顯然錯誤，主管機關或勞動檢查機構應令其限期補正；屆期未補正者，依本法第44條第1項及第49條規定辦理。
questions.explain_en: Article 15-1: order correction by a deadline; if not corrected, apply Articles 44(1) and 49 of the OSH Act.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 危害性化學品清單之內容格式，應參照何附表？
questions.q_en: The hazardous chemical inventory format follows which annex?
questions.explain_zh: 第17條第1項第2款：製作危害性化學品清單，其內容、格式參照附表五。附表一為分類及標示要項，附表三為應提供SDS之化學品，附表四為SDS格式。
questions.explain_en: Article 17(1)(2): inventory per Annex 5; Annex 1 covers classification and label elements, Annex 3 the chemicals needing SDSs, Annex 4 the SDS format.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 申請保留揭示安全資料表資訊，檢附文件不齊全時，應於補正通知後幾日內補正？補正次數以幾次為限？
questions.q_en: For a trade-secret withholding application with incomplete documents, the deadline and maximum number of corrections are:
questions.explain_zh: 第18條第2項：申請者應於收受補正通知後三十日內補正，補正次數以二次為限；逾期未補正者不予受理。核定後查有不實得撤銷或廢止。
questions.explain_en: Article 18(2): correct within 30 days of notice, at most twice; otherwise not accepted. Approval may be revoked if information is false.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 裝有危害性化學品之船舶、航空器或運送車輛之標示，應依何規定辦理？
questions.c_zh: 交通法規有關運輸之規定
questions.q_en: Labeling of ships, aircraft or vehicles carrying hazardous chemicals follows:
questions.explain_zh: 第20條：對裝有危害性化學品之船舶、航空器或運送車輛之標示，應依交通法規有關運輸之規定辦理。
questions.explain_en: Article 20: per the transport provisions of traffic regulations.

questions.law: 危害性化學品標示及通識規則
questions.q_zh: 放射性物質及 CNS 15030 分類之環境危害性化學品之標示，應依何規定辦理？
questions.d_zh: 游離輻射及環境保護相關法規
questions.q_en: Labeling of radioactive substances and environmentally hazardous chemicals (CNS 15030) follows:
questions.d_en: Ionizing radiation and environmental protection laws
questions.explain_zh: 第21條：對放射性物質、CNS 15030分類之環境危害性化學品之標示，應依游離輻射及環境保護相關法規規定辦理。第22條：農藥及環境用藥依農藥及環境用藥相關法規。
questions.explain_en: Article 21: ionizing radiation and environmental laws; Article 22: pesticides and environmental agents follow their own laws.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則係依職業安全衛生法第幾條規定訂定？
questions.q_en: The OSH Sign Installation Guidelines are enacted under which OSH Act article?
questions.explain_zh: 第1條：本準則依職業安全衛生法第六條第三項規定訂定之。第2條：雇主設置之標示，除其他法規或國家標準另有規定外，依本準則辦理。
questions.explain_en: Article 1: under Article 6(3); Article 2: employer signs follow these Guidelines unless other laws or national standards provide otherwise.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 「高壓電」、「墜落」、「高熱」、「輻射」等危險之標示，屬何種標示？
questions.q_en: Signs for high voltage, falls, extreme heat or radiation are:
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第1款第2目：警告標示：警告既存之危險或有害狀況，包括高壓電、墜落、高熱、輻射等危險。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(1)(2): warning signs warn of existing dangerous or harmful conditions such as high voltage, falls, heat and radiation.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生標示設置準則
questions.q_zh: 反應塔、鍋爐房、安全門、急救箱、消防栓、機房等之標示，屬何種用途？
questions.a_zh: 一般說明或提示之用途或處所標示
questions.q_en: Signs for reactor towers, boiler rooms, emergency exits, first-aid kits, hydrants or machine rooms are:
questions.a_en: General information signs indicating use or location
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第2款：一般說明或提示包括用途或處所之標示（反應塔、鍋爐房、安全門、伐木區、急救箱、急救站、救護車、診所、消防栓、機房）、操作或儀控之標示、說明性質之標示。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(2): general information covers location/use signs, operation/instrument signs, and explanatory signs such as directions and signal meanings.
